angi_reviews.text: Tommy and his crew just finished the complete remodeling of our new home. The work took several months and during this time they remodeled each space including the kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms, entry etc… Tommy started with the 3D design and after we agreed on that phase, he came up with execution plan including the prices. The work was managed by him daily and according to the schedule that he planned for us. We were informed on each and every step of the work while Tommy made sure that the price will remain within the agreed budget. We really love the new remodeling and our home got a brand new look. We highly recommend Tommy and each one of his crew for any remodeling project.

We were looking for estimates for a room addition several months ago when we came across ET Builders. We already had a few estimates but decided we needed one more. They sent Tommy, one of the project managers, to give us an estimate, and he explained things better than other company we had looked at.  We went with ET Builders for our project and glad we did. They helped with financing and helped with questions we had. The room addition isn’t finished yet but so far it’s been going great. The workers clean up as much as they can every day when they go home. If we have questions Tommy is always a phone call away to answer them and if he doesn’t have the answer he calls back as soon as he does. So far I would highly recommend this company for any project you need. They are very professional and have great customer service.

Tommy at ET Builders was our project manager at our home. Tommy was so professional and very detailed. He made this construction job an absolute delight! As far as the work itself, they could move my job up an entire week! Which meant I got my project done a week early. When does that happen? The guys were great, and they did an excellent job. They cleaned up everything so nicely. Spotless!!! The job was done beautifully and I simply love it! Now I can have parties and entertainment in my backyard. I highly recommend ET Builders!!!

We hired Tommy, the contractor for ADU Garage Conversion. We went with him and his team on such a large remodeling project because he is ‘the’ specialist in that area. They also gave me very competitive price. Tommy and his team were a real pleasure to work with. Tommy and the team that worked at our house were always on time, respectful, disciplined and responsible. The project was finished ahead of the promised schedule and outcome is great. Big thanks to Tommy. very honest and helpful person. Highly recommend ET Builders!

I contacted ET Builders to help with my garage conversion. I wanted to build a one bedroom, one bathroom, living room and a small kitchen. I was working with Tommy, the project supervisor. He was great. I had a lot of questions and he answered each question. He was very patient and professional. They helped with the architectural drawings and getting the needed permits from the city. Also, there was a DWP easement on my property and they worked with DWP to get that approval. I would very much recommend ET Builders for any remodeling/construction job you may have. These guys are straightforward and wonderful to work with!

We started our remodeling project with our bathroom, and it went much better than we expected so we decided to do more remodeling projects (now that we have more free time). Tommy helped us select all the materials and fixtures that we needed for the first remodeling and his workers worked every day and they completed the project on time. The remodeling job went so well that we had them do the other bathrooms, kitchen and front landscape. Tommy, and the rest of the team did a very professional job and we are very pleased with the results. We do recommend them to anyone considering a remodeling project.

Tommy at ET Builders did a STUNNINNG remodeling job for us. We basically redid our entire first floor that included the kitchen, guest bathroom, living room and dining room area and all of it looks gorgeous. Tommy and his team of people were easy, polite, and honest people to work with, super responsive, and very affordable compared to everyone else. They also painted the entire spaces, installed washer dryer hookups and installed our new wood flooring. We will be hiring them for future projects. Can’t wait!

Very well- Tommy was referred to me by my friend.  He arrived to the appointment on time- showed me examples of his work on his ipad and I felt very confident that he was the man for the job. 

We went through everything that me and my wife each wanted in the kitchen and Tommy put it all together for us flawlessly.  We did a modern theme with an amazing layout.  The flow in the kitchen is what sets the tone for the whole house.

We have an open space with no walls so the kitchen is defined by the center island as well as the free standing counter that is the home base station.  It is wide and long so we have amazing white stools on the outside and the inside facing the center island is all cabinet space.  It also serves as our buffet station when we entertain.  You can see the whole house from our kitchen.

We couldn't be happier.

I needed a new roof for my house and garage, I also enclosed my patio and added a master bedroom and bathroom to the downstairs.  This is the first time I used ET Builders and to my surprise it was flawless.  Usually a project like this is full of headaches and delays but I must say that the level of professionalism and service that I experienced is that best I have ever had and I have done plenty of projects. There were no surprises everything was as promised the only delay that we had was due to the permit and that was just a few days.  The crew was very respectful and they cleaned up the job site everyday.  I will definitely use ET Builders again!

Tommy is very professional.  He is meticulous and pays attention to every small detail.  We remodeled our kitchen from the ground up, he designed a wonderful layout that is comfortable and the same space looks 10 times bigger!  It came out better than I anticipated.

I would definitely recommend Tommy and I will use him again when I am ready to redo the bathrooms and add a backyard deck.

The reason for 4 instead of 5 stars was the oven was higher than the counter about a quarter inch while the back of the oven is flush with the counter. Before the kitchen floor was replaced with laminates, the entire oven was flush with the counter, and the reason was the laminate was installed under the front legs of the oven where the floor was bare before that caused the oven front to be elevated.

The quality of the work is top notch. The team is made up of well-mannered professionals. And the price was very reasonable. The hardwood flooring throughout my property sustained significant damage from tenant’s cats. It was so disheartening. I scheduled Mario and his team for the initially planned work, but once the tenants were finally evicted, we discovered the scope of work needed was much larger. Mario’s company was flexible enough to enable me to still meet my deadline. This was during the last big heat wave of the summer, so conditions were tough. But this team was nothing but professional. Mario knows his wood flooring and won't settle for low quality work!
Estimate was explained well.  Was very clear up front about the scope of work included.
Upon removing my carpet, he found some damage to my substrate that needed to be repaired - immediately told me there would be additional cost which I agreed with.  When I asked for extra work, Mario was clear about what would be additional work and what could be done in his original estimate. 
I appreciate that he ordered extra long trim pieces when his supplier only had 8' lengths.  The long pieces look much better than the 8' pieces would have.  He also put extra coats of finish on my stair treads because he wasn't happy with the quality.
 
Although the work took longer than he estimated, Mario did not ask for any unreasonable change orders.
I would not hesitate to recommend Mario to a friend!

Mario and his crew worked diligently and professionally to install the new floors.  The result looks fantastic.  They maneuvered skillfully around several surprises that presented themselves upon removing the previous flooring (mold, bizarrely configured landing, etc.).   From the beginning, their expertise with and knowledge of wood floors made the experience a huge success.  For example, they recommended a type of floor that met our needs and taste, worked well with the sub-floor in our place, and was in stock at a reasonable price at a nearby flooring distributor.  Finally, Mario and his team were funny and personable with our entire family.

It was a pleasure working with Mario, he is very knowledgeable and helpful. Mario?s team did a great job repairing my antique hardwood floor in my 110-year old house. There was water damage, dry rot and missing wood planks. They did a great job at blending in the new wood with the old wood. Professional, knowledgeable and friendly crew. The floors look beautiful! I highly recommend Mario Diaz Flooring.
The job took 3 days total including two coats of oil-based polyeurthane. They were extremely helpful with your moving the furniture from the house putting it into the garage and covering the rest on the patio while they we finished our floors. They did a amazing job and then put everything back. I would hire them again anytime I need wood floors or wood floor serviced.

Job went well. When I asked for a estimate they came out and I knew I wanted two bedrooms and a hallway done. I was also interested in doing my dining room. I had them look at all of the areas. When I got my quote I only got the quote for the two bedrooms and hallway from them as that was what I knew I wanted. The job went well and turned out beautifully. Once completed I was really interested in doing the dining room immediately. The quote came back at twice the square foot range. Like the same price as the original job, but for 1/4 of the square footage. They explained that because it was a small area the price per square foot would not be the same. Understandable yes, HOWEVER, if they had told me that before I started the job I WOULD have included it in the original job. DUH >>>> needless to say I was not able to afford to do my dining room. As a result the job itself was great. The professionalism of the company is where they lack.

Great communication and quality

The job went very well. The floors look brand new. The owner, Jaymes Pillar, was responsive, friendly, and knowledgeable. The workers went above and beyond by adding two extra layers of poly seal ("varnish") to the floors. There were some scraps along the baseboard in the hallway that I will have to paint over. There is a small gouge in the door jamb where the wood was crushed and the paint flaked off. They did not remove the plastic that was covering the linen closet in the hallway. Those are the only negatives. I definitely would hire this company again. I had interviewed three companies; one company was about 40% cheaper but I did not get that trustful vibe one gets when dealing with a family-owned business like Arbor. The other company was about $50.00 more expensive (an inconsequential amount). I felt I made the right choice.

The contractor was great to work with. He explained everything in detail and gave us an honest opinion on what we could scrimp on and what we should spend on. Unlike other contractors I've used, he actually called and texted me back quickly. Several of the jobs were actually completed AHEAD of schedule. The crew Roy brought in was professional and cleaned up nicely after each day's work. I would definitely use CA Builders again for our next project.

UPDATE: Unfortunately the rooftop patio entrance leaked significantly during the last rain storm.  There was also another leak that bubbled paint both upstairs and downstairs and will probably require drywall replacement.  We specifically asked them to make sure the roof entrance was watertight, but it was definitely not - buckets of water came through.

We got several estimates for a kitchen & Bathroom remodel and ended up selecting CA BUILDERS.             Ray impressed us as being exceptionally knowledgeable. On his first visit he immediately provided us with different 3D computer models of our kitchen & Bathrooms that we could preview. He was extremely helpful in making suggestions for the design and took us to various places to buy the needed supplies. Ray was always accommodating us if we wanted changes. Indeed he worked extremely hard to please us and put a lot of attention to all the details and to do everything possible to provide us with a beautiful kitchen and amazing Bathrooms. Everyone who worked for this company was doing their best to satisfy us. His crew was amazing and did a great job. We also appreciated Tina, the friendly secretary for this company who was always available to answer questions and to keep us informed of the production process. angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you [member name removed] for taking the time to give our company a review with your experience with us.

angi_reviews.text: Very professional company and the crew was very clean and punctual. Right from the start we were instructed the whole job from beginning to end. The material of my choice was order even if it was something they did not carry. Mike and Michael were very responsible and came daily once or twice to inspect the job site. I was able to stay at my home while so much was going on and I could not have been more happier with their work and friend and family won't stop complimenting the beautiful floors.

The 2 workers, both named Miguel were punctual and very professional. They really know their stuff and were a good source of information as to the future care of the floors. They were very good at relocating furniture despite some tight spots through which they had to maneuver. The floor is gorgeous- don't want to even tread on it!
They were professional, prompt.  We are delighted with the job that they did and would recommend them.

Ricardo, the guy who actually did the job, was fantastic. Very friendly, helpful meticulous and a true artist. He was super professional and helped us choose the right color for the floors. We thought of dark initially, but in the end we decided on a light golden stain after he provided several sample stains on our floor. It looks beautiful, like new (and the floor might be very well 50 years old!). We paid some more money since we wanted the floors finished with "bona traffic" (sealer). Thank you Ricardo - and your helper - for a great job!

The three day job went smoothly and without incident.  The hardest part appeared to be taking out and putting back the furniture, and they did this very well, without breakage.  I would definitely use this firm again.

I had gotten a bid from this company several years ago. When I called to get the work done- they remembered me- and used the same bid to do the work. I was under a very tight deadline - and they accommodated my time line- even over the 4th of July week-end. The guys who did the work spent a lot of time on each phase including draping plastic in doorways to block the dust. When it was all done- the tape did take off some paint around my kitchen area- but they did bring that to my attention- other than that- everything went really well. My wood floors look amazing. I wish I had done this years ago.

First, their approach to the sale was consultative and not pushy.  Other vendors on Angie's list (even highly rated) are concerned with hard sell and up sell.  Mike Pillar's staff was concerned with doing the job right.  Very professional approach.  While other installers we interviewed were most interested in getting us to agree to the sale, Mike's staff was concerned with getting the layout right. They carefully considered layout and made sure they got it right and never pressured in the sales process.  

Also, their prices were very fair. This was a fairly big job.  It took 9 days.  Great attention to detail from the entire crew.  The preparation was really well done.  They even did special touches that were not originally part of the specified job. Overall great experience.  Next time I would use Pillar and not worry about getting multiple bids.
I loved them.  They did a great job and I highly recommend them.  They were very professional and very clean.  The guys who did the job cleaned up every day, and they were careful with my furniture.

I went to look for hardwood floors on Friday, January 25th.  I chose Mike Pillar because of the excellent reviews on Angie's List.  Mike carefully explained the different options available, and what would work best on my slab concrete floors.  I chose the wood I wanted, and made an appointment for them to come measure the following Tuesday.  Had a quote the next day, and booked the job to start the following Wednesday.  They actually were able to start the work a day earlier.  The workers arrived on time and were very professional.  They completed the job in four days, and the workmanship was beautiful.  There was a minor issue with the placement of some closet hardware, but when I called about it, Mike himself came out to the house and immediately fixed the problem.  Not being a patient person, it was very gratifying to have my hardwood floors completed within two weeks of the day I walked into the showroom.

I needed to replace my wooden floor and my friend recommended me LA Hardwood Floors and Remodeling.

Camilo and his team did a great job on our floors! Despite the other reviews, our experience with him was positive. He was punctual and professional and completed the job within two days. Everything he explained to us that was a part of the refinishing process happened as planned. There were no surprises and that's a good thing considering our stringent deadline! The only thing I would say is that if you use LA Hardwood Floors, make sure you're serious about it. Camilo and team are busy guys and his prices are extremely competitive. Half of floors in the house appeared glossy and the other half looked very dull.  The thresholds that were sanded down were uneven and had sharp edges. I could see nail holes in the baseboards. They pulled the baseboard out a quarter of an inch to cover up holes in the floors instead of fixing the holes in the floor themselves. We had to call another company to give us estimates for the problem because LA Hardwood Floors and  Remodeling Inc. Company tried to fix the problem but made it worse. Great. Camilo is a young, ambitious business-owner who is responsible, affordable and does great work. angi_reviews.text: Fantastic. We have used Rosswood Flooring in the past and have referred him to others. Ross is always extremely helpful and honest in his assessment and it is clear he is a veteran in his trade. We couldn’t be happier with his services and will continue to use him in the future.

Ross Wood Flooring did a fantastic job. They worked quickly and installed our floors at an expert level. We are constantly being told how great our floors look, and that is all due to the great work that Ross Wood Flooring did. I highly recommend them for any and all flooring jobs.

Ross and his team of professionals do amazing work. The care they took in identifying floor creaking and making sure everything was level before they laid the vinyl planks was above and beyond. This team cares about what they do and it shows.
They did a great job. I highly recommend them. They were very professional.

Ross and his team were professional and punctual. He responded to any questions I had in a timely manner and also provided me with samples after I described to him what look I was going for. He never made me feel rushed to make a decision but made sure I was aware of any deadlines. He informed me of the progress of the install and in the end I was left with beautiful wood laminate floors. Thank you Ross!
Ross was the best contractor I have ever worked with. Price was fair, quality of work was excellent and the job was completed very quickly. He and his team were just great people.
I highly recommend Ross Wood Flooring. Ross is great to work with and he does excellent work.
On time, on budget, went great, hassle-free.

Ross is highly knowledgeable and honest. There was an issue with a cleaner we had used on our floors (our fault not his) but he redid the initial seal, free of charge, to make sure we had the level of sheen we wanted! Ross would not give up until our floors looked perfect. It's rare to find a company that stands by their work in this way! Ross and his team are also punctual, easy to work with, and very conscientious. We highly recommend Ross Wood Flooring:

Ross was absolutely fantastic. Our job was small so I was pleased that he treated us like our job was just as important as something much larger. When he says he or his team will be there, they show. Super nice to deal with and excellent work product. Really happy with the way the floor came out. After the job was done, he came back the next morning to put furniture back. Will definitely use him again.

Floor replaced as quoted . Beautiful . Came on time just like comments on Angie's said he did on other jobs . Didn't wastes time talking or fooling around . Had all the equipment needed for the job . Would hire Ross Wood Floors again with no questions asked .

Ross was the perfect flooring guy. He responded to my calls, he showed up on time, he had very good and knowledgeable advice about the flooring, he had a good eye for details, and his price was reasonable. Ross ordered my wood flooring materials and had it delivered. His installation took the amount of time he said it would and he started and finished on time. I highly recommend him and would hire him again.

Ross is a true professional. He spent hours with my wife and I, assisting us will evaluating multiple options to remedy a floor situation we had that was the result from an upstairs leak. Ultimately, the option we chose had to be completed in conjunction with cabinet installers, remediation companies, and granite installers, all while my wife was 9 months pregnant. Ross lived up to his promise to have the project completed before our new arrival, amidst numerous unforeseen obstacles. Ross and his team worked efficiently, were diligent about caring for our belongings, and left the work area looking better than it did before they started. I would hire Ross for a similar or more complex project in a heartbeat.
It went fine, see the above comments
Ross was very responsive, helpful, professional, qualified and very trustworthy. He set expectations and he delivered on them. My floor is gorgeous, and I could not be more pleased.

Ross did a superb job. He showed up on time every day and worked hard throughout the day. He started by grinding down thinset on the slab to prepare the surface. He then glued down engineered hardwood on the slab. He pays extra attention to detail as he undercut the fireplace, installed stair risers flawlessly, and even crafted his own transitions into the kitchen which saved us money and looked awesome! He worked around other contractors needs in the house well and always kept us in the loop with his progress. Ross was very honest and there were no surprises whatsoever and would definitely hire him again. Wood floors look beautiful as Ross is a true master of his craft.
He arrived on-time, worked efficiently, and kept his word. I felt comfortable having him working in my house and would highly recommend him.

He was also able to get us a discount on the purchase price of the hardwood floors.

Dan and his team did an exceptional job on our floors. The floors look great and are holding up well under my families constant abuse.  I took three bids on the project and now know that I made the right choice. Thank you Dan!
unknown

They did a good job. They were here for 5 days. There was a lot of glue residue which took some time  to remove (more than a day) before they could proceed with the refinishing. They seemed very knowledgeable and knew exactly what they were doing. They sanded and also put down two coats of sealer. They also did a wood transition strip treatment between the living room and hall way. I let them come up with  suggestions or recommendations to how it should look. They really did a good job; the floor looks great. These guys seem to be real top of the line, providing good quality.
They were good. Everything came out great!

The New Floor Co did a floor repair/patch wear our old floor furnace use to be.  They matched the current wood, latticed it in and spot sanded it.
They were punctual, professional and did a very good job of  matching and blending in the new patch to the old floor.
We will use them again.

It could not have gone any better!  They were clean, professional, quick and did excellent work.  When they left, the floors were perfect and brand new while matching the style and color of stain as the original flooring.  If you are looking for a flooring guy who does excellent work at a reasonable price, look no further.  He was not the cheapest, he was the middle of the 4 quotes I received...but keep in mind, if you pay for peanuts, you get monkeys....or something like that!

A very good experience.  Dan gave us several options to consider and provided some good recommendations.  The tear out could not have gone better - the guys took out the carpet, padding and old hardwoods and cut them all into managable pieces to reduce the clutter in the back yard as they worked.  The home was built in the 1920s and there were some "interesting" obstacles in terms of angles and subfloor issues, but the guys always made a solution and the outcome is beautiful.
They're highly  recommended, they do excellent work and color matched existing floors perfectly.  The owner honored the 5% Angie's List Discount he offered at the time as well.

Dan, the proprietor, was quick to come out to our vacant house and give us an estimate.  We were trying to get the floors done prior to moving in to the house, so there was a tight time frame, with other types of work that had to be delicately scheduled around the flooring job.  There was a bit of a scheduling snafu, created by a worker who fell ill, that would have jeopardized the floors getting done when promised, but Dan managed to step up to the plate and get it done as originally scheduled. This was most appreciated.  He also gave us a discount on top of the Angie's discount to make up for our trouble.  This also was most appreciated.  We were quite pleased with the way the floors turned out.

I may end up choosing them at a later point.  They were very professional.  The actual person, I think his name is Drew came out twice to my house and looked at the floor because my floor is unique, so he had to match the flooring.  I was happy with the time he took with me.
I had them come out a couple of times.  They did a great job. The people who came were nice.

They were very good. They were very thorough. The only issue that ever arose was that I had talked to the owner about moving furniture and the workers said they never move furniture. I told them to talk to their boss and they did and they moved the furniture. Once that was resolved they did a very good job. I was very happy with the results. I talked to three other companies and two were in the same range. Another one was way out and another company didn?t contact me until after the project was done. The price was fair and reasonable. I didn?t have any buyer?s remorse. They were very responsive and I would definitely hire them again.

Dan screened, cleaned and re-coated 1 room that was looking a little worn, as well as spot coating a few damaged areas. The whole job came out looking just fantastic, and Dan managed to find the time to do it on short notice. Not only is he a craftsman with a great eye for detail, and great knowledge about hardwood floors, but he's also just a genuinely nice guy. I will most certainly be using New Floor Co again. Thanks Dan!

They were very good. They said what they were going to do and they did it on time and go out. The floor looks beautiful. They showed up on time. They explained what I needed to do to keep the floors nice. They were awesome!

Dan Paik and his crew are very professional. Dan has 30 years of experience in the business and an in depth knowledge of materials available. I was ready to settle for wood I had found on my own, but when I showed Dan the sample, he had other suggestions. The flooring I choose with his advice is gorgeous and has held up perfectly with two large dogs. My living room was done more than a year ago and there's not a scratch on it. It was the perfect choice for a place that gets wear and tear--yet, it's absolutely beautiful. What impressed me the most about The New Floor Company is their attention to detail. The moldings, the doorways and transitions to other rooms, and especially my stairways are perfectly executed.  The crew is polite and easy to have around, and they clean up after themselves.  These guys are the best. This is the 4th home I've owned with wood floors, and the other companies I've used in the past do  not measure up to The New Floor Company.
They were in terrible shape. He did excellent work. He was very, very careful. There was a lot of restoration work. I would absolutely hire him again.

angi_reviews.text: Great personal service, completed the job in less time than they had originally planned.

Oren said it was not in our best interest to refinish our 100 yr old fir hardwood floor which had no subfloor.  Expensive to find fir flooring boards; and where the floor flexed while walking over it, the joists are too far apart to stabilize the floor. I was disappointed with this news.  The samples Oren brought out to the house were nice and large for visualizing what it would look like.  He said he soaked a piece in a bathtub over night with no damage.  So we went with Aqua Armor Tech flooring which Oren had advised and we are very happy with the results.  The floor is sturdy when walked on and it's beautiful.  Time will tell how it holds up.  Oren's crew installed it quickly and the price was very good.  We highly recommend them.
Oren and his crew were wonderful. A shoutout to Francisco the color matching expert. He did a great job matching the original color, since we only did half the floor. Love OB Floors, Inc.

Oren and company were amazing. They refinished part of my wood floor and transformed the room, and actually charged less than the quote, based on the actual amount of work needed! I'm so happy with the result and would use them for anything. And -- they came when they said they would!

Contracted with OB floors to stain and refinish my kitchen and family room floors, and to install new baseboards.  Beto and Frank did an exceptional job, which included spending time to match the stain to newly installed hardwood floors. They are the best company I have ever used ! Orin and his workers are the most  sincere genuine people I have ever met ! Very professional, courteous and great work ! I love my new laminate floors ! I will hire them again ! Great price too !

angi_reviews.text: Ken and Hugo are fantastic!   We have had them remodel our kitchen and two bathrooms, one being the master. Both bathrooms were complete demolition and remodel, and one needed to reroute the existing plumbing. All three remodels turned out amazing!  Their tile and granite work are superb. They guided us along on all three projects, offering suggestions and pointing us to the right vendors to get our materials, all of whom made this overwhelmed couple feel very comfortable, and helped with the designs.  We are so happy with the results and feel very fortunate to have found them.

Amazing. On time, fairly priced. Clean and responsible.  Ken was great as was his team.  He remodeled our master bathroom and did stack stone on our fireplace wall. We are going to have him do our two other bathrooms.  I highly recommend Ken.
Ken Keck did an outstanding job; thorough pre-design and cost estimate, worked with us closely on all steps in executing work in  timely manner, very friendly to work with. We highly recommend him.

Ken at Affordable Tile is easy to work with and does exceptionally good work, and his prices are fair and reasonable.  Ken and his crew did a complete shower remodel for my home. They demoed the old shower and then rebuilt a new shower from the studs and floor up. Work included framing the substructure of the shower and then an awesome hot mop job, and then they framed and floated the floor, bench, and walls. The tile work was so beautiful it nearly brought tears to my eyes. I bought modern tiles with size 13” x 39”, so Ken and his crew had to cut every single tile, and every cut was spot on, and not one tile was broke or wasted, it was unbelievable. The finished product looks terrific. I also loved that Ken always let me know when he would arrive, and always showed up on time and put in a full day of work. The whole job took about 8 days, and Ken and his crew cleaned up at the end of each day, and kept my home free of dust and debris. I would highly recommend for any shower remodel or tile installation.

Ken was fabulous to work with. Reasonably priced and excellent work. Great communication every step of the way. Can’t say enough good things about the process. Most importantly the bathroom looks amazing. So glad we made the right choice in a contractor. Highly recommend!
Love my new master bathroom! Also had my kids bathroom redone and it turned out great!! I would hire them again.
My wife and I were very impressed with the job done by Ken , Sherrie and his crew. Our home has a nice new appearance and we will likely have some more jobs soon for ATI ! Jon & Mary Moorpark, CA.

Ken and his staff were fantastic from beginning to end. He made the process so easy and he was always up front and transparent about the service and prices. We had our bathroom remodeled last year and the previous contractor did such a poor job, we had to have new tile installed again. The difference between the two contractors was night and day. We are so happy with how the shower turned out. We would DEFINITELY want to work with him and his company again in future.

I can’t say enough great things about Ken from Affordable Tile. He explained the process, showed up on time, was professional, clean and made great suggestions. I would use him again in a heartbeat (if I had more bathrooms!) I highly recommend, you won’t be disappointed!

Absolutely wonderful!!! Ken and team installed kitchen tile and granite countertop two years ago and was so terrific that I called again when we were interested in removing 20 year old fake fireplace surround and old ugly. We replaced with a piece of reclaimed wood- sanded and stained and ordered same tile as our new kitchen Excellent!! Will be calling Ken again when we are ready to remodel our two bathrooms!

Ken, the business' owner, showed excellence in his professionalism and his work. It is noteworthy that he both worked on and carefully monitored the work done. He is an excellent contractor. His website shows some of the beautiful work he has done

The job was fantastic as we knew it would be.  He and his crew transformed an old fiberglass bathtub into a work of art.  We now had a stall shower with glass tile, rock floor and a pebble ledge with new shower head and handles.  It is just beautiful and we love it.  For our second bathroom again he and his crew removed the old fiberglass tub.  Installed a new tub and accessories along with glass tile up to the ceiling.  Another job well done!!!

I was very satisfied with the professionalism that Ken Keck of Affordable Tile and would refer my friends to him anytime!!

After getting a number of quotes for doing the tile in our bathroom, we decided to go with Jose and JC Tile, and now that the job is complete, I can say it was the right decision for us. Communication is very important to me, and Jose always responded in a timely manner via phone and text message throughout the entire process. In my opinion and from a previous remodel experience, it is important for as many details to be discussed and noted prior to approving any contract. We agreed on work to be provided, and they surpassed my expectations. In addition to Jose, Norman and Randy were the crew members on this project, and my family appreciates their professionalism, work quality and in asking questions when it came down to decision making time for tile lines and options available. My kids liked everyone, which is unusual for strangers who come over to the house. The whole JC Tile team was flexible and worked with me on making everything discussed come to fruition.

The men were always prompt to start the day and left the house as they found it at the end. We asked Jose to do a herringbone tile pattern in our guest bathroom, and even though we were unable to find tiles for that, Jose was able to cut the tiles and make it look phenomenal. Overall, it was a great job, and the extra little details that were added put everything over the top. Basically he redid our entire house, so it will be a while before we are doing this again, but when that time comes, I will be contacting Jose! I can not recommend him highly enough.

Jose did a small job that turned into unforeseen complications. He was very professional and knowledgeable throughout the process and honored his original price. The new kitchen back splash looks terrific! He is also very clean, on time and I will use him again. 6-Stars for JC Tiles!!

angi_reviews.text: Good job. Fast work.
Jose was wonderful to work with! He is a reputable contractor and does amazing work. We couldn't have been happier!

We highly recommend J.C. Tiles Company! The owner Jose was amazing. We are so impressed by his work. every detail we spent talking over he listened to the vision and our concerns ... we needed J.C. Tile company to completely remove our very old shower... he did a great job with keeping everything clean and protected. Also, did a beautiful job artistically lining up the tiles to reflect a waterfall-like flow coming down from the top.. It came out unique and looks like I paid a lot of money for this project but, actually it was very reasonable. We paid out of pocket for all materials. We are so happy with his work. the installation of our new beautiful tile walls to the ceiling and pebble floor is a wonderful change. also, they helped assist with plumbing and shower doors install. I highly recommend Jose company J.C.Tiles.
GREAT! I appreciated his attention to detail. He did a beautiful job.
Jose did an amazing job!
Very well! He is very easy to work with and talk to. Very happy with his work! I love my kitchen!

Working with Jose was great as I had a work intensive design. He worked with me through all the stages to make sure he understood my drawings and that it met my satisfaction at every step. Jose directed me to his preferred tile supplier which had an expansive selection and the representative gave me Jose's contractor price. I recommend Jose for any tile project you may have. In fact we decided to have Jose do another bathroom since the master turned out so well.

We are very happy with Jose's work.  He and his crew were very responsive, fast but careful, and always punctual.  Jose is the kind of tile contractor most people hope they will be able to find.  He is very aware of the customer's needs and concerns and never left us wondering what was going on.  He and his crew worked very hard in record high summer heat to get the job done and exceed our expectations.  They have a great "eye" for aesthetic choices like tile pattern choices and calculating the tile cuts so they look great and aren't too narrow in one area, etc.  They left our remodel site clean and tidy.  We will definitely use Jose again!

Jose and his crew did a fantastic job. They were prompt, clean, courteous and went above and beyond to make sure I was absolutely happy.  The herringbone pattern is absolutely perfect and symmetrical and cuts are precise.  Grout lines evenly spaced.  I had a different installer put in floor tile and job was sub-par.  Jose regrouted areas for me and sealed it.  I wish he had done the floor install to begin with!  His attention to detail is there and he can interpret your vision for your space and give you exactly what you want!  I will be using him again in the future.

angi_reviews.text: It went very smoothly.

My husband and I installed hardwood floors in our house and ran out of steam when it came to completing the last room. Elizabeth was able to give me a quote over the phone since we already had all the materials and really just needed it installed. The crew was running a little late due to getting lost in the morning. The job took 1.5 days. They did a terrific job and cleaned up very well.

Contacted Elizabeth from Gamboa's Hardwood.  She came out the same day and was so easy and friendly to work with .  She was flexible and professional as we had to change our start date several times due to other sub-contractors.   They were on time and finished with the job exactly as estimated.  They were neat,cleaning up after themselves as the job progressed.  The floors are beautiful and we couldn't be happier.  We would recommend Gamboas Hardwood to anyone who wants a beautiful hardwood floor.

Elizabeth and her crew did a fantastic job.
It was a great experience with Elizabeth she was flexible and responsive.
When I noticed something I didn't like or any imperfections no excuses were made or trying to get out of the work the team was willing to do them. 
By far my favorite contractor to deal with during my renovations.

Elizabeth's crew members Jose and Rodolfo are courteous, clean, and meticulous with their work.
They did a great job at flushing out the existing hardwood floors into the new area. People can't tell where the new and the old began.

I also appreciated Elizabeth giving her design opinion and taking pride in what she deliveries. I lot of contracts I dealt with didn't have the same mindset. For her it wasn't about how fast she could get paid she was more about delivering a great product.
We were very pleased with their work.

Elizabeth was very professional and punctual. Very good price and very good work quality. They did a very good job with the hardwood floor installation. Her people were very professional and also clean up after everything was done. Had a walk through when the work is done. I was very happy with the work.

We could not move out from the apartment so they were helping us move furniture from one room to another . When we had delays because of us not having the material on site in time they were very professional.Same when they needed to come one hour later than the schedule I had to put Accusticork 1/2 inch thick per condo rules and that was costing  $ 2.5 per foot extra just in material and an additional day of work The suppliers recommended by Gamboa were very good The owner is Elizabeth Gamboa and she is very professional  Ask for the team of Jose Barella  ,Rodolfo and Charlino. They work good together and did an excellent job The apartment is at Ocean Terrace  in Rancho Palos Verdes and in this SLOW market a 1400sqft  2 bedroom 2 bath sells for aprox  $ 520000

Elizabeth checked in with me everyday, which I really appreciated-  if only all my contractors could be so good.  It took a bit longer than I expected but my floors look great.  There were a couple small issues that came up during the install but Elizabeth made sure they were fixed promptly.  I would definitely recommend them to others who are looking for floor installation and use them for my next one.  Great job guys!

They were very responsive and were flexible in working with us. We had a great experience with them. There was nothing to dislike about them. However, the floors weren?t matching with the rest of the house. They were great and we would use their services again.

angi_reviews.text: We were very pleased with the service and love our refinished hardwood floors.

Elizabeth was efficient and courteous, calling to confirm appointments and following up. She and her team were always prompt (although the start day was pushed back a day due to their truck breaking down - Elizabeth was apologetic). The job took place over three days and the floors look wonderful.
Elizabeth the contact person was very professional and courteous. Her workers are very goos and cleaned up after the work was done.

They did a good job. They had great customer service. They came out and did the work, however I think that I need an additional coat on my floors. The price was great. I had a great experience with Gamboa's.

The job was done efficiently and in a timely manner. The workman and workmanship was outstanding. The finished product is absolutely beautiful. Elizabeth, the lady in charge, was there daily to see that the project was going well. During the project, we inadvertently dented a significant portion of the floor in the den, and she told us not to worry, and the floor was ripped up and new flooring installed. She did not charge us for this but it took another day to complete the project because of this.
Their were some issues with communication, but their price was low and they did good work.

They did an excellent job. I wouldn't be able to find the repairs if I didn't know where the damage had been. I was a little disappointed that some of the stain due to water damage remained, but overall I'm very happy with their work. They were prompt in giving me an estimate, they did the work quickly and neatly and it looks great. I asked them to keep the same floor shade, which of course had darkened with age, and they did. My son had to meet them to give them access to the apartments and they arranged that with him. The cost estimate wasn't the lowest I got - but it was close.
They did an excellent job and were very honest about what needed to be done. Their price was excellent.

Overall went very well. Many areas were badly damaged by dog nail scratches. The results are great - floors look good, can't see scratches, the color matched the other rooms in the house. The did a good job cleaning up afterwards (touching up wall paint, even areas that needed it before they arrived), vacuumed, etc. The job took a few days longer than estimated originally and when they moved the furniture out of the rooms that they were going to be working on, it was alittle chaotic (stuff piled/shoved in a room without much organization). But overall it was a great job and we are very satisfied and would definitely hire them again.

Gamboa did an exceptional job. They matched the color and the wood perfectly. They are polite, courteous, friendly and respectful. They also had the best prices by far of any company and we got quotes from 7 places. I would highly recommend them.

angi_reviews.text: John and his crew were punctual, friendly and did outstanding work. John kept us informed every step of the way. He and his crew did not rush and did everything right. He made everything as easy as possible. They found a broken pipe which they also fixed.

angi_reviews.text: The job went very well. John worked with us by performing the work over three move-ins so that we were able to use most of our house during the process. The level of quality is very good including cement floated floors over wood and hot mop tar for waterproofing in the shower. The layout for the tile pattern was right on and Johns recommendations are good and should followed. I am a licensed contractor in another trade so I have a good understanding of doing a job right with a critical eye for workmanship.

angi_reviews.text: I found John V. to communicate every step of the project, with any time frame changes, or additional costs, all the while thru process. The sub-contractors very punctual and efficient, always left the area cleaned up. I had 2 bathrooms remodeled, upstairs and downstairs. I would recommend and use Tilebaths again.

John and his crew did a fantastic bathroom remodel for us. One thing we valued highly was communication. We always knew what was happening and when it would happen. John honored all of his commitments to us even though the project grew as we went along. They were excellent at cleaning up at the end of each work day and leaving things in usable condition for us over night. John listened to our concerns and desires and helped us through the entire process. The work was done well and professionally and it looks beautiful. Even our neighbors were impressed with them. We are delighted with TileBaths and would hire them again any day!
Mr Vaduro did all of the work on this project. He is friendly, punctual and very skilled at his profession. I intend to use his company again!

John was awesome! I had three other guys come out and never come back. He fixed the bigh problem we had with our shower wall, reinstalled the faucet, and tiled a bathroom window. Very professional, on time, quick. I've already been telling my friends if they need a tiler, this guys the one! The price fair, and the quality definitely worth it.

Took a lot longer than I anticipated but he always kept me up to date. Very good price. Good work. Had extra work done and he was able to accommodate. Should have written this review nine months ago. Been trying to get the second bathroom done and had numerous bids, Lots of disappointment with their professionalism. The deal was for one bathroom only or I would go back to them again, no problem.

John, the owner of Tilebaths was quite personable and did an excellent job of communicating progress, questions and suggestions for consideration. John and his staff were punctual, friendly and quite skilled at what they do. They always cleaned up the work area at the end of each day and disposed of any trash or debris. I recommend Tilebaths to anyone considering a bathroom remodel.

A bit over schedule, but well enough.

The job went very smoothly. John from Tile baths always showed up at the house when he said he would. I did upgrade the shower remodel but the price was discussed first so there were no surprise costs.

Very well. John worked with us since it took us time to decide on the tile that we wanted. He did a very professional job. We are very pleased with his work. We definitely will have John do all our future tile work.

John was very professional, knowledgeable. An excellent job for a fair price. The quality of his work is impeckable. He does all the work himself which was important to us to go along with the 25 year guaranty
John came in and surveyed the problem, came up with a blueprint and quoted me a great price. His work is outstanding and we Now have a beautiful bathroom. Tilebaths gets my highest recommendation.

John did an outstanding job. We changed out the existing shower, sink, faucet. John repaired the tile in the shower, installed the under-mount sink and had his plumber finish the plumbing. He showed up when he said he would and if he couldn't he would call and let me know of his delay. John is my my new "tile guy" from now on. I would recommend him to everyone.
It went great!

The job took approx 3 weeks to complete. We were comfortable with the rate of time as each step of the project was done with precision and care. There were no wasted days in the project as all of the sub contracted workers were scheduled ahead of time and came accordingly. From the beginning demolition to the laying of the final piece of tile, the workman were kind, courteous and very neat. I never had to go in after them to clean up a mess. The entire crew was professional and reliable throughout the project. We could not be more pleased at the final outcome of the project. The tile work done by John is splendid! You will be proud to show off your bathroom again, as I am. We will hire John and his crew for further projects.

Everything went according to plan. John and his staff were on time, clean and did quality work. We were very pleased with the outcome and John was readily available every time we needed to speak. I would highly recommend this company.
Good deal and a good price, but these are secondary compared to the responsiveness of John. Would definitely recommend and hire again.
It went great. John & Team are professional, courteous, on time, honest, and take pride in their work. I will never use anyone else ever again!

With help from tile the store designer, we bought the material for our project. I had intended to use a contractor recommended by the tile store but that proved to be futile! Next I checked Angie's List and found Tilebaths.com, John Vadurro is the owner. John knew exactly what we needed to have done and had the skills to make everything happen. We followed his suggestion to wainscot the bathroom walls and are glad we did! Finally, when the work was finished, my wife and I marveled at the way John made all the lines of the tile all fit together. I plan to use Tilebaths.com again!

angi_reviews.text:
Service was excellent. I have used George over several years, for several projects, and have always been extremely satisfied.
He has done two bathrooms, using specialty surfaces with pebble stones, slate and porcelain tiles. He has also redone a fireplace, 
resurfacing the exterior with slate. 
George is prompt , is fair on pricing, and easy to work with. He is always present on the jobs, and easy to work with .I would highly reccommend his services.

George and his associate were a pleasure to deal with. Because we are getting our house ready to put on the market, we needed the work done quickly and professionally. Not only did George come the day after I called, he came on a weekend to give us a quote. His quote for the work was fair and competitive and his work on all aspects of the job was immaculate. The new tiles he installed look fabulous and he matched some hard to find colors of our grout perfectly on our older 10-16 year old tiles. We'd never had our older tiles professionally cleaned before and now they look almost brand new! My husband and I are extremely pleased with the job he did.

I was hoping to remove and replace my 50 year old tired and broken tile in the kitchen with something fresher but after talking with George, he suggested I replace the tile with granite counter tops. Now top grade counter tops for my kitchen would generally cost about $3K plus installation but George knew of a granite product which he quoted me $1400 to install.  There was an additional cost of $150 for a new stainless sink but I didnt think that was too bad.  I could have skipped the sink but because of space limitations, the granite top would have had to be cut in half around the sink and I didnt think I would like that look.
Georges workers did the job in just a few hours and my wife is very happy with the results.
The project left me needing to call a plumber to install the sink connections and garbage disposal but now everything is just fine.
It went great.

George as usual very meticulous about any project he takes. He is very professional and very punctual on time, very honest and hard worker. I will highly recommend him for any kind of tile works, don't look anywhere else if you want your project to look perfect.

He and his journeymen waterproofed, levelled and expertly laid limestone with artful precision. His work is top notch with attention to detail at every stage. Tight clean lines, perfect drainage, careful and thoughtful craftsmanship.

top_complaint_summary: Overpriced service

angi_reviews.text: We hired Ric, his team and their expertise for a complete remodel of our master bathroom and two additional bathrooms, with an added challenge: I was five months pregnant with twins and needed the project completed before giving birth. Rick assured us they could handle it, and they proved true to their word. Almost every day, there was someone on-site, diligently pushing the project forward. We even decided on some last-minute additions, including a heated floor and towel rack, and they accommodated these changes while still meeting the deadline. While I wasn't entirely pleased with the communication style of their design person, I later learned that this individual is no longer with the company. It seems it was a misalignment with their otherwise very transparent approach. In summary, I would certainly recommend their services!

Working with Rick and his team on our remodel was delightful. Yes, you read that right, working with a contractor on a construction project in Camarillo was an absolute delight. The craftsmanship is high-quality, the process was extraordinarily well-managed and the communication was continuous. Our down-to-the-studs remodel was completed on time and on budget and we couldn't be happier with the result! I attribute this to the culture of his team, relationships with vendors and craftspeople, weekly (sometimes more) communication with us, a detailed estimate, expert project planning, and the ability to manage unexpected things that come up. After we finished a previous project, I swore I would never embark on another large construction endeavor but the prospect of working with Dezign Construction again has me reconsidering :)

I am so happy with my new bathroom.  Especially happy that I hired Dezign Construction to do the job. The completed remodeling project was far beyond my expectations.  Rick managed the entire work and teams. He listened to my ideas and gave amazing advice regarding how to achieve my vision.  He came to the house often to check on the project and was always available by text if I had questions. He was attentive and knowledgeable regarding all aspects of remodeling the bathroom. Rick checked in with me regarding the smallest details of the projects - making sure everything was the way I wanted. I LOVE my bathroom.  Thank you Rick, and the Dezign Construction team.

Rick and the Dezign Construction team are truly exceptional. After a nightmare experience with a previous contractor who consistently expanded the scope and provided subpar work, Rick's team stepped in and completely turned things around. Their pricing was fair and all-inclusive, covering permits, plans, and everything else. Throughout the project, they maintained the initial scope without any cost increases. The project passed all inspections, adhered to the timeline, and the outcome exceeded expectations. Notably, we undertook a full basement conversion that now rivals the appeal of the main floor. Highly recommended. For further details or images of the completed work, feel free to contact me.

I was delighted to hire Rick for my ADU remodeling project, and they proved to be an exceptional duo! Their personable nature, honesty, efficiency, and timely work were impressive. With limited knowledge in construction, their guidance throughout the process was invaluable. They even took care of additional project tasks, saving me time.  Despite my initial concerns about the project's duration, Rick estimated 4 weeks and completed it in about 5 weeks. Their efficiency was truly impressive! After the project's completion, I was pleased to find the place immaculately clean, reflecting their commitment to quality. Grateful for Rick and their crew's outstanding work, I would gladly hire them for future projects.

Working with Rick was an absolute pleasure from beginning to end. We initially began the design process with a different architect, but the contrast between them and Rick was striking. Rick's responsiveness was exceptional, with email replies coming in almost immediately. He efficiently handled revisions and worked within our budget to design an ADU that we absolutely adore. Rick's professionalism, excellent communication, and remarkable customer service skills set him apart. We were so impressed with the experience that we intend to have Rick support us as we further expand our main house in the future.

We absolutely adore our house! Collaborating with Dezign Construction and our exceptional project manager, Rick, has been an extraordinary experience. Rick consistently demonstrated remarkable responsiveness, perfectly aligning himself with our project goals. His invaluable recommendations throughout the process greatly enhanced the outcome, and it was an absolute pleasure working with him. We were also fortunate to have an outstanding team, including our talented architect, the creative designer, and all the dedicated individuals involved in our project. Their relentless dedication and hard work allowed them to complete the project ahead of schedule. Needless to say, we are absolutely thrilled with the exceptional results!

Rizk at Dezign Construction is the epitome of an exceptional contractor. Not only is he friendly and approachable, but he possesses the valuable qualities of being a good listener and highly detail-oriented. His exceptional communication skills further enhance the overall experience of working with him. I am immensely grateful to have found Dezign Construction for my complete home remodeling project, as their expertise and dedication have brought me great satisfaction.

Warning... Sloppy Contractors, Smooth Sales Man, Dishonest people.  Read other reviews that have low to bad reviews and are almost identical to what we experienced.
unknown

Nir and Itay showed up today on time for an estimate, were friendly, personable, and helped us brainstorm a better way to arrange our kitchen. We agreed to move forward and look forward to seeing the finished product!

I was very happy with my experience at United Builders of LA and will use them again (and have recommended to friends). They are a very nice compromise between super high end European kitchens ($$$$), on one hand, and Ikea ($) on the other. Somewhere in between in terms of cost, but great quality and ability to create custom designs. Nir did a nice job in designing and project managing, and they were more or less on time.

Nir was great. He was attentive and very friendly. He listened to everything that we wanted for our home improvements. He was very patient with us and very knowledgeable.  We also spoke with Sharon over the phone and she was very friendly and patient with us.  They will start the work in the next few days. I will provide another review once they complete the job.   Yes I would recommend this provider.

Project went extremely well. The work was accomplished efficiently and the workman were very courteous and the work area kept very clean. Nir Elidayan is a top notch contractor--extremely impressive. Work was meticulously inspected at each key point in the process. We were very impressed when Nir noticed the workmen had repaired a scupper rather than replacing it as he had directed, he immediately had the work reaccomplished the next morning. We would not have even known that it wasn't to his standards had he not insisted it be "done right." The work was done as promised and on schedule. We have had a few heavy rains with no leaks and we are thrilled with the results. We were so impressed with Nir and The United Builders of L.A. that we contracted them to completely remodel two bathrooms and two bedrooms! We highly recommend United Builders of L.A.
The Purchase of the house did not go through but I will definitely use Nir again to do my next construction job.  Very educated and experienced on a complete rehab property.

With a great crew led by Nir, I can comfortably say that I am beyond pleased. It goes back to the first day we met with Nir from United Builders of LA, and from design to breaking ground he led us the whole way with great communication which we all know is the key to success and even though there were a few bumps along the project, they were dealt with in the most understanding, professional and competent way possible with out any arguments or headaches. I am very happy with all the work and the end result this contractor is a keeper and now i understand what he meant when he said "HE DOESN'T SELL HOME IMPROVEMENT, HE BUYS CUSTOMERS FOR LIFE" I would recommend him any day to any one.Thank you Nir, and thank you United Builders of LA for all the hard work, I love it!!!!! PS Thank you for the thoughtful gift it fits perfectly in our home.

Nir was very communicative through the whole process and did exactly what I wanted.  He always returned my calls and was always receptive to my changes.  The project turned out to be very successful and very beautiful!! I would recommend him to anyone!

It was hard to find a good contractor after hearing some stories of unfinished work and prices going up as job progress.
I used my mom advise and chose a referral - word of mouth- contractor which my mom used couple of years ago.
Thank god she kept his business card! I called, I got an estimate from Nir, and started the job.Short 4 weeks later, without too much hassle, i have a new (well.. upgraded) bathroom and kitchen

Our start day was nearing  and I received a call from Mikey, wanting to schedule a date to go shopping for materials, How exciting
when that was done we confirmed to start the following Monday. On that day Mike and his crew showed up early morning, he did a walkthrough with us and his team leader Marcelo, and made sure everything was clear and understood.
And we were off. from covering to demolition, framing stage and inspections i must say everything Mikey told us would happen did and it was really a pleasure.
The team was courteous and polite they cleaned up everyday and whenever something came up they addressed the matter promptly with a smile.
I must say i couldn't be happier  with the results. and i would recommend United Builders of LA in a heart beat.

,We were impressed with the quick response and imaginative solutions to different water leakage problems we had. No further leakage problems since the work was completed.They also came up with a solution to a tricky lighting problem we had  in our kitchen. The quality of the work was excellent.

angi_reviews.text: I had the pleasure of working with Top-Pro Home Builders for my bathroom renovation six months ago, and the experience was fantastic. Having had some not-so-great experiences with previous contractors, I was pleasantly surprised by Elon's helpfulness. He efficiently addressed numerous issues in our house without making a fuss. My wife and I were so satisfied that we reached out to them again two months ago to remodel our kitchen. The project was completed just a week ago, and I must say, it has exceeded my wildest dreams. The team guided me through every detail and answered all our questions. Given our previous bad experiences, I wholeheartedly recommend Top-Pro Home Builders to everyone. They truly provide peace of mind!

I had an urgent need to renovate my bathroom, and I was pleasantly surprised when Top-Pro Home Builders responded promptly and delivered an exceptional outcome. Their dedication and commitment to the project were truly remarkable. Throughout the entire process, they kept me well-informed, ensuring that I felt confident and secure in their service. I am immensely grateful for their remarkable work and their patience in dealing with a first-time construction customer like myself. Thank you so much for the outstanding job!

I would like to express my sincere appreciation to Elon and his team for their exceptional responsiveness and assistance. When I reached out to them to inquire about a complete kitchen remodeling project, Elon promptly responded and made time to visit my home the very next day. I was impressed by his professionalism and ability to address all the complexities involved in the project.  Despite the numerous factors that needed to be considered for the new kitchen, Elon and his team tackled each one with great expertise and provided valuable advice along the way. Their guidance was invaluable in making informed decisions throughout the remodeling process.  I am truly grateful for their help and support, and I will definitely keep them in mind for any future remodeling projects at my home. Their level of service and professionalism is commendable, and I highly recommend Elon and his team for any remodeling needs. Thank you once again for your assistance!

We conducted thorough research on various contracting companies for our kitchen remodel, and after meeting with Elon to discuss the project's scope, it became evident that Top Pro Home Builders was the perfect choice. Elon impressed us with his upfront approach, competitive pricing, and responsiveness leading up to the project. Opting for Top Pro Home Builders turned out to be a decision we were grateful for. Elon and his team demonstrated a commitment to excellence and paid meticulous attention to detail in their craftsmanship. They went above and beyond by proactively suggesting the addition of outlets that we hadn't initially planned for, enhancing the functionality of the space. Moreover, the team showed great respect for areas outside the kitchen by implementing barriers and covering our furniture entirely, ensuring a clean working environment. I highly recommend Top Pro Home Builders for any construction projects you have in mind for your home.
Elon and crew provided excellent craftmanship and work on our bathroom remodel. . The city inspectors even commented on how top notch the work was.

Thumbs up to Top-Pro Builders for the exceptional customer service and their quality of work. The remodeling project went as planned and was finished on time. Avi was the main reason why we hired Top-Pro Builders. He came out for a bid and we had a good connection. We lived at the house during the remodeling and Avi was an angel! With his huge help, we felt comfortable. We were in full contact with him and whenever we needed anything, he went out of his way to help.   The entire team at Top-Pro Builders were very helpful and professional from our architect and designer to the crew that performed the work. Their work is beautiful and we can't fault it. 2 months have passed since we finished the remodeling and till now we haven't found any problem with the work that was done. Avi continue to follow up with us to check that everything was ok. We are very happy that we chose to work with Top-Pro Builders.

angi_reviews.text: It went very well considering that the raised foundation created a difficult first take of pouring concrete within 4 foot high moldings....the team of exports knocked this out without a delay in time or schedule. Our family couldn't be happier with the results and extra 500 sq. feet of living space.
unknown

Gary and his team have been a pleasure to work with. There have been a lot of challenges with the city and with the surprises that come with remodeling, but Gary has been great about communicating every step of the way. When not delayed by the city, Gary and the crew have worked quickly and with pride in craft. Gary has explained options on the way to help us save material costs. Though some of the unforeseen variables did increase costs, he was patient and fair in negotiations. He is very responsive and responsible and is committed to completing the job according to agreement and plans. Whenever needed, he personally checks on the work and makes corrections. He also responds to the needs of neighbors inconvenienced by the work, which helps us stay on good terms. One of my favorite aspects to working with the team has been that they even did some little repairs to the house free of charge that were not requested but easy to do and made a big improvement to the overall look.

Gary and his crew built a new garage addition to our house from the ground up.  He then built a new storage shelf extending the width of the garage.  It only took two days for him to complete the second job, and again, we were quite satisfied with the outcome.  I have learned that no construction job is completely free from unforeseen problems, and sometimes one just has to let go of minor imperfections when all is said and done.  With this said, I would highly recommend Gary and his crew.  He is very professional and easy to work with as other customers have stated.  He responds quickly to problems that arise and is on site as much as possible - which cannot be said about many other contractors. Quality work and professionalism are important to me, and that is what I expect when I hire Action Home Remodeling.  I will definitely be contacting Gary again for future projects.

I am extremely pleased and satisfied with Gary’s work on our fireplace remodeling project. He work is neat and very detailed. He takes is time to delivery on time and quality. Thanks to him our fireplace looks not only great but has brought charm to our living room. I will highly recommend Gary to anyone. I know I will be using his services in future.

Action Home was one of three bids I received. From the initial consultation to the final clean-up, this company distinguished itself on the basis of high integrity, top quality workmanship, responsiveness, reliability and creative problem-solving. Gary, the owner, listened to my concerns, answered my questions, and suggested alternatives. Prior to hiring this company, I spoke with three prior customers who reported the same high level of satisfaction as I experienced. I am pleased with the workmanship, the price and the process and am glad to be able to give this company a great recommendation.

Per above, our experience was great.  We would highly recommend Action Home Remodeling & Construction/Gary Frazier and will use him again in the future for our own home remodeling and construction needs.
We are very pleased with Action Home Remodeling?s work. The owner Gary and his crew were so neat, clean and on time.

The job went very well overall. They arrived on schedule every day and caused a minimum of disruption in our home.  I made arrangements for Gary to have independent access and he always secured everything before leaving the site. The job started a week after the proposal was accepted and it was actually completed before the estimated time.  I am planning more work and will make sure to get an estimate from Action Remodeling when the time comes.

They were amazing. The owner, Nathan, explained everything to us. He came everyday to make sure everything was good. He shared his time with us. The experience was excellent and we have told all our friends. All of the aspects were very good. They cleaned up afterwards. The price was good. What they charged was exactly what we guessed it would be.

We have used Gary before and like his professionalism and quality of work.  He shows up when he says he will, responds to phone calls in a timely manner, and does quality work.  He and his crew cleaned up nicely every day.
Gary did a beautiful job. I liked how he spent extra time ensuring the cabinet doors hung correctly.
I am recommending them to all of my family and friends.

Gary always took our calls when we called. When he couldn't he returned our call quickly and came when he said he would. When working his crew covered the floors with cloths and protected the floors and walls as he was worked. He cleaned up as he went. He was very reasonable with his prices. He's a very pleasant and courteous person. We often added additional details to the job such as a back splash in the kitchen, replacing the sink and faucet. He did so without complaint. All in all we are very happy with the service Gary provided.

Overall we had a great experience. The key points are- they finished within the planned schedule (approximately two months), accommodated our last minute changes without hassle (within reason), and were responsive whenever we had concerns.
MY HOUSE WAS IN BAD CONDITION AND HE DID A LOT OF WORK. VERY PROFESSIONAL AND HE HAS A CREW OF MEN, BUT HE COMES And CHECKS ON HIS CREW. I LIKE THAT HE COMES BY TO SUPERVISE HIS WORKERS.

angi_reviews.text: They are the greatest. I do not know anybody can compete with them. They did a better job than others. They were smooth and organize. They do excellent work. Hands down.

My husband and I hired Woodmasters for a full renovation project after interviewing multiple companies, and we are so thrilled we did! Mike was our project manager, and he was incredible. He was extremely knowledgable, very responsive, and really took the time to understand our needs as well as our wants and was able to give us exactly what we wanted and needed. They set us up with crews that were professional, clean, prompt, and exceeded our expectations. Mike made sure the crews maintained the timeline, which was very important to us, and walked us through each step. Woodmasters helped us achieve our dream home, and we are incredibly happy with the results. We highly recommend working with them!

First, it all started with shopping for a contractor to remodel our 1980 house in today's modern style. I called several contractors to do a free estimate. Some were late, and some were absent. But the team from Woodmaster showed up promptly. His office even called to confirm our appointment the day before. I really appreciate that! We are happy with the price for completing everything much earlier than the anticipated project completion date. The team was very responsive and prompt in reply to my calls/texts, which is very important to me because having misunderstandings or miscommunication about house projects can bring more problems=more cost. Overall, I highly recommend hiring Woodmaster if you need to get anything done at your house. You can expect good service and great results!
