angi_reviews.text: I resubmitted my review today, 7/8.

I called Woodmaster Kitchen & Bath after my friend told me about the great job they did with her kitchen last year. I wanted to replace my kitchen cabinets since they were already too old and I wanted a fresh new look. The contractor met with me and gave me an alternative to replacing them, since they were still in very good condition. I ended up refacing the cabinets, costing me 3 times less than it would if I were to replace them.

My kitchen is now beautiful, and their work was 100% on spot.

Every thing went great.
They are very professional. They came on time did a great job and finished as promised.
They are on Angie's List. Overall, they are excellent. I would use them again in the future.

The men arrived Tuesday morning at exactl 8:30 as promised. They walked through the home with me to understand the expectations and desired work. They worked hard for 3 days and did an excellent job. The men were knowledgeable, kind, punctual and very friendly. Their project manager checked in each morning and afternoon as well. They made suggestions that improved the project and were willing to do "extras" if they felt they could accomplish the task in the allotted time. I trusted them completely and even left the home several times to run errands. They prefer cash so be prepared. That is the only "drawback" if you consider it to be so. All in all great work for a great price. Would definitely recommend them and would hire them again in the future.

I re-hired Woodmaster (previously Noy Cabinets) for the second time, (first time in 2004) and their good work made my home value increase dramatically. I was able to rent out the home for a significantly higher amount since the remodeling.
We are still very happy with their job (after so many years the house is still in great shape) and appreciate their frequent follow-up calls and emails. As a person who remodeled over 15 homes in my life, I couldn't recommend a better company to work with than Woodmaster.

Seriously love these guys in a city full of coyotes! Oh and our roof is done!

We recently upgraded all of our windows and replaced all of our carpeted floors with tile and had our electrical panel replaced. We hired classic remodeling to do the work. They did a great job and met all of our requirements and needs. We were asked if we would write them a review if we were pleased with there work and we are happy to do so. We know our projects were not big ones but we never felt anything but appreciated and their work is very good. We will happily recommend them to anyone and are pleased to offer this review.

Excellent Service and work. Classic Remodeling came out to do a gut renovation of our home. I think they handled everything really well including the architecture. They really helped me organize it all. They were also kind and courteous. We really enjoyed working with them, and we really liked our project manager, we found that working with them was easy and targeted. I love how our kitchen and bathroom turned out, and I would recommend them. This was our first time using them. If we had to, we would use them again in the future.

We are so pleased with our recent bathroom remodel. It was over the top – from the scheduling to the completed bathroom. We would like to thank The Classic Remodeling team for the beautiful job. We would definitely recommend them.

These dedicated professionals (Classic Remodeling) consistently provide outstanding service. It is obvious they have personal interests in helping their customers succeed. They repeatedly provide me with valuable advice, feedback, and over-the-top support that far exceeds my expectations. Thank you.

We hired Classic remodelers to paint the exterior of our house and install all new flooring. We also replaced a few of our smaller windows for bigger ones and the transformation is unreal. Its crazy what a little change can do for a face lift. They were reasonable, did stay on budget and kept the area clean during the week they were here. I know its not a big job but it was for us and they gave us all the courtesy and attention as if it was. Thank you Classic for being a part of the Sanchez Family spring clean up!

We hired them from a friend who made our connection who loves this site. Had all new windows installed, some new tile floors and new carpet flooring. No complaints they are a good company and presented great value for my money. Ill pass on the recommendations here and wish you all best of luck if your remodeling. Best make sure you hire a good company as it surely makes all the difference.

Had our interior painted in our home and a new electric panel added. New trim around the doors and a small room recarpeted. They did a great job and left our house picked up. They were prepared and worked hard. Our home has a fresh new look and what a difference going with a trusted contracting company. You can leave the worries at the door. will turn to them again in the future when we are able to do some more remodeling on our home. 2 thumbs up!

angi_reviews.text: The remodel went very well. They were responsive, kept to their schedule and the finished product looks great. When issues arose, they worked with us and were committed to getting us what we wanted. The job did run a little over budget because they demo'd out a set of cabinets in a connecting laundry room that we ultimately wouldn't have replaced. They were very open to how to make it right, and ultimately we found a balanced solution that was fair to everybody. We didn't have a lot of change orders, but what we did ask about was quoted at a rate that seemed a little high to me, so if you think you may do any extras, be sure to get that quoted up-front. Additionally, while the finished product  ultimately ended up looking great, you will have to be vigilant to be sure there aren't any cut corners on the finishing work. There were a few times that things needed to be redone, but they did that with no complaints and an obvious desire to see the customer made happy.
Lots of re-dos, but without complaints.

angi_reviews.text: Accounting needs help.

Rick was fantastic.  This was the second job he's done for us and despite it being on the smaller side, he made sure it was done right and well.  He matched the stain of the wood really really well and was able to have his team knock it out in one day.
unknown

The project consisted of a structural renovation of a four stories, four bedrooms and three bathrooms single family house in Beverly Hills. Overall the project took seven months. The end result went way beyond expectations. State of the art finishes, and quality of the work. There are no words to describe how thankful I am to Rick Valdez (general contractor of Azteca 111 Builders Inc.). He made a superb work despite all the difficulties of the project. Throughout the entire project he demonstrated outstanding design and problem-solving skills. What I was not expecting when I hired Azteca was actually to establish such a trustworthy relationship with Rick, I feel a deep sense of gratitude towards Rick, Lucia and the crew. Matteo
unknown

We've used Azteca before for big and small projects. Rick and Lucia and the guys in their crew are all wonderful--punctual, professional, upfront, clear and very knowledgeable. We will definitely use them again.

Rick and his team were always a pleasure to work with, were punctual, and super fair. They gave us line item estimates for every detail, which made things a lot easier when we inevitably decided we wanted to do specific things slightly differently. We found a lot of unexpected rot in the dining room along with uncovering a clear previous fire that had burned some of the columns and beams such that they needed to be replaced. That put us over the initial estimate, but Rick and Azteca ultimately took a loss on it because the initial estimate for that additional work order didn't include everything that ultimately needed to be done (i.e. they were extremely fair).
Overall, you won't find a better or fairer contractor. Can't go wrong.

It went great. Rick and Lucia were both helpful and very sweet. They gave me a quick estimate and got to work right away. They removed all the debris from our very large back yard and even went out of their way to donate a large cactus plant to a nursery instead of just throwing it out. Rick also taught me to irrigate the front yard. I look forward to working with them again soon and would highly recommend them.

Concrete decks were replaced on 13 balconies, with reinforcement of the structure. Planter boxes and railings were fabricated in redwood to get them termite-resistant. New balconies were stained. The work was a bit slow, but was done very professionally. Our questions and requests were properly addressed by the contractor.

I've been doing business with Rick at Azteca 111 for over 10 years. I needed glass shower doors for our work place gym shower and Rick provided the service. Over the years of doing different projects with Rick he has never let me down on providing what he commits to doing. His crew is professional and always clean up after themselves. I've done big projects and small one's. Ricks commitment to his work ethic and professionalism will always bring me back to using his services.

I am so happy with my new AC/HEAT system. The guys came in and did a clean job removing debris and materials ....these guys are super clean and don't leave a mess at the end of each work day. The unit is awesome; spent my first summer with a cool house! Thanks Rick for the service you provide.

Awesome job!! Rick does a great job from start to finish. We had a bad old roof that Rick repaired and added a new roof to the entire house. We are waterproof safe and dry thanks to Azteca111 for their great service.

Rick was successful and very professional in completing the project. His experience in the field helped him identify some major problems with the plumbing that could have cost me more in the long run. I enjoy working with Rick and have come to trust his advice.
I was very pleased with Rick's recomendations on an iron gate. it was very nice simple and will last us a very long time.

The end project was AMAZING!!  All offices turned out great with the window design. It was a very smooth transition from start to finish.
I hope to include picture SOON!! Rick and his crew are by far the best at what they do. I will continue to use their services for our office needs.

These guys are awesome. We had our custom lattice-work fence (facing street) blown down in the December windstorm. We wanted to replace as original, but were on a tight insurance budget. Rick found what we thought was pre-fab fencing that was very close, but upon receipt of the material (Home Depot) it was clearly substandard. Rick had photographed the original fence work, and reworked the pre-fab to match tthe original...can't tell the difference between this new fence and the other original fence on the property. Cudos Rick and team!

The remodel is currently in progress; I anticipate that it will be completed by mid-November 2011. Azteca 111 Builders has been fantastic throughout the remodel. They have a solid team, which is headed up by Rick and Lucia Valdez. They have been steadily completing the work, while keeping me regularly informed with updates regarding the progress of the townhouse. Rick has impeccable taste, vision, and craftsmanship. So far, my townhouse is shaping up to be the home of my dreams. Call me one very happy client!

My old water heater finally gave up last Wednesday night. I had to find a way to replace it quickly. I called Home Depot and scheduled an estimate. I found that with all the work they said they had to do and the heater, the bill was over $2000.00. This seemed outrageous to me. I called Rick to see if there was a possibility that one of his plumbers could do the job. Rick and the plumber arrived at my home around 5PM. They discussed the job and while Rick picked up the new water heater, his plumber took the old one out. Rick returned with the heater and they quickly completed the job including a good clean up of the room. I was very pleased with the speed in which they could complete the job along with saving me quite a bit of money in the process. The heater works great and I am a happy person
app
They are a very responsive company. The quality of their work was good, and Rick made sure we were satisfied with the end results.

From my initial phone call to completion of the job, they made the process easy through their professionalism and responsiveness.  I received calls back when expected, the detail of their bid was thorough and the work was completed well, and looks good.  I would choose to use them again, particularly because I felt I could trust them and their judgement.
The process was pretty straight forward.  They responded to my call and got me a bid in a reasonable amount of time.  THey were very professional and nice people, they seemed knowledgeable.

0000Don Giladi and his team at Overland Builders have done amazing work completely remodeling my back yard.  His integrity, professionalism, attention to detail, creativity in design, problem solving and the ability to really listen and understand my vision, are some of the qualities that were so refreshing to find in a contractor! He completed the work that was promised (with many changes and additions on my part) in a timely fashion and got it right the first time.   He was very hands-on; personally accompanying me to the nursery to pick out plants and also accompanying me to purchase the water feature. His crew was friendly, respectful and went above and beyond in keeping the work area neat and clean when leaving each night. Absolutely first class from start to finish and the final results completely exceeded my original expectations!  You will not be disappointed by choosing Overland Builders for your remodeling needs.

I can't say enough great things about Overland Builders!  We remodeled a guest bathroom, a complete gut with plumbing and electric being moved, and from start to finish it was a joy to work with them!  On time and On Budget - how many people can really say that is their experience?!  The sub-contractors arrived always on-time, and they were CLEAN!!  Their craftsmanship was top-of-the-line and bathroom turned out beautifully!  I would not use any other company to do future projects in my home! I have previously remodeled a kitchen, and also built a house from the ground up - so I have experience working with contractors!  I wish I would have known about Overland earlier. A big plus - they are trustworthy!!  (I had no second thoughts about leaving them in my home alone).  So if you want a job done RIGHT - use OVERLAND BUILDERS!!!

angi_reviews.text: It was difficult to start the work once we got a quote, because Mr. Martinez was battling a cold and there was a job before ours that took longer than he expected.  Once he finally arrived, however, things were smooth sailing.  He did beautiful work and repaired the area in our living room/dining room, where we took out an old floor furnace and the previous owners took out a small bookcase.  Mr. Martinez found the same wood and size as our oak floor planks, and then made it look as if the repaired planks were a part of the original floor.  The results were magical.  The floors look incredible, and Mr. Martinez was very professional and did not have to be supervised.  He said it would take 3 days, and it ended up taking 4 because he was still recovering from the cold.  But I would not hesitate to recommend him - he does great work, very reasonable prices, and is worth the wait.

I think is work was excellent, there only small details that we wish we had brought to his attention at the time for him to correct, but I think speaking to him works.  He his a good listener and responds well.

Everything you've read about Martinez is true.  He does impeccable work for a good price.  He's very personable and easy to work with, as long as you can get over the language barrier.  The floors were in pretty terrible shape and now they look like new.  He came out on Monday and the job finished the following Monday, with a thorough sanding, 2 coats of stain and a coat of high-gloss on top.  My only warning is if you're super picky about what you want or you want work to happen on a tight schedule, make sure you have a bilingual friend on hand who can interpret exactly what you want.  If you're a little more open about things, you'll have no problems even if you don't speak Spanish.    Overall, it couldn't have gone better.  Martinez does great work and I'll recommend him to anyone who needs this sort of work done.
On budget, on time, no surprises.  Very courteous and pleasant.

After reading several good reviews on Mr. Martinez, I called him to give me a quote to refinish the hardwood floors on a home I recently purchased. I had removed the carpet myself, but there were nails and wood strips with carpet tacks that still needed to br removed. The floor was dirty but he told it was in good shape and did not need wood replaced. He measured the floors and told me he would charge $1680 to remove the nails, sand, and then lay down one coat of stain and a few coats of polyurethane. This quote was to do living room, dining room, a hallway and 2 bedrooms. All in all, about 1,200 square feet or so. After sanding, he told me to select a stain color from his samples, and he laid it down in a test area. I did not like the original color, so we changed it. He started and completed the job on schedule. The whole job took about 3-4 days to complete. Overall he did a great job and there were no surprises. I would recommend him to others.

I did not even think we needed to get the hardwood floors refinished in our house until I saw the end results. I thought they looked OK when we bought the  house but they now look like completely brand new floors.  The floors look beautiful, we get compliments on them from everyone that comes to the house. Martinez came on time, gave me the best price, finished when he said he would and I could not be happier.  The area where he had to repair them and replace boards looks and matches perfect - even I can't remember where the damage started exactly. Great job!!!

Martinez made an appointment for an estimate on a Sunday. He was right on time. He gave me a price to remove my old flooring, repair some of the sub floor and install the new oak flooring which was supplied by me. He said it would take 2 1/2 days to complete and he could start on Wednesday. He arrived on time everyday and completed the job as promised. He and his helper were very polite and did an excellent job. I am pleased with the outcome and would use Martinez again.

Wanted Pastor Martinez to redo the flooring before moving in. He had 2 other people to help and did a great job.  He estimated that it would done in 4 days and they completed the job on time.  I spoke some spanish and it was very helpful.  My husband though spoke no spanish and there was a serious language barrier (Even if Martinez appears to understand, make sure and verify that he really does understand )  Overall though, the floors look amazing and for way less than what others had quoted us.

Mr. Martinez did a great job. He was quick to come out for an estimate, and very friendly and cooperative when we had a miscommunication as to the first appointment time. He explained what needed to be done and what my options were for the finish.They were prompt, and removed the carpets (and at the end hauled away the refuse), sanded and then applied two coats of varnish to the living and dining room, hallway and two bedrooms. He was understanding of some difficulties in being able to clear away the furniture and objects from one of the rooms, and worked around this obstacle with a problem. The floors look outstanding, and we were quite pleased.

Martinez knows hardwood floors.  The work that he and his worker subs did turned out beautifully.  He was knowledgeable about which stains would lift, made color suggestions and was always affable on-site.  The language barrier is a real problem, even larger than I anticipated from the other reviews and our initial estimate visit with Martinez.    Ours was a complicated job, demanding the install work and refinish work be divided into two chunks, working around an excellent contractor, tile man and painter.  We had to repeatedly ask Martinez to make sure to follow through on several details: please remove trash, don't forget to execute one door threshold upstairs.   Overall, the great floor work, which was very competitively priced, speaks for itself.
Did a really great job.  Damage was more extensive than was apparent with old carpeting in place, he gave fair price to repair all unknown damages and complete the job.
Called him.  He gave the best estimate.  He started right away.  He and his partner were always prompt.  They had to tear out carpet and move a lot of furniture around, but they did a beautiful job.

Mr. Martinez was very prompt in coming over to give an estimate, and then completed the work on the next day.  He also gave me a discount on flooring materials because he already had some in stock.  The sub-floor was uneven and he did a great job of leveling it out before installing the new hardwood.

Martinez did a great job. The floors hadn't been done in about 30 years and he made them look fantastic-like new. He is very conscientious, professional and knowledgeable. I originally chose a stain color that turned out to be not as dark as I wanted-Martinez got a new stain and fixed the issue with no problem and no extra charge. He is a nice guy who clearly knows what he is doing and takes pride in his work. I highly recommend him.
He did a great job at a really good price.

Ori and Shay of Eco Design Pro are consummate professionals. They appreciate the dynamics of any major home renovation work by being patient with the client and providing exceptional service. Their attention to details and daily communications helped ease the anxiety and stress of a three month kitchen renovation project. angi_reviews.text: He told us that the previous contractor had not installed support beams as needed for this project (The previous contractor was unlicensed.. The EDP employees did an amazing job of getting the new spring ladder framed properly and installed very securely. The end result is also now very aesthetically pleasing!! They also cleaned up when their work was done. I was extremely satisfied with their work and cleanup.
It looks excellent! I'm very pleased as now my backyard is a useable - and great looking - outdoor space.

Ori and Shay helped plan and decide that pavers were the best way to go. And it looks fantastic! Now I have a great outdoor living space which includes pavers, lights, planting beds with crushed rock and a drip irrigation system. They oversaw all aspects of the job; carting out the two truckloads of dirt and old concrete, putting in the gravel underlayment, then laying the sand and pavers. Even when little problems came up - like with the location of new valves for the drip system - they were able to overcome them quickly and within budget. I'm very happy.

After interviewing countless flaky contractors, I finally found Ori at Eco Design Pro. They're fantastic. Fast, organized, imaginative, and - above all - professional. It was so nice to have a contractor that showed up, that clearly explained the work and offered suggestions, and that put the payments steps in writing on paper. I'm glad to have found them and will use them again and again in the future.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you [Member Name Removed].  It was our pleasure working with you.  Ori & Shay.  Eco design pro.

angi_reviews.text: We had our kitchen reconstruct completely and remodeled by Ori Sakal from ECO design pro and it looks so nice and functional. Ori installed us high quality of kitchen cabinets with all the perfect finishing touches, Ori was able to handle all aspects of the remodeling (such as Color combinations, plumbing fixtures, backsplash, granite, outlets, lighting, appliance selection, etc.) with a knowledgeable and thorough staff.   We were able to find a very nice hood for over the range but it was too large for our kitchen.  Ori was able to reconstruct the kitchen and walls and to fit it to the kitchen. That's what you get with ECO design pro and Ori Sakal, a guy who knows good kitchen design, and he cares so much about his customer's throughout the project, making sure to work each day and to check that the work is in perfect condition (and no less) and provides a quality final product and mainly give and excellent customer service. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend ECO design pro.

We first used ECO design pro in 2011 and this time we didn’t think twice about who we would hire to design and complete the landscape of our new home. Ori Sakal has a keen eye for details and an innate ability to visualize and design a project; he helped us design our landscape by providing ideas and recommendations to make the entire project flow together and suggested unique details which make our project stand out from the rest. Ori’s demeanor is soft and gentile and easy to work with. If we weren’t sure about something during the construction, he was flexible in making changes to ensure our satisfaction. ECO design pro is a reputable company and hires employees and/or subcontractors that are responsible and conscientious. I highly recommend them.

After having gone through the stressful ordeal of seeking retribution for damages caused by other contractors, I feel compelled to give credit where it's deserved. My husband and I have now dealt with 4 different contractors on various house projects, and only 2 of them produced work that didn't need to be 'fixed' afterwards. One of those contractors was Ori Sakal from ECO design - fast, excellent work and very professional the entire way through. Ori came in a little bit above cost, so we originally didn't go with him. However, we ended up regretting that decision when the contractor we chose turned out to be completely incompetent at leveling our foundation and floors. Lesson learned - you get what you pay for. And even then, sometimes you don't! But with ECO design pro, you absolutely do. These are the types of contractors we want in business.

We had a fantastic experience with Ori and his crew of workers. I wanted to paint my house but I didn’t have an idea of what colors to use. Ori with his knowledge, he was able to provide me with some color samples of how he would paint the house and my selection was pretty easy after I saw them. At the end, his selection of colors came out great. His crew were very polite and professional. Ori even did some extras tasks for me like change out the a/c filter and generally looked around and gave me opinions about house projects that might need to be done. I thought his price was very reasonable as well. Definitely recommend for renovate paint and/or design!

Ori came over to check our pool. We contact him after we had some leaks at the pool and we were losing water. Ori did a complete check and he was able to give us a great price for the repair. After we approved the work, He gave us a date for starting the work and he came over with his guys, providing them with the correct information about what they need to do. The workers (2 in total) employees the pool and did all the patching. After that, they did the new prime and then, they painted the pool with a paint that we selected from the selection that Ori provided us with. Ori is a professional, polite and happy person to work with. He is a hard worker and we are happy to have him fix the pool.

Ori just finished remodeling our master bathroom and bedroom. We needed a complete remodel of our master bath and in the same time, we wanted to replace the carpet in the bedroom and to replace the closet with a new one that can function better for us. In the bathroom we needed the old shower and tub removed and to install a huge shower in its place.  From our meeting with Ori, through the design of the room, through the construction, we couldn't be MORE PLEASED AND HAPPY! We trusted everyone associated with this company. We recommend them 100%. The other company we requested a quote from was very unprofessional.

The Best Decision I ever made was to use ECO design PRO. From the initial meeting with Ori till the end of the job I couldn't have asked for anything more. The old bathroom that we had was too old and it was time to bring it to life? We came across Ori from his previous client that we know and we loved the work that he did. The bathroom that we remodeled included new Bath tub and shower, new tiles on the walls and floor, New double sink vanity and of course the new paint. Ori brought 2 teams of workers that each one of them did a different task and he supervised them on a daily basis. The workers made sure to clean up every day and worked on our project from beginning to end to finish exactly when Ori said he will. I was amazed how beautiful everything turned out.  It was perfect!

angi_reviews.text: YS Remodeling & Design did a great job on my backyard remodel and I can't say enough positive things about this company. The staff was great, always on time, professional, friendly but also quick and efficient. I love my new remodeled backyard! Thank you!

I received 6 quotes on my two bathrooms remodel and YS Remodeling gave me the best quality-price ratio. Yoel and his team shoved up on time and worked hard from first day to end of the project. It was true pleasure to work with this people, they made everything to went smooth and there were no any issues or unexpected costs. Yoel helped me with his great suggestions and he carefully listened what I wanted to do. The outcome is excellent, my new bathrooms are top notch!!

I had my home fully renovated by Y.S Remodeling & Design. I hired this contractor based on my friends recommendation, they did excellent job for him so I decided to call them. We agreed about terms of work and soon after we signed a contract Yoel and his team started to work on the project. Yoel was very honest, he did everything as he said at the start. He was also professional, friendly and always available to answer any question. His team was fantastic, worked hard every day and kept my home clean as possible. The most important, I am completely satisfied with the final product! Excellent job! I highly recommend this company!!

My kitchen looks fantastic thanks to Yoel and Y.S Remodeling. I recently hired them to remodel my kitchen and it wasn't wrong decision, actually it was great decision. Yoel helped me a lot with his valuable ideas and advices. He really cares about customer satisfaction. I am also very pleased with final price, it was very affordable although they used a high quality materials. In short, this company is phenomenal and I will definitely work with them on some future projects at my home.

I needed to remodel my backyard and my neighbor recommended me YS Remodeling & Design, he told me that they are true experts in that area. Yoel gave me estimate and it was very affordable for this type of project so I hired them. I'm so satisfied with everything they did, my backyard is awesome! Highly recommended company!

My experience with YS Remodeling was great! Yoel and his crew recently remodeled my backyard and from start to finish it was a true pleasure to work with them. They were always on time, clean, polite and professional. Yoel was communicative, helpful and honest, he carefully listened what I wanted to do and with his team did even better job than I expected. The final price was acceptable, realistic and my new backyard is beautiful! Highest recommendation on Yoel and his team!

I received 4 quotes on my kitchen remodel and my decision was to go with YS Remodeling & Design, they gave us great offer and I heard great things about this contractor. Yoel and his team shoved up soon after we signed a contract. They were professional, honest, helpful and respectful to my home. Yoel was there for any help but project went very smooth and without issues. I am more than a satisfied how my kitchen turned out and it was finished within scheduled date. I couldn't ask for more! Excellent service! Highly recommend YS Remodeling & Design!

Highly recommended contractor.

angi_reviews.text: Cant say enough! The project was done in one month flat. They knocked down the main walls and created a beautiful open kitchen. He has a system that is efficient and gets all the dirty work executed, straight away. This of course, required new floors, base boards, etc. Basically a new house! I always felt like I was in a partnership with Yoel, as we worked along the way. He was very adaptive to my desired design and nuances within the project. We came up with a realistic budget and stayed very close to it. He also has a good eye for design and decor, which helped me. Most importantly, he works in a very ethical manner, that made me feel comfortable. We are now enjoying our “new home” for the summer!

Yoel and his team did a great job adding pavers and river rock to my yard at a fair price. The work was efficient and the team did a great job cleaning up after themselves when they were finished. When he came out to review the work, I pointed out an issue and he took responsibility and resolved it instead of coming up with an excuse and dodging ownership. That's a rare quality with contractors and as a result, he's earned my trust. Would highly recommend working with him again if ever the need arises.

As good as one could expect but better than hoped, because of Yoel his and commitment to efficiency, excellence with expertise. I received estimates from five landscapers/remodelers, so due diligence was realized. Y&S was the first - I could’ve stopped there. I’m saving you the time - you can’t find better product and service, than Y&S - period! Call Yoel for a first class experience!

They used hand powersanders to cover almost every inch to even out cracks and layers of old paint. It was no easy job. In some spots it is three levels.....up and down ladders; and it just happened to be very hot weather. After completing Thomas asked me to write a list of things that might need touch up. Again, I was impressed. As we walked around the house/decks/gazebo together he spotted some small things that I did not see. That is to say, he is very honest and trustworthy. angi_reviews.text: Foothill just finished painting the front of our bldg. and we are totally happy with their workmanship and professionalism. They did a great job.
Work was done on time. It was well done. It was done for the quoted price. The company personnel were very professional.

Foothill Painting was our first choice for many reasons. Everyone was really nice and nice to work with. Their promptness, attention to detail and willingness to try and fix things to the best of their ability made us glad we chose them. They were able to complete the job in a timely manner and after we did the walk through, fixed the additional parts well. The paint job looks great, and we are pleased with the results.

The painting done looks gorgeous and on can tell that the painting was professionally done. The final contract that was drawn up for me to sign had great detail and was accurate. The production manager included some extra things as painting the retaining wall in the back yard. The painters spoke courteously to me and my wife. The foreman spoke perfect English. One of the painters helped my wife go down the driveway with her walker down to her car that was parked on the street. The painters showed up on time and didn't make a lot of noise like loud talking or playing the radio loud during their lunch breaks. I was especially pleased with the workmanship. They put two coats of paint plus primer on all surfaces, and I am sure that the paint will look good beyond the five year warranty period. The company seemed to have a lot of integrity and will take care of anything that was inadvertently missed. They left at least half a can of paint of each color and some stucco for future touch up.

What I liked in addition to their workmanship, which was outstanding is that they had an office I could go to instead of communication on the phone or waiting on someone to get to my home.  I liked that all expenses, materials, everything regarding the work was written down in a contract and thoroughly and explained to me, there were no surprises with any additional costs, etc.  They were very thorough when prepping for the job in that they did all repairs and touch ups prior to beginnig.  They used high quality materials when replacing the Fascia boards.  The amount of time they stated it would take to complete the work was 8 days and they were spot on.  They came everyday and worked a full day.

As always,  on this particular job,  they were terrific .We never bother to get competing bids  knowing they do such an excellent job. The painters are always on time and always  stay on the job until completion.  They are meticulously clean (never leave a mess) . Their workmanship could not be better. There is no hesitancy on our part to recommend this company.

angi_reviews.business_response_text: Foothill Painting Company welcomes customer comments, good or bad (we prefer good, of course) We strive to give our customers quality service. Unfortunately, things don't always work out. Sometimes customers have unrealistic expectations that we simply can't satisfy. We performed our best services for this customer, and when their problem resurfaced, we returned to attempt to fix it. We subsequently discovered that the problem stemmed from a source unrelated to our original work. We advised the customer of the work needed to fix the problem, but they refused. Because the customer was not satisfied and was unwilling to address the real cause of the problem, we promptly issued a full refund. We realize that one bad review can overshadow thirty good ones. We invite you to contact us for an estimate and let us demonstrate our commitment to excellent service. "We want to be your painter for life."

angi_reviews.text: We are happy with the whole process of initiating the project, arranging the service and the service itself. Very fast response from the office clerk and the owner. The two year warranty provided by the company gave us a piece of mind. The job was done in less than the week. If the nice painting sustains over the years to come as promised by the owner, we could certainly hire them back for other painting and roof needs.

Couldn't have gone better. I was under a time crunch because my tenant moved out and I didn't want to let the house sit a whole month without income. I urgently read AL reviews and called 5 companies.
Don, the owner I think, of Foothill came out himself at a time that worked for me. He immediately impressed me with his insight, friendliness and his suggestions of how to keep costs low while not skimping on quality. He worked with me on price and I gladly gave him the job. Couldn't be happier, I was on the road for work when the work got done and thankfully it went off without a hitch; no calls, no extra charges, no delays. The place was sparkling and beautiful for our new tenants upon move-in.
Foothill has a customer for life.

I hired Foothill Painting after getting quotes from 2 other companies for my reflective roof coating project.? I do not have insulation for my East L.A. home, and despite having a forced air conditioning system, I could never get the thermostat below 85 degrees on hot days.? Foothill just finished the roof coating, and the inside temperature now is at least 10 degrees cooler.? The staff is super helpful, friendly and no pressure, I was assisted by the owner Don, his daughter Raquel and A.J. was my tech.? Best home improvement project I ever did.

Everything about our experience was great and our house looks beautiful!  The estimate was very reasonable, and included a discount for Angie's List members.  The company accommodated our request for an earlier start date, and finished the job a day earlier than expected.  The crew did a great job keeping the site tidy at the end of each day, and cleaning up at the end.   We added two extra items to our original estimate, which were both cheerfully made at a fair price. Everyone at the company was friendly and helpful!  We would definitely use them again and will recommend them to friends.
They did a great job. They did what we expected and I guess they were taunted.

This company is very willing to correct anything and basically did a good job. My house was built in 1927. They explained, after they started painting and when I realized they weren't doing any sanding preparation, that they couldn't sand because the paint probably contained lead. I accepted this explanation but had they told me prior to starting, I would have sanded the areas myself. Some time after, I found out that there is a simple test for lead. I appreciate the fact that this is a green company, but an explanation about the sanding should have been given at the time of contract. I respect green concerns and use no pesticides or other toxic chemicals

They were very professional and friendly. They were on time and got the job done quickly, even though it was one of the hottest weeks of the year! They were there to help us choose our colors. We love the new look! We appreciated that they use their own employees and didn't hire day laborers. We received a free, detailed estimated before we began and when we asked to add a couple of things during the job, we were given a written change order for approval. There were no surprises at the end of the job. The cost that we were told, was what we ended up paying at the end. Don was wonderful and the office support staff was always available if we had any questions!

The service went well.  They tore off the rain gutters and fixed some other things.  They did a good job prepping.  The owner came out and was friendly and courteous.  He explained things well.  It took two and a half days to paint.  They do good work. They are fairly quick and good to work with.

They are very nice people. They cleaned up everyday before they left. They made sure there was no trash left outside. They were very responsive and happy to do what I asked. They are reasonably priced.
They did an excellent job.  The homeowners were very satisfied with their work.  They came on time, worked all day and then cleaned up each night.  The quality of their work was great!!

They did a great job.  They are a local company and know the area.  They came within 2 days of calling them to get an estimate.  They had no problems with me buying the paint.  They worked with me.  They were immaculate on the clean up every night.  They were here every morning at 7:00 and worked all day long.  They are my favorite company that I've used from Angie's List.  They were a little higher but I felt more comfortable with them.  They gave me a discount since I saw them on Angie's List.  I would definitely use them again.

Everyone was just great, words can not express how special everyone made me feel. Starting with Stella and mike who took me by the hand and put me on a pedestal making me feel like very confident with the company I chose to Jose and the crew who were very patient and courteous, arriving early in the morning and working very hard every day to get the job done. They did not rest for a second and on a daily basis you can see obvious progress and results. I love the wonderful bathroom they have built for me it has everything that I ever wanted and dreamed of, the colors and tiles used are just so relaxing to me with a jacuzzi tub and shower for two. I just can't wait to get back home from work to my private little spa retreat. These guys mean business and I admire their enthusiasm about the project on such a personal level. Thank you guys so much for everything you have done .... Mike, Stella , Jose you guys are the best!!!!

angi_reviews.text:
When we decided to expand our kitchen by bumping out a portion of the back wall of our 2 story home, we interviewed several contractors, including Mike with United Builders  (Your Favorite Contractor).

Mike brought a wealth of construction and design experience that helped us to quickly work out our design. He was personable and professional with a focus on customer service.

Although construction is still in progress, the work has proceeded at a good pace. Nir, who is in charge of our job, stays on top of any issues and is very responsive.

The workers arrive early, work hard all day and do an excellent job. Nir is experienced and helpful with site/design issues. He and his team are genuinely concerned with customer satisfaction.

We are happy with our choice of contractors and recommend them.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: [member's name removed], your place came out amazing and it was great working with you. Hope to see you again soon.

angi_reviews.text: After receiving  home improvement magazine in the mail, my husband and I decided that it was time we had our bathroom remodeled. We had called a few companies and one of them just happened to be "your Favorite  Contractor", with a name like that how could you not want to call. We called them up to set up an appointment and had a time set for a design consultation. We met with Mike the head designer and let me tell you, I was delighted by the ideas and suggestion he had come up with, as opposed to others he listened to what we wanted and just tweaked the design to make it more user friendly, even the price was appealing. we then set a date to start and two weeks later we had a completed new bathroom that we just love. Thank you Mike for all our hard work you deserve an A+

I AM A WOMAN OF FEW WORDS SO WITH MY EXPERIENCE ALL I WILL SAY IS IT WAS PLEASANT AND PROFESSIONAL
AND I WILL USE AND RECOMMEND THEM AGAIN.

I'm so Happy to say everything went nice and smooth and I was very pleased with the design and price. However I had to see another contractor to compare and I ended up choosing Mike with Your Favorite Contractor. Everything turned out great!!!! I am actually sitting in my new kitchen writing this review. Thanks so much Mike!!! :-)

Your favorite contractor was very nice, Itay was our contract manager and he was very helpful. He helped us in giving us feedback on the design and was very nice in helping us with any follow-ups. We are very satisfied with the service and will recommend them to anyone.

Got a flyer in the mailer just a few days before I had a slab leak.
I called your favorite contractor up (with a name like that you can't go wrong) and within 4 hours a nice young man called Etai came by and inspected the problem and on the spot was able to walk me through the remedy and gave me a great deal of repiping my house with new copper including patching and touch up paint where needed as well as repair of the floor.
He also threw in a new tankless water heater.
All the work from start to finish took about 5 days including inspection so I must say I am very pleased
Thank you Etai, I now know where to go again if ever in trouble

We are still in the process but up until now we are very happy with Itay and his crew. They have been completely professional every day, doing good work, passing inspections on the first go, etc. Other contractors bid on the job at a lower price, but I believe that you get what you pay for. At the first meeting Itay prepared a 3D mockup of the addition within 10 minutes, and was able to connect with us on what we wanted and put it into action. This kind of service from a contractor is invaluable. Anyone who can snag them would be equally as pleased. Once we are finished with construction, I will add more photos.

LOVE LOVE LOVE Mikey, and the whole YFC builders crew. Usually I do not leave reviews, but this team deserves it two fold. I wanted to thank Mikey for my new bathroom, it has everything I could possibly want and more. It is very calming and has a spa like feeling as my little get away after a long day at work. Mikey you are one of the most talented people I have met in my life, you helped me design and execute my bathroom remodel, with such ease and pleasure. Get ready my kitchen is next!
I would recommend Mikey to remodel any ones house. He truly has a golden touch!

This is the second time we've used Your Facorite Contractor. First time they remodeled our kitchen and family room and now Mikey and the team painted our entire house inside and out - 3200 sq. feet/two story. They also patched cracks where needed and the entire house looks brand new, we couldn't be happier. We also did more extensive work like replacing all interior doors, all brand new fixtures and fixed all the old electrical. Lastly, we completely remodeled another fireplace we had (they redid the first one in our family room) and now it looks beautiful. Lastly, they fixed a couple minor plumbing issues. I defintley recommend these guys, top quality craftsmanship, workers showed up on time and the work was done ahead of schedule!!

Neil was very patient considering the job he is up against! He took my families problem into his hands and treated it as if it was his own! Extremely prideful in his work and with his word. We had A LOT of questions, even questions off topic with other issues in the house. He stayed way passed his time promised and made sure to answer any questions we had as well as call people for us to fix previous issues. He was referred to us by a Family member who has had work done by his company and has nothing but great things to say about him! To top it off he treated my dad and I to Coffee and pastries at Starbucks to relieve a little stress he sensed in us!
Neil was fantastic . Always punctual, helpful, and did top notch work!

He was excellent. He was really really good, very professional.

James is a great guy.  He was professional, friendly, courteous and was very patient as we kept finding wood that needed replacing.  He milled the siding, replace 2x4's, removed electrical box, light switches etc.  He works very efficiently as he is paid by the hour, which worried me a little, but we are so pleased with the quality of work, the type of wood he used and his work ethic.  Absolutely and totally glad we called him!   Thanks James!

James is reliable, prompt and very talented. We had custom cabinets designed for our garage and because they are so deep and wide, they began to sag in the middle. Side note: original woodworker should have known this would happten after time. James built and installed supports. But the really beautiful job he accomplished is the work he performed modifying the straight pillars to the type that adorn a Craftsman style home. They look just great. He is realistic about what can be done. We asked him about some furniture and he told us he could change the one piece but could not change the second piece. I appreciate his frankness. He works quietly and keeps a very clean work space. James is a great find.

angi_reviews.text: James arrived promptly.  He completed the 3 jobs quickly considering there was a problem with putting the ceiling fan together due to poor quality.  I purchased it from Lamps Plus.  All in all James went about his work.  Some guys have the gift of gab on my dime but he did not. I would definitely hire him again.

I called James and described the problem to him. He suggested that I remove the collaped piece from the main cabinet and bring the unit to him, which saved me money for his travel time. I brought the cabinet unit to him. He did a great job of reassembling the unit, used stronger nails to connect the pieces together and then applied a large amount of very strong glue to finalize the reassembly. The work was done when he said it would be done. We are most happy with the reassembled unit, which is far stronger than that provided by the original cabinet manufacturer.

angi_reviews.text:
I called James the a day or two before and he came by to diagnose the problems mentioned earlier--he determined the garbage disposal needed to be replaced (he went out to get a new garbage disposal and replaced it the same day). He determined the gas dryer air duct (which allows the dryer air to be vented to the outside) did not need to be replaced but just needed to be sealed. He repaired some wood damage on a door frame very well. He also determined that the occasional loud noise when turning on hot water in a bathtub could not be repairs without tearing out the wall..
Overall, his diagnoses was very professional and honest and the repair work he did was excellent.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you for your review. It was a pleasure working with you.

angi_reviews.text: James was extremely professional. He promptly responded to all calls and text messages. He was punctual, honest, careful and thoughtful in his repair work. Wherever possible, he tried to use whatever could be salvaged in order to avoid disposing of otherwise useful materials. I found him to be honest in his assessments and definitely reliable. I observed his work and can say that it was done in a very high quality manner. In addition, relative to the high quality and reliability of the work he does, his hourly fees are extremely reasonable. I would strongly recommend James for any job and have referred my friends and neighbors to seek him out for any necessary repair work. He will be coming back to install an attic ladder and lay plywood down in the attic for additional storage. I fully expect to write another great review for him then as well.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you for your review. It was a pleasure working with you.

angi_reviews.text: My elderly parents hired James to repair my Dad's favorite recliner. James came out promptly and did the repairs. It is good to have a trustworthy handyman who is prompt and professional. They are relatively hard to find, and the good ones often will not come out for smaller jobs. Thanks James.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you for the review. It was a pleasure working for your parents.

angi_reviews.text: James had to make two trips out to my house. On the first trip he accomplished all the tasks enumerated above including going to Home Depot and purchasing the battery for the garage door opener and new light bulbs. He was very fast and efficient, brought all his tools and knew exactly how to proceed. Unfortunately, the battery he bought at Home Depot was bad. So he made a second trip out, no additional cost, checked the battery, went back to Home Depot and found a battery that was good. There were several on the shelf that were not good. Apparently people buy a new battery, return the old one, and get their money back. He said it wasn't unusual to have that happen. James stands behind his work and is extremely competent. Although he's not as cheap as some, he moves to fast and gets so much done, that the overall price for all he accomplishes is reasonable.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you for your review. It was a pleasure working with you.

angi_reviews.text: We needed numerous repairs at my mother-in-law's home recently in Monterey Park. We were very gratefull that a neighbor told us about James Edward Handyman and Custom Woodwork. James fixed 2 electrical problems, 3 doors, and 2 plumbing problems. He also advised us who we could call on those rare problems he didn't handle. He worked quickly and at reasonable rates and did an excellent job. We will definately call him in the future.

They were outstanding. They painted the entire 1600 sq. ft apartment, including a couple of coats of paint in some rooms as I changed my mind a few times. They were very punctual and on time. I had them back 1 another time to do another coat of paint. I had no problems with scheduling.

Christopher Horisk came out to meet me the same day I called! He went over our design options with me and my wife and gave us our quote. He had a custom cabinet maker on staff (Ignacio) to make an appointment to go over color and design. angi_reviews.business_response_text: We are sorry to hear that this client was dissapointed. We made the client aware that it may not look perfect and if he wanted to refund the deal and use someone who was more experienced he could. The client said it was a good deal and he wanted to go through us. Our first technician actually did a good job and he used the material that the client provided which made two small cracks. He called us two weeks later when the cracks showed up and he requested the contractor to come out. At the time the contractor was very busy and was not able to come out right away. Just acquire a new  property a few months ago and also used them for my income property to do the same work, cement driveway. This case was leveling and a fresh new layer to enhance.

This is a multi family  residence, more like an income property. After the use of many years and many cars in and out of the driveway. It had to be repaired someday. These guys came in quick and repaired and sealed the driveway. Took a few days but the final work was great!

Hasn't been long since I purchased this house as an investment property, but the outside needed a little work. The driveway was mainly gone. I guess the concrete was not used properly and the rest of the driveway was just a mess. These fellows came and removed the old concrete and poured in a new layer. Now it looks like a real driveway to pull up and park.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: I can see you are very happy with the work ! Thank you very much.

angi_reviews.text: Plenty of damage, torn tiles and cracked on the sides. I called these guys after a relative gave me their number. Guys replaced in a matter of days, the tile matched and also they also did a beautiful job in having the tile glazed.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you very much [removed member name], we appreciate your feedback!

angi_reviews.text: I had used them before for my own house, but  not sure if they could drive all the way to Anaheim to fix my parent's driveway. They had no issue assigning a team to their place, after the work they did, I already knew a good job was expected. I gave the options to my parents, and they liked the ideas I pitched them. They did a simple driveway, nicely done and was stamped concrete.

My old bathroom was in desperate need of new stuff. The old tub was a sheer mess and dangerous, we don't use it, might as well get rid of it and make room. The freestanding with a jets. Just like the model houses in HGTV!! The guys gave a full makeover to my bathroom ! New shower, matching hardware, an eclectic overall look .

Bought a house not too long ago and certain sections of the house was left untouched by the previous owners, the patio grill and the guest bathroom. Those areas of the house were neglected and needed some TLC. I called these fellows and decided a good reno was due. Once they were done, the value of the house def. went up.

The entire bathroom was gutted out, new plumbing, cabinets, vanity and of course  the infamous TILE! I went ahead and explained how I wanted the design and color scheme. They completed the job as I had planned, total transformation.  Will call them later no for any other projects I have in mind.

Bought a house to be flipped, replaced any damaged areas and bring the house up to date with modern features. The bathroom needed re-tiled. The driveway was badly in shape , layered and designed concrete was used. All the kitchen cabinets were stripped and refaced . Stained that matched the decor. The roof was replaced with new shingles.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you very much, we appreciate your feedback! Hope you gain your business and feel free to refer us

angi_reviews.text: This project took about a month to finish but was worth it. My old bathroom had the shower and tub, yet wanted the separate thing since I have enough room. The tile updated and the countertops with granite. They did all the work within the time frame and sure enough they finished. Everything working and no problems encountered.

I decided to plant big trees on the the front yard for much-needed shade. I wanted a stone retaining wall, actually several. I also requested a few more on the back, making sure I had enough space for these trees. Indeed they did a great job. I am pleased with the punctuality of the team, they worked pretty fast. The walls were made sturdy and most important ... aligned!

There were 2 teams that came to the door, one for the deck and the other for the paver project, I explained the details and even showed them a somewhat blueprint of my dream deck and these guys were on point! ... The pavers were finished quick and my old deck was demolished, the wood was in pretty bad shape. The guys built it and refinished it with the waterproof stain I had chosen. I was amazed at their hard work. Maybe once or twice they ran late by coming in 15/20 min  late,  but they did a great job overall.
The pavers had a combo of cobble stone and river stone which led to the grassy area.

I was very hesitant in the beginning to hire a construction company that I had never heard of. The sales representative that we met with gave us other customers to talk to and hear their experiences. My husband and I liked what we heard so we decided to go with them. Dave was very professional and told us exactly how the job was going to be done and the time frame. They brought the workers out the next day and the job was done in two weeks. 
I would recommend Dave and Quality to all of my friends. Dave, if you're reading this: I will be calling you soon! I need an estimate on windows! ;)

My husband and I have been looking for someone to help us with the remodeling around the house. We are getting old and we were afraid that someone might take advantage of us. Luckily we found Quality Remodeling and we felt so much relief. Sean came out to see us on September 19th 2012. He brought all of his license information and wouldn't even come into our house until we felt comfortable with the idea. We showed him the problem and he took measurements. What my husband and I liked the most was that he never pressured us. He told us to take time and think about it. He gave us a great price and was even willing to help us out with financing, but luckily we didn't need it.  I would recommend this company to all of my friends. In fact Sean has done work for my daughter as well.
Quality is really a wonderful company and they were  a pleasure to deal with.

Rene is a small operation. But very personal attention. The chair needed total reupholstery and is an odd shape. It also needed new foam. They picked up the chair 2 months ago, and it just got finished. Took longer than expected but the job is excellent. Almost as good as new!

When Rene arrived he started to place the furniture in my house. It looked strange and I realized that if was the wrong fabric. Rene tried to say it was my fault. He wanted to charge the full price. I said and proved it was his mistake. I still ended paying for half of the correct fabric. What was I to do? He had my furniture. I should have paid nothing for his mistake which I proved be showing him the contract. The workamanship was fine. I just shouldn't have paid an extra dime.
Excellent. Satisfaction total.
They did an excellent job! I will definitely recommend them and absolutely use them, again.
Great, Rene texted right away in the weekend, was reasonably priced and came on time in 2 days and got it done.

they re-upholstered our 6 dining chairs and refinished our solid wood table. everything looks like new. pricey, but they included pick up and delivery of the items. they did a professional job in a reasonable time frame (took about 9 days from pick up to return). i recommend rene and his crew and will contract with him again when the time comes.
Easy, they came with in hours of me calling in an emergency sistuaion. Only company that got back to me
Went very well
He did a flawless job Looks amazing! Very professional! Lori

The business was non-responsive. I called three times and left voice messages. I emailed once. I had to reach out to Angies staff to have them reach out to the company. I received a emailed stating that they had received the email and would be calling me on the following Monday. On the following Tuesday, after no call, I called and left a message. I was called back within 30 minutes and was directed to send 3 pictures of my chest upon receiving them I would be contacted. I received a text stating that the restoration would be $1200 and did I wish to proceed. I promptly responded no. This is the shabbiest treatment I have ever experienced when using an Angies List cfartsman.
He is a craftsman, and will dedicate himself to realizing your vision. Our couch and pillows have never been so beautiful and comfortable. Do not hesitate to call him. I know we won't!

When the work was done he wanted another four hundred dollars to replace a pad and recover the pillow....total scam here.... This was laughable....second time an Angies list referral tried to get me to refinance my home to do work agreed to on one of your teaser ads......Not sure the benefit to any consumers here....only to the scammers who get on your deal list.......

The first attempt at repair was unsatisfactory. There were large gaps in the supposedly repaired joints which would, over a short time, become unstable again. I explained the source of my displeasure with the work and Mr. Guzman agreed to take the chairs back and re-set them to look like I had originally expected. I was pleased with the final result.
excellent work
great Arrived on time repaired and made comfort corrections professional and courteous
He took my dresser & my money & he kept it; he won't return my calls & text messages anymore; this guy stole my property & my money
Very well. They picked up the chair and also brought it back!
It went very well. The divan looks beautiful in its off-shade, weathered green Spanish leather. We are very pleased with Mr. Guzman's work and recommend him highly to all.

Rene did a great job.  The dining table suffered a serious injury when I fell on it from a ladder.  I was not hurt, but the table collapsed.  Rene repaired the broken structure and legs.  It looks again just like it did 60 years ago.
Fair. Did not come when he said he would, didn't call. Had to make another appt. and he was late for that one.
There were maybe 2 people and it took a couple weeks. They were efficient and a job well done.
Very well. the chairs are strong and the refinishing makes them look great
Great job well done. I cant wait to get him back to do some other jobs

Initial miscommunication about first estimate visit. Immediately, the owner, Tony Forfa contacted me, apologized and came out to do the estimate himself. From that point forward, everything went exceedingly well. I do feel that the willingness to correct with professionalism and performance is very much appreciated. The install went perfectly, and the wonderful service was the bright spot in a long process. My kitchen renovation was due to a leak, and mold abatement, not a planned renovation. Kitchen Specialists will get all PLANNED work in the future.

Wonderful company, with an eye toward excellent customer service. I am not only thrilled with results, but with the experience. Mr. Forfa was responsive to my need economize, and helped me make decisions which provided me with cost saving options. I have a crazy dog, and they were very helpful in letting me know they were near, so I could take care of her, and not have a canine melt down. The young man, Chris, who did the install was so professional and very thorough. He also helped me with some of the choices I needed to make and was very neat in his work area. I highly recommend Kitchen Specialists and I would use them for any remodeling--especially high end, custom work.

The experience was very good. They gave great advice their suggestions were very valid when I needed it. They were very professional and punctual. If they were late they always called and did not leave us wondering and also let us know if they  were going to be early. I am very please with the outcome of the work. I would use them again in the future. I recommend them to others.
They did a good job.

They were outstanding and extremely helpful. They are good. The work is being done by another company. They went out of their way to make sure that she got all the rebates possible. It took them at least an hour and a half to two hours to write up the invoice; they did this to ensure that she gets all the credits as far as rebates could be acquired. This was way above and beyond what they ordinarily would do so I was impressed. I have purchased from them in the past but never to this degree. They have always been very attentive. They give me all the different options. They provide very good customer service after the sales as well so I have been very pleased. I am going to be purchasing a new stove top from them in the future.

They were awesome. The did exactly what they promised to do. Their communication was good. Their craftsmen were professional. My overall experience with them was excellent. I am getting ready to remodel my kitchen so will definitely use them again.

My husband and I were extremely pleased with the services provided by the Kitchen Specialists. Staff was excellent and work area was always left clean. Kitchen remodel was done in a timely matter. The owner is personable and delivered exactly what was ordered. We highly recommend the Kitchen Specialists.
From start to finish from the manager to all the workers that came on the job DID their part "EXCELLENT"   OUR FAMILY LAST RATINGS FOR THIS COMPANY. from one to ten "We give them ONE MILLION".

The work turned out okay, but it was a hassle. They did good work but I had to be on them constantly to get the work done. I did not like that they continually tried to do upgrades from the contract I was provided.
It was okay.
The remodel went well and looks good after 4 years.

The cabinets have been done so poorly that I will have to have some one else come out and fix it. All their work is amateur and the finish on it is just terrible. I had to negotiate a lower price with the owner. They did all they could do to do the cheapest job. I would not recommend them to anyone. They were virtually never on time. Sometimes they wouldn't even show. They said that they did call when they were late but we never did get any calls. They took a month longer to complete the job.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: The Kitchen Specialists did in fact complete the member’s project, and the scope of work was far more involved than just cabinets. Walls were moved, the ceilings were raised, fabricated and installed countertops with a full tile backsplash, as well as gas lines, electrical, and plumbing. Kitchen Specialists went above and beyond to appease the member, and even went as far as giving him a credit towards the total job cost. When doing a project as involved as the member’s there is always the risk of running into unexpected problems during the course of the job. The Kitchen Specialists did everything in their power to cooperate with the member and complete his job to his specifications, and made every effort to make the member happy. We have hundreds of customers each year who are more than happy with our work. The Kitchen Specialists also has an A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau.

angi_reviews.text: Royalty Builders was such a good company to work with. We worked with Liroy on getting pavers installed in our backyard and driveway, and they look amazing! They were so helpful with helping us choose the best design for my house and we agreed on the scope of the work that needed to be done. They were very efficient to make everything look great. There was no change order and the work was completed on time even when a pandemic was getting in the way haha. I recommend them to everyone who wants renovations done.

angi_reviews.business_response_text: We appreciate you taking the time to leave your awesome review. It is so good to hear you had such an amazing experience with our team, and that you are pleased with the outcome of your new project! Thank you for your business and for recommending Royalty Builders Inc.

angi_reviews.text: I hired Royalty Builders after receiving multiple bids for different companies. Royalty Builders was one of the higher bids, however I feel that it was worth the money! My project manager was professional, caring, and responsive. The process was very simple we had 2 long meetings where I sat with Liroy the owner of the company. He explained the entire process thoroughly and created a 3-D before and after design of my home. I was able to see what the final product would be before we even started. After the 2 meetings we set a start date and end date which was spot on. Overall I had a great experience and I was very pleased with their craftsmanship, professionalism, and dedication.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: We appreciate you taking the time to leave your awesome review. It is so good to hear you had such an amazing experience with our team, and that you are pleased with the outcome of your new project! Thank you for your business and for recommending Royalty Builders Inc.

angi_reviews.text: We thank you and your team at Royalty Builders for doing a great job on the remodeling of our house. angi_reviews.text: Very well

T.N.L. Construction is our go-to home improvement company. Me and my wife were thinking of upgrading our kitchen back in September and got estimates from a few companies. Most were too high and we felt like they were trying to rip us off but Meir from T.N.L. Construction was a game-changer. Very friendly guy, actually lowered the price twice before we signed. Our kitchen looks better than we had expected and my wife and I are happier than ever. Thanks Meir!

We had some issues with our sink and our kitchen was overall old and outdated. Since we've moved into the house, we haven't done any remodeling so we thought this would be a good start. Meir and his partner brought a few samples and gave us a fair estimate. We decided to continue to shop around but eventually called Meir back because of the low price he gave us. We were extremely surprised at how fast the process was and we are happy at how new and improved our kitchen looks now! This includes cabinet, sink, counter top,  highly recommended services :)

It was my wife's idea to remodel the bathroom and we went through several different companies and estimates. Raphael gave us a good feeling from the moment we met and was nice enough to drop a generous portion of the original price. He managed the entire project very professionally and his workers were kind and on time. My wife and I are very happy with how our bathroom looks today and will definitely use this company in the future. We've already recommended their service to a family member who happens to be just as impressed as we are!

2 words.... Smooth ride. I can't express enough truly how great of an experience this was. I have good experiences with previous contractors but not like this one with Meir. I didn't feel pressured into making decisions, he was willing to work with me on the price (because I wanted everything high end), and I was constantly updated with the status of the project. I highly recommend working with this company and Meir. Thank you again for your outstanding work.

They arrived on time for the estimate which was different than the other contractors, and gave us the price,which was lower than the other estimates. They started the job promptly and while they were doing the construction they cleaned up the mess as they went ,that was a surprise.They finished when they promised .Upon completion they they took the time to show us the custom work that was done. Very professional. We will and do recommend them.

angi_reviews.text: I hired this company to replace a retaining wall on the outside of my home. Amir was the representative. Very hard to get a hold of. Would only contact us when they wanted money. Never on time, left a mess for myself and my son to clean up. It has been one year. The finish coat on the wall is cracking and falling off. Retaining wall is starting to crack and bust. With the amount of money that I paid for this. I expected somewhat of a little bit better job. I have since sent messages to the rep with no answer no reply. I would not recommend them for anything. Unless you want to write a check and have horrible work done. It amazes me this day and age that we have to be dealing with this. Especially as much as this company advertises work in our neighborhood. Just very disappointed. Had someone reached out to rectify the situation things might have been different. But guess not. Do not hire these people

We hired the right choice home remodeling to remodel our bathroom. They said that they would be with us every step of the way and to help us pick out the right materials for the remodel. I saw the rep once and that was at the very beginning of the remodel. They never went with us to pick out any materials, faucets, or fixtures. They said it would take three weeks from start to finish, it took eight weeks. We purchased granite countertops for our vanity and sinks and they miss cut the countertops, so the faucet would not fit and the backsplash was not cut to proper length and used the wrong blade so the marble was jagged. We had to buy new material to replace what they had damaged. They made all kinds of promises that they did not keep. It seemed like all they wanted to do was collect their money. The the rep would only call me when he wanted me to write a check. The only other time I spoke to him was when I hated to discuss the situation. I do not recommend this company.

Leo is an excellent contractor. He was here every single day to check on the progress of the work from beginning to end. It was a pleasure to work with him,and have him explain everything that would be done. It was a job well done. Looking forward to working with him again in the near future.

Leo was an excellent contractor, who made me feel important. He was he every single day, to check on the process of how much work was completed. He explain things well and gave sound instructions on the process each day. It was beyond my expectations, even people in the neighborhood was impressed with the work done.
