Niri and Leo initially presented us with an impressive plan for a complete remodel of our two bathrooms. They were very accommodating during the planning phase, promising to bring our vision to life. However, after we signed the contract, the experience quickly turned disappointing.  The team they sent to our home was unprofessional, lacked the necessary expertise, and failed to deliver on their commitments. Communication was poor, and we encountered multiple instances of misinformation. Unfortunately, rather than receiving the quality service we were promised, we felt pressured and misled throughout the entire process.  In hindsight, we regret not exploring other options and would caution others to carefully consider their choices when hiring this company. This has by far been the worst experience we have had with a service provider, leaving us feeling both frustrated and dissatisfied.

angi_reviews.text: Lee Roy was excellent, his quotes were reasonable, the work was done on time and very well. He's helped us with stucco repair and paint, new windows and doors, attic insulation, and most recently interior drywall and flooring renovations. Lee Roy keeps us in the loop with pictures and updates, he asks the right questions, and offers really helpful advice on ways to fix complicated problems. His attention to detail is very much appreciated and it's what makes the difference every time we work with him. Looking forward to having him back on the next major project. Thanks Lee Roy!

Very happy with the service. They were on time and did exactly what I needed done for a good price.  They worked at a great pace and  cleaned up when finished.  I'd definitely hire them again and recommend them.

I called Brews Roy and had a wonderful experience.  Leroy was quick to get back to me, answered my questions, was on time, and came in on budget. Leroy was such a gentleman and did an amazing job repairing our bathroom ceiling. He was cautious of my dogs when coming in and out which was such a huge relief. I will definitely be calling Leroy out again.

angi_reviews.text: Company changed hands mid-2017, so any review previous to that is for a different company. Every review in 2017 that talks about problems I can relate as we experienced them all. They still aren't done and a sub has been working to finish. Multiple start and stops. Was supposed to be done 11/2017. Still not in house. Asked to prepay multiple times or else they couldn't work. Took shingles off then made me prepay to get new roof or else they couldn't complete for a few weeks. Stole money from my project to complete others. In my industry that is a Ponzi scheme. Johnny flat out lies and only responded when he wanted money. Phone is disconnected, so I hope they are out of business finally. I am out $20-30k at this point. Not sure how to get them removed or reported to Angies List and the other places they are listed.

Hired them in Oct.2016. They began the work in Feb. 2017. Would say they were coming to do some work and not show. Finally finished in Sept. We now have a contractors lien on the house because they did not pay the subcontractor they hired to do the actual work. This was after we were told that they do not sub-contract.

They installed sliding glass door for me. They did a poor job of it. While framing it, they ignored or grossly misread the structural engineer's drawings (failing to install a column attached to the ground), which seemed incredibly dangerous. They only installed it after my wife noticed it before they covered it up, and then they still needed me to verify with the structural engineer that a column should actually go all the way to the footing. Thank God my wife saw it. They left trash and debris everywhere throughout the project. They also improperly sealed the door, and now it leaks whenever it rains. We have tried to call them to fix the seal around the door multiple times. They said they would fix it, but now they simply do not return our calls. Avoid this contractor!

the price was negotiable, was a little over my budget but for the quality of the work. I can see why it was the price it was. I have to keep in mind my house isn't not small, so they square footage that is already existing PLUS the addition, made it a lot bigger. I like that the workers were here constantly. Even through out inspections, once it was passed they continued to work. The foreman was also great and would constantly inform me about the stages that were going to come next. As far as the office, i cannot complain. Any concerns i had were resolved right away, and I had constant communication from the coordinator and the accounting side, along with a young lady that would come every week to check up and make sure the job was being ran properly.

I was actually recommended by them from a friend. My roof needed to be upgraded so i can be ready for "El Niño" and I called them for a quote. As soon as I got the quote I decided to give them a shot and they finished my roof before I can blink my eyes. The workers were very respectful and would inform me about every step. So I definitely got a good experience with them. No issues at all! Thanks for hard work!

Good service. This was my first time doing construction and didn't know what the process was like or the timing. But I can say they finished fast. Inspections were all passed. I had minor changes in the bathroom instead of having everything standard I wanted more of a modern look but they were not bothered about my changes that I wanted they actually even helped out with getting the perfect design. Deena was keeping constant communication and had a young lady come over once or twice a week to make sure process was smooth and it really was. Thank you!

I have previously worked with them for minor remodels (bathrooms) and decided I needed to do something new to the house and that would add value to it since I am looking into leaving state. I added two new bedrooms with bathrooms and extended my current kitchen for my space, to add an island and a small breakfast area. I had my plans already, all I did was hire them for the construction. But let me tell you it was a good experience. They were there 7-4 latest, and if I wanted minor changes they did them with no problem. I had no minor fixtures everything ran smoothly thank god! My kitchen looks GREAT so spacious and modern, and the two extra rooms with their own bathrooms are cozy and spacious as well. Thank you for the great effort and doing an exceptional job. I' would recommend you use these guys. You won't regret

Quality of work was good, I can say I am satisfied. I was usually never home since I travel for work but the work was done fast. I like that they started early and worked until mid afternoon. When inspection was not passed for a very MINOR problem they worked on it the same day and called for inspection next day to pass. I ran across them by seeing their company logo on a property in Van Nuys area. I called and had my free estimate which was good. And Jason was just very polite and knew what he was talking about. I would use these guys and recommend to family.

I had used them back in the beginning of the year around my wife's birthday. They had done a small addition to my home and let me tell you, it was great. Sometimes there were delays but because of inspection and material was changing delivery dates. But my wife and I were very stoked when the work started. As well when it was finished, we were pleased with what we wanted done. Now, here we are using them again but this time for my parents. They have a small home in north hills and I am looking to expand it since my sister is coming from Chicago to stay for a year and she can have somewhere to stay. The plans are being checked at the city, have been for 2 months now but we're closer and we're getting ready to start our second project. I'm excited to see what the end results will be!

I signed up with these guys about two months ago, we started out with a free estimate and then I signed up with them to have my drawings done and they handled all the city stuff. The work has started as of this month (October) and so far I am happy with the job, Lesly and Deena have been coming at least twice a week to check on the job, and she gives me updates on what's going on since I am new with all the construction language. The guys are very hard working (considering the fact that they work all day in the sun). They are respectful of my house and always ask me question as well. My foundation has been done and my framing is up as well. I'm happy with progression so far and I can't wait to see end results. Thanks to Jason and everyone that's working hard I appreciate it and again can't wait to see end results with the finishes.

Their work ethic is a Aplus! They were probably late to start working a couple of times but made up the time and stayed later to advance on the kitchen. They definitely did work early in the mornings and sometimes they wouldn't work, but only because they have inspection to pass. I like the fact that they passed inspections, only once was it a minor little detail that the inspector brought to they attention but he let it be done while he was there and inspection passed. Demo was probably tough on them, the stucco was a bit old and strong. But after that the foundation happened and everything happened so fast(stages) my addition seemed to be a lot bigger than I thought it would be but I am definitely happy with the end work. They did not do finishes because I have family members that helped but as far as construction I was impressed with the quality and the fact that I have warranty made me a happy camper. Thanks to the team and office staff that checked up about twice a week!

I got a great relationship with everyone in the office, including deena and Jason. First off Deena was great, she gave me a like weekly schedule of job and helped me choose all my bathroom stuff through online or even going to Home Depot with me on days she came to job site. The workers were very friendly and respectful when in my house. If there were minor problems they immediately contacted me to inform and I stay updated. Which I thought was great because I like to know what it is going on. I was impressed with how fast things went. I already had my plans approved by city and everything so as soon as I signed contract with them they started a little over a week later! Very good! Fast paced! Friendly staff!! IMPRESSED THANKS SO MJCH XO

Excellent work!! I was very sketchy about them because the guy that came to me house looked young, but when he told me they had 30 + years of experience I was sort of convinced. I had free estimates by other company's as well but I just wasn't convinced. This guy had a strong personality, outgoing gentleman. They helped me with the process 100%. From issues with the city to starting construction, they guided me through it all step by step. I am happy I chose them for my small project. I have handed their number to friends and family and hope they continue to get more business because their work is just great!

Well, I had double work done in my home down in LB. I had first hired them for a kitchen remodel, then asked how fast they could work on extending my existing garage. They had measurements done and let me know a time frame. The price I wasnt too convinced about. But I kept in mind that the company had over 30 years of experience and it was not easy to trust anyone.(also did consider the fact that they did an awesome job on my kitchen WHICH is now extremely spacious as I had wished) so I agreed and signed a new contract for my garage. Demolition was done and my garage was extended. I can now fit two cars(before I can only fit one and used extra as storage). Also, they did start a bit early (7am) and finished a bit late, but all the time they invested was definitely worth it because they worked fast and the end work was very professional. I did not see any major fixtures. Thanks office and crew, I will definitely recommend to my family and friends for any construction work! *TWO THUMBS UP!!

I had a garage added to the back of my house. My house never had one so I wanted one since it's always good to have that extra storage and I needed a place to store one of my vehicles. Everything was greatly done. The only big process was really getting the plans approved. But Chris did his part and stayed on top of his communication with the city. As soon as my plans got approved the guys started working right away! Greatly done. Thank you very much. I am so happy with my extra garage space.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you (Members name removed) for taking time out of your busy schedule to write a wonderful review of our company. We are pleased you are happy with our work. Thank you again. Sharon Richie Marketing Manager

angi_reviews.text: The company was very great. I can say my experience with them was definitely an "A" rating. I received a free estimate from Michael and as soon as I got the price, I decided to proceed. I had an addition built to the side of my existing home. The process was very smooth, Dina kept constant communication with me and gave me a weekly schedule of the work being done. They did start a bit early in the morning but it needed to be done since I had a certain time frame. Besides the crew being there and working on the construction site, I had assistants from the office stop by weekly to make sure I was happy with the process, and to make sure that everything was moving smoothly. Great customer service from them. Thank you Dina for being great, and thank you Michael for a very well promised job. I am definitely content with my new addition!
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you (Members name removed) for allowing us to serve you. We also appreciate you taking the time to write a positive review for our company. Sharon Richie Marketing Manager

angi_reviews.text: My experience with them was good, can't complain. I am a very picky person so they were super patient and were ok with me coming along with them on getting my material. I also liked the fact that they did not once complain about me changing my mind about certain little things i wanted in my bath and guest room. I want to thank Michael and the crew for completing my small addition. My brother comes constantly and is comfortable with the room he has to stay in. Thanks for taking your time and making me happy!

I was actually recommended to them by a friend, she had hired them for a kitchen remodel, and the work was excellent. So when she found out that I wanted an extra room added to the back of my home she told me to give them a call for an appointment.
As soon as i decided do hire them, they were on top of it all. Not only do they do Construction but they help out with the Planning process as well. Chris, was very patient and helpful, he was in constant communication with me the whole way. Although, the city may have taken a little longer than what I expected; as soon as it was approved, Chris and his team started at the site right away. They do as they say! They will definitely make you happy! Thank you Chris, for a professional experience.

I had been looking forward to making changes around my home for a while now, but I wasn't too sure weather I was making the right decision or weather I even knew where to begin with the process. I decided to look around for someone to help out and I stumbled across these guys. Michael, (who I first met with for a free consultation) helped me plan this out and even exceed what my thoughts for the addition were (master bedroom, with a large bathroom and a walk in closet). There were minor fixtures that resulted in taking longer than what I expected, but the end results were phenomenal. I will definitely use these guys in the future!

Everything went well, I have done business with these guys before, great work, I have got to say this year my house went through a lot of work but I am glad to say that the work looks great, thank you guys.

Went good, took time to decide on the finish materials of the project which delayed things a bit but they were patient in working with me and my wife. A couple of things occurred on site which were unexpected, but everything was situated and handled.

Everything was professional and by the book, organized, and easy to work with, not my first construction project,  wont be my last, I will most likely use these guys again for any remodeling work, cant vouch for what other type of work, but the remodel was perfect.

First met with Jason which went great , closed on the price, met with the architect. Got things under way about a week later and saved me the money from another violation, city tried to fine me several thousands of dollars.

top_complaint_summary: The customer had a poor experience with the owner's behavior, which they believed might be due to a family relationship.

angi_reviews.text: Avi and Tal were great. They have quality craftsmen... from the tile work to the plumbing, even the plastering and painting. Everyone showed up on time, did their work efficiently, and were all extremely careful to keep the rest of the house clean. That alone made it the best remodel job for us yet. The price the charged was certainly fair -- not the cheapest but certainly not the most expensive -- and the part we liked the most is that the price they quoted was the price they charged. There were no hidden costs, no add-ons, and everything they promised was included. That was another huge plus. But the biggest plus is the end result -- my wife now has a gorgeous bathroom that she loves. We highly recommend them.

Flat Rate Rate Remodeling did an outstanding job on our home. The bathrooms are stunning, literally drop dead gorgeous. The guest bedroom with new tile flooring, lighting and electrical prefect. Then my wife left town for five days and we gutted the entire home office, reworked all the electrical, internet and USB connections, scraped the ceiling and laid the same natural wood tiles fabulous. Big surprise when she returned home. Took a couple more week to get new office & french doors to the yard. but worth the wait. I high recommend Avi and his crews at Flat Rate remodeling.
Great Job, appreciated the continual contact as project progressed.

We are so happy with the outcome of our bathroom remodel. The work was really done well and you can see the quality in the craftsmanship. We're grateful for Flat Rate's willingness to work with us and find solutions when we ran into obstacles. Full disclosure though, we thought communication could have been a bit more clear and would have avoided some differences in opinion along the way. There were some commitments made while agreeing to the initial contract that led to some debates, but in the end we did resolve things with Avi's help so all parties were happy. Flat Rate Remodeling did a very nice job.
By far the best experience I've ever had with any contractor. Extremely satisfied.

The work was done well and in a timely manner. I was very impressed by how quickly things got finished once permitting issues were resolved. They did an excellent job staying on top of permitting issues and were always available for communication addressing any issues/concerns. Cabinetry and countertops are top notch. All of the workmen were very polite and considerate and kept the house/kitchen tidy whenever their work was done for the day. The remodel turned out beautiful, better than I had hoped. Avi, who oversaw our project, was very professional, attentive, and easy to work with. Would definitely hire again, and/or recommend. We had interviewed quite a few contractors before deciding on Flat Rate Remodeling, I am very happy with the choice we made.
FANTASTIC !!!

I hired Flat Rate for a bathroom remodel. They were a great company to work with, and I am glad to offer them a recommendation to any that ask. I want through a long quoting process for this job. Flat Rate offered one of the most competitive quotes with a clear SOW. My directions on design were very few, but Avi, delivered exactly what I wanted with a clean and modern design. Tal did a wonderful job of communicating with me on scheduling, and the project came off smooth and on schedule. If you thinking of any remodel, do yourself a favor and call Flat Rate for a quote. I will definitely use them again for my next project.

So I just finished a complete kitchen remodel with Flat Rate in my small condo. I did a lot of research and got quotes from several contractors before choosing them. The thing that ultimately made me choose them was the great communication which continued throughout the project. Avi, who helped design the project and Tal are very knowledgeable and easy to work with. All the crews were courteous and respectful. With any big project, there will always be an unforeseen glitch or 2 but I felt complete security knowing they will take care of everything. As for the kitchen, its simply stunning how it came out. I have zero regrets in choosing them and highly recommend them for any contracting project.

They are supposed to bring the papers to me. but they did not. I found out the service was over price. It was a rush job, did not take care of the final deatails. I have to point out the things that they have to do. The man who work was good but then It was a rush job, he did not do some other things that need to be done. And also the Material that they put in the counter top was not the material that they showed me and promised to put into the counter.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Hard for me to believe that you will post a review a year after the job was already completed. its the first time that I hear those concerns I wish you could call the office first. we are standing behind our customers by the end of the day our goal is to have a happy and satisfied customer. you signed all material colors and selection prior to installation, which paperwork you are referring too? you have all original contract paperwork with you  sorry for the inconvenience, please call the office for any issue to be resolved.

angi_reviews.text:
It's just shy business traps, rude behavior, disorganized, poor communications among her and her staff and me and the tenant and apparently I'm guessing because the owner of the company and she had similar last name they must have been related because I can't imagine anybody putting up with her behavior in an office unless they were related you know.



They got the job done at the price they said but it was a pain in the a**.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: This review is very shocking and surprising to us. We went above and beyond for this job. When we began your  we did not take any form of a deposit from you (we NEVER do business like that but made an exception for you because we were working remotely). Through out the duration of your project, we pulled permits, went by-the-book and completed your job in full. When it was time for us to get payment, it was such a hard time. We made multiple phone calls and emails that went unanswered.There was a trust issue from the beginning. You called the city yourself to see if permits were pulled even after we sent you the original copies of everything.   The tenant however, was a pleasure to work with. We made the minor corrections with no problem. After we made the corrections, there was still a big hassle to get payment from you. We completed the job fully and the client was satisfied with the results AND our customer service.

angi_reviews.text: Every step of this process was a pleasure. We started out needing repair work, then decided to renovate the ancient bathroom while we were at it. The finished room is so beautiful that our kids call it the "hotel bathroom." Avi and his team were direct, pleasant, prompt, and professional every step of the way, from the initial design discussions to the final inspection. It was nice to feel we were collaborating, rather than being told what we needed (as we've experienced with other companies). All work was completed by the promised date, even though the team had to work around our schedule and city inspections. The office checked in regularly to keep us up-to-date on schedule matters, and were attentive and responsive when we had questions. Every craftsman who came to the house was punctual, professional, and friendly. The work was meticulous. We are delighted to have found this company and will be scheduling more work with them soon.

We met Jacob, the project manager  to do the estimate of our bathroom remodeling, he was so knowledgeable, very thorough and explained everything to us. Tal, the office manager was very helpful and responsive, she made sure that all concerns, questions are being taken care of. We requested to cancel our bathroom remodeling for the meantime. They were able to accommodate our request within 24 hours. Avi the owner hand delivered our deposit check. He did the bathroom inspection, he checked if we have water leak on our shower pan which is the reason why we requested their service because the termite company told us we might have a water leak issue .  Upon checking, he made sure that he checked everything and  assured us that there's no leak and we should have peace of mind and advised us anytime we are ready to do the bathroom remodeling we'll contact them. We had a great experience dealing with them.They do have the best customer service!
unknown
unknown

I have had 2 jobs with Flat Rate Remodeling and they get the work done. The guys are pleasant and professional, which is nice when they are working on your home. I had a small bathroom remodel that went quite well and I am satisfied with the work. It was done on time and in the budget. I had a laundry room upgrade done as well. All working out so far. I would definitely use Flat Rate Again. I am very busy and they just take care of a lot of the worries so I don't have to.

Because of their attention to detail and strong focus on client satisfaction, FlatRate Remodeling is an indispensable key component to our projects' successes.Flat Rate Remodeling professionalism and experience enable our creative visions to become reality in the best possible way.

Overall the quality of the work was very high. The workers were skilled and did not cut any corners in making sure that everything was properly fitted, sealed and made absolutely water-tight. Obviously it was a stressful experience to have our only bathroom out of commission, but they did the best they could to move things along and make sure things were done quickly and neatly. They were also considerate in making sure that things were cleaned up when they left. The repair they did is very solid, looks good and will undoubtedly last a long time, and they told me to call them if there are any problems, so I appreciate that they stand behind their work.

I am so pleased with the results!  The quality of service was beyond my expectations.  It was a pleasant experience working with Tal and Avi; they both were very knowledgeable and answered all my questions during the remodel of my kitchen and bathroom.  My ideas and their ideas worked well and we always found a middle ground when we couldn't see eye to eye.  In addition, I am very grateful that Avi was able to work with my budget which I made very clear from the beginning.  I also have to thank Tal for providing friendly and courteous customer service-I never felt like she was too busy for me.  I highly recommend Flat Rate Remodeling.  They are honest people that do what they say and will not give you the run around.  Thanks again!

angi_reviews.business_response_text: Project was completed to 100% client satisfaction!!! long time ago..... Whatever was not included in the contract has to be charged We did everything was required and more....

angi_reviews.text: It is absolutely beautiful. I have a new jacuzzi, a new shower with a bench, new flooring, new lights, new countertops. All the guys that came out were very professional, they cleaned up after themselves, showed up on time and made sure I was aware of everything going on from start to finish. I would highly recommend them.

top_complaint_summary: Poor quality of work and unprofessional behavior, including bringing in another contractor to finish a job and asking for a rating before completion.

angi_reviews.text: I found him on Angie's List and it was a very unfavorable experience. He said he fixed it when he left but it did not work again the next day. When I called him back he refused to come back. I thought he was overpriced for what he did and the quality of work was unsatisfactory.

We hired Yari to fix a door (which he ruined and had to replace, the replacement is of much lower quality), we hired him to paint, he brought in someone else to do that job, and now the ceiling where he performed light carpentry is cracking, he also asked that we rate his work before the job was finished.

FROM THE VERY START THE EXPERIENCE WAS EXCELLENT.
THE ESTIMATES WERE NICE.
THE WORK WAS QUICK AND PROFESSIONAL.
THEY PAID ATTENTION TO THE SMALLEST DETAIL.
THE CREW WENT THE EXTRA MILE TO MAKE ME HAPPY.
THE CLEANUP WAS TOP NOTCH.
AND THE RESPECT THEY GAVE TO ME AND MY FAMILY WAS EXCELLENT.
FOR YOUR REPAIR NEEDS THIS IS THE FIRM TO HIRE.
It went great overall.
Yari was very good about responding to my request. It was cold and the heater wasn't working properly.
The leak was repaired.

The men were all very professional and friendly and knowledgeable.  They cleaned up after each task and were very precise about the time estimates.  The plumber knew his stuff and was even able to find the water cutoff even though I didn't know where it was (nor did any of my neighbors).  They were fast and efficient.  The wall patch is invisible.

Our house was broken into the night before we moved in, and there were several minor issues which needed to be fixed. I researched here on Angie's List and Yari had good reviews and was close. I prefer to use local businesses if at all possible. Yariv was polite and nice to work with. He showed up on time and was very matter-of-fact about the job. This was an insurance claim, so I wasn't worried about pricing too much, but it was very reasonable in my opinion. The only problem I had was when the rains came later on and the shed door expanded with humidity. It started to scrape on the bottom. I could have called him back, but decided to fix it myself and it was no problem. I would not hesitate to use him again for general handyman needs. Thanks!

I contacted Yari over the phone. Even though he was busy, he was very good about returning my call and scheduling an appt. He visited the property and keep me informed about the repairs since I don't live locally. Unfortunately, I was not able to see the work done. However, the tenant seemed happy and satisfied. Yari was efficient, friendly, and professional.

I met Isaac through his son, Yari the handyman, who did excellent work remodeling the back room of our house. Isaac was polite, courteous and professional. He explained the issues with our roof, provided me with a fair estimate and all of this on New Year's Eve day! His crew came out on the second of January and finished the roof in one day. There was no trace of them in the yard after they left which is an extremely high compliment! Since I wasn't able to get up to the roof Isaac took pains to show me the before and after photos of his crew's work. This company was highly reliable and extremely communicative, taking pains to make sure that the customer was happy. I have already recommended them to a neighbor and will use them again in the future for some carpentry work we're planning to do in the house.

Novatec were professional, punctual, attentive and very clean. From start to finish this was a great and positive experience (unlike previous experience I had with other companies). Isaac went far and beyond the ?call of duty? and with his expertise as a building inspector, rechecked my house and gave me a detailed report of the condition of the house, at no charge. The most important thing for me was to have a fixed price with no surprises, a set date, and detailed information of the job to be performed. Hurray, I was more than pleased.  Once the bathroom was done, I also did my flooring on the stairs and the hallway since I was impressed, happy and thrilled.

Yari was very professional. He answered his phone right away, scheduled an appointment for the next day and - after talking - he started work immediately. He explained to me step-by-step what he was doing and gave me alternatives for fixing damage done from a previous leak. I never felt like he was trying to up sell me, but rather explaining all the options. Both of his crew, Pedro and Casanova, worked quickly and well. I would definitely use this company again because I really appreciate having a licensed handyman take care of whatever jobs we need done.

Yari is a responsible, reliable gentleman who did what he said he would do and more. When he came a second time to complete some work, I was not able to be home and therefore pay him, and that was not an issue for him, in fact I had to call HIM to ask how I could get the check to him. He worked hard, sometimes giving me a break on a price because it took longer to get parts,etc. Just a good, trustworthy man.

Yari called me back the very day I called him and was able to come out the next day to give me an estimate. Yari showed up with molding samples and the samples we're nicer (real wood) and a better price than what you can get from a place like Home Depot. Yari had great ideas and I believe I used all of them. My husband and I were only going to do a few home improvements now but we kept calling Yari back for additional work because he does a really good job and is pleasure to be around. Yari was here the day I had a wardrobe unit delivered and for some reason all the hardware was unscrewed. Yari noticed I was disappointed and quickly jumped in and drilled the hardware back in. On another day, my 3 year old daughter accidental ripped the curtain rode down from her room and Yari jumped in and fixed it.  He never later said I owed me more money. Yari will give you a quote and stick to it. He won't nickel and dime you and he'll go out of his way to make you happy.

Excellent experience. Yari is always on time, courteous and easy to work with. He has even worked on holidays for us! He is very detail oriented and the end result is exactly what was asked for and even better!! I think you will find his pricing to be very competitive. We have already hired him for another project and will continue to do so for future needs.

angi_reviews.text:
AAA I think this is the best way to start this review.

Metro builders did it again!!!

Simply perfect, start to finish, so smooth, so fast and my mom so happy she

can move in.

In less then 3 Months Metro builders and the amazing Erez who supervise the all project, as he promised the job site always so clean, ordering the materials on time so no delays, the way he manage the workers and the chemistry between all.

The kitchen came so pretty, the bathroom with the handicap accesses for my mom, the non slippery floor covering.

Thank you Metro builders and I'm sure will see you again.

Metro builders did it again!!!

In less then 10 days complete my kids bath room with new tile in the shower and floor.

Remove the old roof and install new shingles just before the rain start.


Thank you Erez and Metro team.

The company's owner Erez was outstanding in every way. Very attentive, punctual, responsive, reasonable and enthusiastic. I have no reservations giving him and the company the highest marks. Ours was a complex remodel. He made it essentially painless. Even when we were out an appliance because it was being replaced, he arranged for us to have replacement options.
Everything stayed on schedule and was completed in a timely fashion. It looks amazing. My wife and I are very excited and pleased.
Phillip

I feel like the deal was falsely advertised. They said that it would not be for any 8 hours, and they said that Angie’s List had advertised it wrong. I was told that I couldn’t get just anything done during the 8 hours. I wasn’t compensated at all for the Big Deal I purchased. All this is to the best of my recollection.

angi_reviews.text:
We
called to Metro builders again after our amazing experience in the pass.
Erez showed up at 9 PM after we called cause our main water supply brake in the
attic above the bathroom.
He stayed until 10:30 Pm with his plumber as a first aid to stop the leaking
and next day the workers came to do clean up the mess.
He helped us to negotiate with the insurance to collect the money and the same
time replace the entire bathroom, new flooring, vanity, tile, electrical, dry
wall and paint, all job was done in less than a week like nothing happen.
Thank you and see you again

We just hired metro builders again to remodel my mom's bathroom in Encino. Removed the tub and install walk-in tub, install new tile floor, new toilet and vanity. New fresh paint and new lights.  He discovered termite damage inside the wall, replace all the damaged wood, install new wood for NO CHARGE. The job was done in 5 days.
My mom and I are very happy.
Thank you Erez.

Bought 12 hours, the provider provided 2 guys. Possibly it was the amount of time or the paint used but I had to add a few more coats to all doors as the original color could still be seen. Overall the guys did a good job in the time allotted and were extremely friendly, helpful and professional.
Painted doors and windows, mounted new house numbers and letterbox.

Initial installer did very poor job and contractor's initial response was unprofessional and argumentative.  The correction of the work done by the initial installer went very well with the two men kind and competent.

In
the last 9 years we did many jobs with metro builders and remodeling.
We own a multiply apartments buildings and Metro builder?s always available
for immediate start.
This job we have a bath room that the ceiling is collapsed from broken water
pipe above.
The guys came over at 10 PM to shot off the water, fix the pipe and show up at
7 AM to clean up the mass and start remodel the bathroom.
Everything was done in 6 days: new tile, electrical, window, paint. Perfect
we are very happy and the tenant happy.
Thank you again.

I had called Metro Builders to come give me an estimate to replace an
elevated driveway.  The job is more complex than an average driveway as
there are posts, foundations, beams, etc. under the concrete.  Erez was
able to figure out several details that other contractors missed,
especially with regard to the necessity to replace much of the support
structure under the driveway.  He came back to me with a fair quote in a very
reasonable period of time.

WE LOVE THE BATHROOM YOU GUYS JUST DID FOR US.
SO FAST, SO CLEAN, SO PROFESSIONAL . 
SEE YOU SOON.  ^_^

kitchen and bathroom remodel
AAA

I purchased the $199 for 6 man hours of general remodeling or contracting services BIg Deal.  Metro Builders contacted me shortly thereafter, but I told them that I was not yet ready and would call them.  I called them a couple weeks before my voucher expired, and Metro set me up for an appointment in less than a week.  Francisco arrived at my house early, which worked out great for me.  He told me he was here to do whatever I needed done, put in a full 6 hours and maybe more, and was a pleasure to work with.  We are very happy with the results of his work.

METRO BUILDERS REMODEL THE BATH ROOM IN MY GUST HOUSE.
IN 10 WORKING DAYS THE JOB WAS DONE, FROM DEMOLITION TO INSTALL NEW WINDOW, NEW PLUMBING, TRAVERTINE FLOOR AND SHOWER, PAINTING AND CLEAN UP.
HIGHLY  RECOMMENDED.
They are very nice, never complained about the request that I had. Very professional. Well prepared too. And they did a wonderful job.  I would recommend him to anyone.

Well, I'll start with the fact that they had to come back because they attached the shelves to drywall without anchoring  (of course they came down when I placed something on the shelves), put baseboards on walls without nailing them to studs and created screens that did not fit property in windows.
On first visit they did not have the proper tools and had to borrow some from me.
All in all it was a horrible experience as they didn't do enough during the time that they were at my house and the things they did were mostly done incorrectly.

angi_reviews.text:
Metro builders help me recovering the bathroom and kitchen in one of my rental units after my tenant destroyed.
Install new cabinet, counter tops , tile floor, toilet, sink, all plumbing fixtures and painting.
10 days job and the unit is ready to rent again.
Thank you Erez and thank your professional workers.
Hop to see you soon.
Don.

It was mediocre. The first time the came out, they stripped out the drywall, patched it and painted, but they didn't wait for the interior of the wall to dry, so it needed to be redone. So, they had to come back and redo the work. It took them about 5 trips total to finish. They first did the initial repair, then had to rip it out and let the wall dry, then came back to replace the drywall, then to painted, and then to do some odd jobs that they were supposed to do the first time. They never tried to back out of their responsibility. It just took a long time to get everything done. Also, every time it was a different crew or worker who hadn't fully been explained the scope of the work and may not have had the appropriate supplies. They also didn't charge by the hour, even though the deal was for 6 man hours, so I didn't actually save any money on the deal.

Metro Builders is a large scale remodeling company. I believe they do not specialize in smaller scale work. I described my small job clearly before they came to my home to assess the job. In that meeting, I felt I was resisting the efforts to call them in the future for a larger scale project. I was not interested in a larger scale project and felt I had to insist on that before I received the time estimate for the scope of what I wanted to do.

angi_reviews.text:
I had mixed feelings about this company. Some of the work they did was fantastic. I love my new kitchen, the design is beautiful. Everyone was very punctual and professional and the job finished on schedule. The tiles were put in well but some caulking was missing which has caused issues around the sink.  

Most of my issues involved the painters that the company hired for another job in a rental property I own. They accidently threw away a medicine cabinet that I needed to return, breaking the mirror. They did reimburse me for it, but it was a mistake that shouldn't have occured. The painting work seemed rushed.

I do think that this company is a bit expensive. If I had to do this work again I would double check to see what was included. I felt like I paid for extras, out of pocket, that should have been covered by the contractors.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Dear [member name removed], First of all I would like to say that it was a great pleasure to work with you and we appreciate very much the business and the trust you gave in us. As you have mentioned on deferent occasions, we were one out of 7 to 10 companies you have interviewed for your projects, before making decision. We are very happy about the fact that you decided to work with us time after time for the last over 3 years. As I have mentioned in our telephone conversation, all our work is under full warranty and we are willing to fix anything related to our work till you are 100% satisfy and happy. All will be done at zero cost to you. We are deeply apologies for any inconvenience that it may have caused you and expecting to hear from ASAP to schedule a time to meet and address any issue.

angi_reviews.text: He came and gave me an estimate and he worked with me. I tried other companies, but they were very expensive. Best builders is very pleasant, and he has done a good job, and everything is to code. I am very happy with him. I know some things about construction, and he is giving me what I want. They gave me a fair price, and I see the work everyday. I can call him at any time of the day, and he calls me back.

I received 3 bids for this project.  From the very first interview with Roei, a partner I was impressed with his ability to advise on some ideas to save money and make the kitchen more efficient, he was very professional and never pushed me.   I hired him to start 7/31/13, he quoted 2 weeks, and it was completed in 2 weeks, and the cost was as quoted.   This was one of the best renovation experiences I have had in the 40 yrs I have lived in this house.   All the workers, were polite, on time, cleaned up after, and did really good work.  I would hire Best Builders again for any home projects and recommend them highly to anyone else looking for a good experience in renovating any part of their home.

We interviewed three contractors from different sources, Aaron was not the least expensive but his quote was more inline with expected budget. We hired Aaron and started construction on our new home, demo was quick we were ready for new foundations within a week, then we went into re - framing of existing structure, framing of new structures, cabanas decks, patios, etc. 6 months later we moved into our new home. At every step Aaron and his team were available to help manage expectations and avoid mishaps. Thanks Aaron.

They came to my house, I liked there presentation and professional approach.
Everything they promised was delivered on time and within budget.

 They were quick, efficient and nice to work with.
In general, it was a very good experience with a reliable company. I would highly recommend them to anyone who needs a quality work without someone who is trying to sell them something they do not need.

Best Builders & Development did my kitchen and 2.5 bathrooms complete remodeling. I am a very picky customer not easy to please. I met with several different providers before choosing Best Builders for my project. I am very happy with the job they have done in my house. Their team and the owner are professional, easy to work with, flexible, always on time, always listened and considered all my requests. My kitchen and my bathrooms look incredibly beautiful, everything done within budget.
I will defenitely recommend hiring Best Builders & Development for your project.

Simon, Giovanni and crew are very hard workers and try to please the customer.

King David and Jonathan gave me the best peace of mind during my project. The project managersand the whole production team in the office kept me in the loop of what was going to happen at my house every day, and I would receive a great weekly schedule from my project manager David  designed our beautiful bathroom and he worked with us all the way through to make sure everything ran smoothly from beginning to end. I was able to go to work and do other things and not have the construction at my house bother me in any way! King David gets the job done fast and efficiently and I couldn't have been any happier with another contractor. 
So happy with simon the owner
thank you simon

I was very nervous about making so many changes all at one time.  I like to cook and didn't want my kitchen torn up.  My husband and I met with David.  He was amazing.  Super professional and very knowledgeable.  His designs were incredible and really solidified how nice everything would look.  He stepped us through choosing materials and appliances and was even able to incorporate the exact models in his designs!!       David also somehow managed to time the kitchen projects so that I always had a functional kitchen.
The workers were polite and on time, and I appreciated that they were conscientious about not dragging dirt through the house.  David came by regularly to check up on the progress, and he was always available when we called with questions.  Everything was finished on time, and the house looks wonderful!  We are planning to have David and Jonathan back to do some landscaping and outdoor patio in the future!  Overall fantastic experience!

I bought the Angie's List deal ($500 for 16 hours of a contractor). We owed our neighbor a new fence as we ran a new gas line along their side of the fence. We bought the material and stained it ourselves, but unfortunately we did not notice that the planks were different sizes from the one we had on our side of the fence. King David sent out two guys for 8 hours and they ripped down each board to the correct size. The job ended up being much more complicated that we had thought but these guys really paid attention to the detail and the fence they put up in one day looks great. We would use them again.

top_complaint_summary: They have not finished work and have poor communication

angi_reviews.text: I met with owner and he went over all the details of the work and provided me with a quote. He examined the rooms...kitchen, living room, family room, dining room, stairway, and office.  He clearly explained the process, provided me a copy of his insurance coverage, and a written estimate. He performed the work as he promised. The crews were respectful and took care of my home. They work hard and keep things clean and tidy. They arrived exactly when they said they would and took great care to do the prep work such as laying down the drop cloth, taping plastic sheets over windows and cabinets, They also worked late when necessary to meet my schedule because I had to move out of my home. I like the fact that he recommended me to break down the job one step at a time for me to feel comfortable and perform really well. My home is a condo and we have an HOA. TLC works with me to meet any HOA's requirement. I would highly recommend TLC to anyone!

overall, the project went smoothly , the roof need to be fixed and reinforced in a few areas to hold the panels.  the panel installation went rather quickly. they need a few inspection by the city. however, the thing that took the longest was the utility company coming out to do the final inspection before the panels can be switched on. which was out of their control. so in the meantime they painted my home looks amazing. almost brand new.

Everything with the roofing portion and the installation of the solar panels went find. I had no issues. They had to get a permit from the city. The job was complete and panels were turned on and working for about 4 days. The project manager came out and said panels had to be turned off because Edison did not authorize them being turned on.

The job was completed on August 20 and I was told the paperwork was submitted on August 24 to Edison to get the solar panels turned on. After they were not, I contacted Edison who said they received no notice from TLC Home Improvement.

In addition, when I inquired about a $2000 credit that was in an advertisement in the Angie's List magazine (for any job over $8000), TLC Home Improvement refused to honor it.

I feel like I'm getting the run around. I paid $20,000 for something I am unable to use until they say I can turn them on.
Good.

My husband and I needed to do some painting to our home by UCLA, we decided to rent it out to some students but the last time it was painted was 15 years ago. so we called a few people and found TLC and they caught our eye almost immediately. they did the complete outside and inside of the house. they did an amazing job it took about 2 weeks for the whole project because we had things to move around inside the home. but now it looks like when we first bought the home. i will definitely use them again.
Their work is sloppy. They still have not come back to finish their work. I have called numerous times in the last couple weeks and still have not heard anything back. I would not recommend them.

angi_reviews.text: As I mentioned above, great crew. Quite happy with the guys signed to us, lovely friendly people with very capable project manager, Steve. Quite experienced guy with years in business behind him and still full of energy and detail oriented. They were doing great while I was there and as they finished everything in the schedule I must say they did great overall. I'm quite happy with them. Roofing went off pretty fast. Routine work for them and happy feelings for me. New look was rising up day by day. More happy feelings for me and my family. We barely felt such a big project on our house but they were moving out old pieces and bringing new step by step. Very efficient. That would sum it up. Great experience with TLC.

The Jon went very well, work was done in very orderly professional manner.  There was one a minor issue that was reworked with no problems. I highly recommend TLC, I will be working with them again in the future.

The project manager was very nice, and most importantly they were not pushy. That is rare, compared to the other companies that came out and bid. That's why we decided to go with TLC. The project manager was there everyday. He answered all of our questions and concerns.  The guys were very nice. When the job was done, I thought there would be a little clean-up after they left. I was surprised to find not one trace that we had the roof done. The clean-up was amazing. I am and will definitely use TLC for any more projects that I have.

The price was well over $12000 for the roof and I also got a couple of things done. The job went well. They did a good job. They were very accommodating with everything I needed. So I was impressed with that. They were pretty quick and I have no complaints. I didn?t get too many other quotes and so I don?t know about their price. They were pretty punctual. Their responsiveness was pretty good.
i am a happy customer

mapquest_reviews.text: Yah know, I've just gotta say, the first job I hired Gene for was windows and it went smoothly and as expected. After he rightfully had earned some confidence I've just got to say the next job,...

angi_reviews.text: I hired Gene and All American Traditions  to remodel my kitchen and two bathrooms last November.  The worked started out great.  We were happy with the work and the attention to detail.  However, we soon became unhappy when the quality of work began to slide when a new crew was brought in.  We had some issues with the project manager and while the work was finished, it took much longer than it should have since Gene did not have enough workers to work on our house as well as his other projects. There were several weeks when the workers came only once or twice during the week.   We tried to contact Gene numerous times and very rarely did he respond.  The end product came out nice, but the process was very nerve wracking and caused a lot of stress and sleepless nights on our parts.

Asked for $9,000 additional after initial $1000 deposit for kitchen remodel. Abandoned job after 2 days' demolition saying our contract (signed 2 months before work began) was not valid as Blankenship did not sign it (his partner did.) Owes us $8,000 refund which has not been paid to date.

Well I have heard nightmares about contractors and. Was hesitant to start a project but I felt comfortable from the first day they starting working very clean and professional and they did an amazing job on our kitchen I have reffered them to my neighbors and they are doing theier house soon im so glad I used them and we are calling them back to do our bathroom.
They did everything for me and in a timely fashion.  They shopped, installed everything, and did the plumbing.  They did an absolutely beautiful job. I'm thrilled.

From start to finish i was satisfied with the estimate the planned work and work performed.  Gene was honest and straightforward and the work was completed as per the contract. During the construction process I noted some things not up to par and they were quickly fixed as soon as I brought them to Gene's attention.   I have several rental properties and am not new to the  construction process and I consider the completed work to be of high quality.  I  highly recommend All American Traditions!
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Hi (Members names removed), I would like to thank you for your business and I really hope you enjoy your new kitchen. Gene

angi_reviews.text: Sorry wrote review for wrong co.  Meant to do Danmer Shutters.
The quality of work came out very, very  well.  The workers were all very friendly and courteous.  They weren't always punctual...sometimes they showed up a little late.

Other than being without a kitchen, I think the whole project was not as bad as you have heard stories about. The contractor, Gene, was on site quite often to check on the progress and often made gofer runs to pick up needed materials. The employees Eric and Jose were dedicated to getting the job done and spent many late hours , always making sure the work place was cleaned up.

The work was very well done, but the cleanup was a bit lacking.  They cut a hole in the first floor bathroom ceiling to get at the pipes.  They repaired the hole, but did not clean up the drywall dust that was everywhere in the first floor bathroom.
Everything went great.  I love the new bathrooms and so do the tenants.

When they first came in they covered my floors and carpet before they started any work. They were very respectful of our home.
We couldn't be happier with their work. The guys were just wonderful!

They came the first day started taking out some dirt  got it ready for the cement poured the cement and putting stones in place and they hauled the dirt away came back  and continued working finished what they could that day cleaned up and returned the following day to finish job and cleaned up everything. I am very pleased with the outcome.
The project went smoothly despite a few bumps in the road.  It was a wonderful experience to work with Gene and his crew.

Went great. Gene was easy going and relaxed. Provided an estimate and stuck to it. Did the work on time - removed my old counter on Tuesday and had the new ones custom made during the week and installed on Saturday. Kitchen looks great.

top_complaint_summary: Overcharged by $47

angi_reviews.text: Everything turned out just like the designer showed it to us on the computer

Sky renovation was easy to communicate with. They were punctual and very attentive to all our needs and concerns. I was very pleased with their advice and appreciated their honesty in creating a working design that fit our needs. Finally, we never felt that they were trying to "up-sell" us on more expensive designs or work that was not necessary. I will be working with them again.
highly recommend Tomas and Sky Renovation to anyone looking for a reputable, professional and honest company.

Tomas was amazing from the appointment till the end of my project. Always kept me informed of what was happening at the house. Work was finished before agreed upon completion date. I will be using them in the future and would recommend them anytime.
Purchased for house and needs to do a complete remodel. I loved Ian. He was professional and had great ideas. Work was done quickly & efficiently and a month later my house was ready.

Cannot say enough about contractor Ron Zagury and his crew and the job they did replacing kitchen floor and renovating a bathroom.   The crew was prompt, professional and polite.  They put in a full day's work every day and cleaned up every night before leaving.  Ron was always available if we had questions or concerns about any aspect of the projects..He went above and beyond to insure that our projects were completed to our satisfaction on budget and on time. We couldn't be happier with the end results and would definitely hire Ron and Sky Renovation for any future projects.

The good:
Sales and design meeting were professional and they understood my needs and budget. "Free" Design was beautiful.
Custom cabinets of good quality.
Most subcontractors were punctual and professional (carpenter,electritian, plumbing, drywall, paint, counter install).
Returned to resolve unsatisfactory workmanship.

The bad:
Complete lack of attention to detail which caused several call backs during the process.
Project manager visited site Very infrequently to check progress leaving micromanagement up to me the homeowner.
Quoted with 4 week completion- turned into 10 weeks.
Debris left on the job regularly and at completion.
Asked for "warranty" paperwork and proof of counter material weeks ago- I still don't have it.

Work was completed before given time frame. Service was great! The crew came on time every day and cleaned after they left. The communication with Tom, our project manager was punctual and very helpful. We were kept upto date daily, Tom would come and monitor the project on a daily basis. He listened to our wishes and concerns and was very Kind and respectful. We are very happy with the out come. They were very detail oriented so everything looks amazing. We defiantly got more value for what we spend. Construction at your home is never easy and there were days that we had to face a lot of challenges, but they were on top of things and always took care of any issue that came along. I found my to go to contractor. Recommend them highly

angi_reviews.business_response_text: [member name removed], Thank you for your review, good or bad, it helps us getting better. I'd like to make 1 point very clear, never did i raised my price with no reason. The price went up by 2500 because in our first meeting you did not mentioned anything about wanting to have the finished look to go up the stairs but only requested to build the closet and cabinets below. The fact the project took longer than expected was because of a very simple reason, every time I wanted to schedule the crew i had to do it with you, your husband (who is very busy with his work and couldn't open the door for us before later in the afternoon) and your dogs that we needed your husband to put them away because some of them are not very friendly with strangers. I am always sorry to see an unhappy customer and you are in specific because i tried so much to accommodate you in so many areas but i guess sometimes it's not enough. Thank you, Ian

angi_reviews.text:
Ian was prompt, easy to talk to and explained to me what was going on with my roof by taking photos with his phone and showing me details of what the problems were.
Smart use of technology and reassurinmg that he wasn't just telling a story.

They job was done at my rental property. They called me to ask for access to the inside of the house and I told them they didn’t need to go inside since it was a maintenance package for the roof. They never followed up with me to let me know what repairs where done or provide me awith n estimate of what may need to be done. I do not even know if I got anything for my money.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: [member name removed] In the deal detail you purchased it states the the "Home owner needs to be present during the time of the maintenance" in order to avoid situations like that one. I'm sorry for you feeling like our service deserves an 'F' - I strongly believe that if you were present at the time we scheduled or at any other project we performed, you would think differently.

angi_reviews.text: unknown

angi_reviews.business_response_text: Thank you for taking the time to give us your review. Good or bad, we try to learn and get better. I would like to point out 2 things. We didn't try to 'sell' you, your roof is beyond repairable and must be replaced. I understand how news like that can be upsetting and interpreted as an attempted to Sell you something. Payment for those deals are made directly to Angie's list, we have no control over refund requests and such.... Hope you're doing well and wishing you long lasting roof.

angi_reviews.text:
Ian arrived a little before he was scheduled to (always a plus) and was a true professional.  He went over his findings with me and fully explained the work that he recommended be done.  He showed me pictures of each area that needed repairs.  There was never any pressure to have all the work done - he simply told me which ones were higher priority and could lead to more damage and which ones were not as urgent. I decided to have all of the work done and we set the follow up date.  On that date he showed up on time and took care of all the repairs.
I was incredibly impressed with his style, professionalism and service.  I would highly recommend Ian and he is now my 'go to' guy when it comes to any type of roof repair.
Thank you for a wonderful experience Ian!!!!!

Ian, one of the 3 brothers who own this company, came to my home to assess my roof. He was very professional and easy to understand when he described the condition of my roof. His estimate of costs appeared fair in light of the poor condition of the roof. His workers arrived on time, cleaned up everyday and finished the job earlier as Ian had put on a double crew which with the loud hammering overhead, I was extremely grateful. Although there were additional problems which came to light after the job was started, Ian kept with his original estimate.
Very polite, punctual and professional. Advised me of a few minor roofing issues. Very good experience overall.
Thorough, professional.

The color of my house is white (well...suppose to) but because I live in a high traffic area it became very dirty and almost black.
Ian and his crew came with a high power washing machine and cleaned everything. My house is white again!!!

Used big 3 before and never thought about using someone else.

Decor Home Builders did a great job. In taking over from the 1st contractor who did a very bad job, alots of mistakes creating alots of problems not following what was in the buliding plans. It was a very bad expeience and caused alot of stress, money and time. Decor Home Builders came in and took over the project and we were so pleased with their professional skills, talent and work habits. We are so happy and thankful that everything turned out so well. As of today we are using Decor Home Building in remodeling our 2nd home.
Thank you again Decor Home Building your the best :)

I interviewed 4 contractors, Yossi gave me the best bid. He started and finished the job within the time he had promised. I usually have my house custom built and I have horror stories to mention. I did not think there were people like Yossi around any longer. His crew cleaned everything at the end of each day. They all spoke English and Yossi supervised the job on a daily basis. It was a wonderful experience for change. I recommend him very highly.

Yossi previously did a complete remodelling of our kitchen, and after completing our gourmet kitchen we were so pleased in all respects that we asked him to remodel our bathroom - no other estimates necessary. He was amazingly talented at design and helping us design a custom bathroom down to the last detail, including a steam shower, heated floors, beautiful mirrors and custom designed cabinets.  His work was flawless, he was on the job continuously, and his team of artisans were skilled and friendly to work with, not to mention right on time.  I have no criticisms of any aspect of his work.  He is the best as far as I and my wife are concerned.

Yossi provided a high-quality service with excellent communication and a positive experience.
Highly recommends Yossi for his exceptional professionalism and work quality
Very satisfied with price

angi_reviews.text: They promised to provide good service. We had agreed upon what would be done and the material prior to 09/05/2014. They said they could do all of it under the Big Deal I had purchased through Angie's List. They did not show up when they were supposed to. I had to pay more than what was agreed upon. They started out so professional and then backed out on what we had agreed upon. Very unprofessional and very frustrating. I would not recommend them to anyone.  They did not even do the work themselves, They hired outside of their company. The workers told me they were charging me too much. The people that did the actual work were wonderful. But this contractor was horrible.
unknown
unknown

The site visit went fine but there was no followup.  The Angie's deal said they would prepare plans.  For $50, I wasn't expecting much but it seemed like they lost all interest when I expressed interest in moving along slowly rather than a big project immediately.

They were good. There was an issue initially in the scheduling. But other than that everything went fine. The gentleman who handled us was very informative. He knew his stuff and emailed me the print of what he has come up with and with his suggestions. I have no complaints at all about the company.
Okay.. Diagram was provided by contractor not architect. Nothing very special.  He was professional and trustworthy, but I didn't feel the results were very creative.
They did a good job and had some good ideas.

The service did not go so well. He left the door to his vehicle open indicating he did not plan on spending much time with me. He did not seem professional at all. I feel like the guy sent out was part of their regular crew or very knowledgeable about what I needed. He was only out for about 10 minutes. I never received the design or plans that I had purchased. I had no problem scheduling the deal, but I feel like I did not get my money’s worth at all.
Terrible, never again with this company.

I set up the appointment with Jeanette, who was incredibly friendly and pleasant each time I spoke with her.  Unfortunately I don't recall the name of the gentleman who came by to discuss our yard options, but he was throrough, knowledgeable, very friendly, and was an excellent listener, hearing what we wanted to do rather than pushing ideas of what he wanted to do.  He was also willing to propose different options based on our budget.  I think we will be looking at using Turf Terminators to transition to a hardscape, but I would absolutely love to use Tip Top once the hardscape is in place for some accent landscaping.  It was a true pleasure working with them!

This 1-hour backyard landscaping consultation was helpful and gave us a better sense of our options for improving our drainage, retaining walls, and vegetation. We ended up deciding not to pursue further landscaping work at the present time, but we may do so in the future.

The original appointment had to be rearranged due to the provider falling ill. On the new day he turned up on time and was friendly, professional and helpful. There was a big gap, however, between the cost to implement the plans he came up with and the amount of money I had for the project. This meant there never any chance of our doing business together but the provider did leave me with a sketch of how my yard could end up looking.
unknown
unknown
unknown

It went well. He spent time with me providing a blueprint of possibilities for my exterior landscaping. He was at the home for about an hour to an hour and a half. The only problem with the experience is that we had to schedule/reschedule. We scheduled a month in advance, and he was sick and couldn’t make it. They called me up and asked if I could come immediately (the same day) and I wanted to stick to the schedule we’d set up the 2nd time. It seemed a little unprofessional.
It didn't go too well. The sketch was of very poor quality and done very quickly. He said he would get back to me with plan samples, but he never did. It was more advertisement than service.

They came by an hour late twice. Their estimate for the project was 2x higher than other bids. They made me feel that my project was not big enough for them to do. He did have interesting ideas, but when I asked for the bid on the project, he became frustrated and a bit aggresive. When I declined to have them do the job, I started recieving phone calls from other contractors to do the job and do not appreciate that. They did come back a third time with the owner of the company, and provided a more accurate estimate and told me the original person who I delt with that provided the estimate had since been laid off.

angi_reviews.text:
David first came by to inspect the kitchen area.  It was larger than the area covered by the deal but the additional area was quoted at the same price so the whole area was included. We arranged for the work to begin a week later. I then chose the ceramic tile from several samples.
The contractors showed up promptly at the appointment a week later.  They had to make a trip to Home Depot first.  Upon returning, they began the work of removing the linoleum tile.  For about three hours, they worked on removal and installing the ceramic tile.
They were short a few tiles so they had to return a couple of days later.  The contractor called ahead and arrived timely. The remaining area was completed in about an hour.
Very happy with the finished look!
Overall the tile looks beautiful.  The job took 2 days longer than expected and the crew could have done a better job of clean up.  The tile work itself is lovely.
I was able to provide them with the cabinets and they installed them. They cleaned up everyday and they were extremely professional. They also did some drywall work.

It went Great.  I was pleased that i found them for my complete kitchen remodel.  They are very professional, easy to work with in the new layout process with 3d design and demolition, and installation.  The workers were corteous and helpful during contrusction process, especially if I had an extra request and the price was the best.

 from A papmered chef in Los Angeles.

Everything went extremely well. I purchased a Big Deal from Angie's List for this work, and they actually contacted me to schedule the appointment. They were very professional, and cleaned up at the end of every day. They were always on time, and they never tried to upsell me. When David came to do the work, he was great about just doing the one job that I asked him to do. The floor looks fantastic, and I'm using them in the future to do work on my kitchen.

Living in my home for over thirty years. The expert that came by explained everything in detail. They did a great job on my kitchen and bathroom and provided great value for the amount of work it required. They were able to accommodate my scope change of the project. They gave me great quality work and I couldn't be happier with the service. If anything, they exceeded my expectations.

Good. Company is professional and aims to please the customer. They know there way around in the construction world and will do whatever is required to get the job done right. Many years of experience.

I am really excited on the outcome of my project. Took a total of 10 days to complete. They covered everywhere when doing the demo. It was very convenient to have to only deal with one contractor who brought the plumber, electrician and even helped me choose the tile. The guys are very professional and spoke English. I love my bathroom and highly recommend GMS remodeling!!
