angi_reviews.text: This is a servicer provider that does work in the city of LA without pulling a permit. The carport he built has been cited as not having a permit. He is refusing to pull a permit for me stating it is my responsibility. He never verbally explained to me that pulling a permit was my responsibility. I was told by a professional that the shingles he installed on the roof are not up to code and were installed incorrectly. They need to be replaced because there is water collecting on the top of the carport. He is ignoring my request to come over to my house and replace the shingles. This provider is unprofessional and tries to pretend he does not understand English. I would never hire this company again because he does work without pulling permits which is illegal in LA and refuses to fix his mistakes.
unknown
Did it quickly and well left a little mess under the sink but good job overall

Two techs showed up .  Plumbing took a while to install and the closet door was not completed because the glue needed to dry.  Needed a special glue and my son went to buy it so had to wait for it . I asked if they needed some newspapers to lay the door on while it was being glued he said no .  Some of the glue did get on my bedroom carpet. Well the door is still not installed because we could not get it in and I don't iknow if want to call them back.
unknown
He was great. I would call on him again.
unknown
unknown
unknown

I purchased the coupon for 189.00 for two technicians and they worked the two hours. It ended up being an addtional hour of work due to the hole they had to drill for the overflow.  Very happy with the work performed, cleanup and the price was really great even with the additional hour needed.  I will definitely hire again for more jobs needed done around my home.

The two hours went very well, Juan and Julio were very professional, friendly and efficient. They actually got through more of my to-do list than I had thought was possible in the two hours booked.
The securing of furniture to walls was our main reason for calling. We simply hadn't had time to do it ourselves. These gentlemen left me with a big sigh of relief that our home is much safer now for our little one who is crawling, standing and getting into everything!
I will definitely call E B Specialist Handyman Service again.

a burglar used a pry bar to break into our house. . . ruined the framing for the door as well as the lock.  called EB and they came within four hours and stayed until they had finished the job. . . Wilfredo went to Home Depot for supplies and Julio stayed behind and prepped the area for new wood and lock, when he was finished he did many small odd jobs that had been bothering us. . . it was great.  We got our door fixed, a new lock (keyed to our front door) and lots of other things finished. They cleaned up the area before they left!  The price was very fair and we are happy with their work and appreciate them coming on such short notice.  We will definitely call them again when we have another list of "to do" jobs that are beyond our capabilities.

They hung a microwave above my stove. They had to alter the cabinets and although it doesn't look like a custom job it is functional.
They were professional I would hire them again to do work at my home.

It was an Angie's List Big Deal that we purchased. It was excellent. The faucet works and we were happy with it. The installation went well. He came out immediately. There were no additional charges. We would absolutely use them again.

Julio arrived early to install our new Toto toilet.  He was quick, efficient and clean.  Honestly, after watching a few YouTube videos, I was thinking about tackling a DIY project to install the toilet, but this was money well spent as it was done 5x faster and cleaner than I would have done.  
Highly recommend them for any handyman projects in the future.
Everything was fine, they did good work. They were on time and all the work was done well. The price was reasonable and I have no complaints at all.

Wilfredo arrived exactly on time for the estimate.  He carefully looked at the work to be performed and gave me a verbal estimate.  He followed with a written e-mailed estimate the same day.
On the day of the work, he arrived exactly on time with two workmen.  He again went over the scope of the work to be performed with me.  The workmen performed exactly as I would have expected -- they were meticulous, worked hard, and cleaned up at the end of the day.
When the job was completed, Wilfredo went over what had been done with me.  The work was to my complete satisfaction.
These guys were great.  They arrived on time, cleaned up after themselves and did a great job.  I will definitely use them again when I have some other jobs.  I would not hesitate to recommend them.
They arrived on time and were able to complete the job of installing a faucet I had already purchased.  NO problems with the faucet since then.
I'm very happy with the service. I have them come back several times for other things. I'm very happy with them.
unknown
They did a great job; on time and on budget.  They quoted a fair price, were willing to reduce the price slightly to get to my budget, and they delivered.

angi_reviews.text: The service went very well. The technicians a did a great job and the pricing was very reasonable. They just did a partial remodel and did exactly what I needed. They had great communication skills, were very quick and great with clean up afterwards. I had no issues with scheduling.

What they promised and what they planned to deliver were two different things.  Eventually, we were able to ge twhat we expected.  However, it required a tremendous amount of patience and perserverance.  We had to get the owner (Joseph) involved, and only after threatening to withhold payment, was the job completed the way it was promised.  We were pleased with the final result, but felt pretty beat up by the process.  Part of the problem may be cultural differences in style of communication.  Joseph seems to have high values and expectations, but he suggested that our crew was not yet up to the high bar he sets for his company.  We do love our kitchen.

Based on Joseph and the crew it went beautifully. They cleaned up very well. What made me really happy is that main contact was always available and is a very dedicated worker. Joseph checked on the job daily. Very trustworthy staff.

Joseph took care of the requirements on the permits with the city and the home owners assc. This took a lot of weight off our backs. The bottom line to this story is that we started with My Design Remodeling because they were very competitively priced. We continued with them because of the excellent work we saw on the bath rooms. We are happy with the results and the experience in general because Joseph is a very hands on owner. He was there to help get it done the way we wanted.   My Design Remodeling is now working on some projects at our daughter's house. She is just a please as we were.

angi_reviews.text: It was a job well done. Jake was very up-front about the pricing and what to expect, and was very good about coordinating with my plumber and electrician. They removed the other countertops without problem. They measured well for the installation. They weren’t the cheapest, but I really thought that their workers were very good. They cleaned up after themselves very nicely. I would certainly use them again, if I needed it and if I it worked in to my budget.

The deck in the front porch is pretty good; the painting looks fine and I think the guy was trying pretty hard but there were a few places where there was some wood that probably should have been replaced but they just painted over it.  They were pretty responsive and they did try to come out and make sure that the job was done right.  I would probably consider getting a bid from them in the future.

i met Jerry the project manager at the beginninghe explain to me very careful and showed me some samples about my kitchenafter we choose the right things to my kitchen the guys came to my house to start the jobeverything was very good with the workers and i really like the result of my new kitchen, it came even nicer than i expectedalso the workers left my house very clean before they leftover all i'm very happy and want to thank Jerry and the workers from Superior for all that they did for me
Superior Construction and Remodeling Inc. were fantastic. They were fast and finished in time. Their foreman always kept in contact with me. I would use them again in the future.

Our project manager, Jake, was great in ensuring that we knew what to expect as the project progressed.  We had to be out of town during part of the project and were pleased to return home to a nearly completed project.  Things were clean and done very well. Any questions we had were immediately answered to our satisfaction.

Our project manager Jake was very professional and helpful throughout the process. We started the demolition and followed the steps of the project as was explained to us during our consultation.  The crew was on time and cleaned up after themselves everyday.  After speaking with a property manage regarding the project we realized that the cost of our project was more than fair. We were very happy with the results and will use them again in future projects.

From the start Jake, our project manager provided professional, expert, and curtious advise, insight, and a keen eye on the project.
At any time we had a question or concern, Jake would respond promptly and have our issues delt with. As each phase of the was completed he would, with us, inspect the quality of of the work performed and would even catch items we missed.
Perfect! Everything went better then expected,

With their help and suggestions, I managed to maximize the space in my kitchen so that I have more counter and cabinet space, without moving any walls.   They said they would finish in 4 weeks and they did!  I got many helpful suggestions from the designer who knew better what I needed than I did.   I love the "Strawberry blond" cabinets and matching granite, and I love my extra deep stainless steel sink. All the cabinetry works perfectly and  looks looks perfect as well.  I got lazy Susan cabinets to utilize my corner space. All my drawers slide out smoothly.  The men who came to my house were professional and pleasant.They arrived on time and were willing to work with my schedule. I would highly recommend their service, and if you saw my kitchen, you would too!

jake the project manger came to see the house explain the prosess in to details and gave us an estimate later the week the guys started the water blast and continue the proses until the job was done a very good and friendly experience  always on time and very clean we are very happy

2 days after we signed the contract they were all ready to start the job. The workers were very nice & clean and came every morning at 8am and started working with no delays. They finished the whole bathroom in less than 2 weeks and the job was perfect. Our manager was Jake and he came almost every day to check up with the progress of the work and to make sure we are satisfied with the result.
At the end of the project the workers cleaned all the mess and left the house spotless.
We are very satisfied with the result and i will sure use this company to my next project.

Very sloppy work, have had to have them come back 3 times so far to correct errors. Very expensive. Didnt cleanup well, left broken tiles all over. Spoke with worker and their workers make $8.00 an hour. Unprofessional work.

angi_reviews.text: I just picked up my rug a few days ago and it looks like new! The repair work was done all by hand and came out so nice. The rug cleaning is even better than their repair work! They actually managed to get all of the stains out of my rugs! It has such a nice shine to it and it feels so soft again. I really could not be happier which is why I am writing this review. Dr. Kay and Kash did a great job. I am bringing another rug to them next week for them to take care of for me.

I found them online, and spoke with Kash who is a master rug cleaner. He was so kind and so professional in his job. He explained their 10-step rug cleaning process, and this was exactly what I was looking for. I dropped off my rug, and picked it up after I received their phone call. My rug looked and felt fresh again. I am very happy with this company.

First I looked up online and found Los Angeles Rug Cleaning. Then I called in and Kash explained their 10-step process that I liked. I dropped off my dirty, smelly 8x10 Shag rug. I picked it up after two weeks; it looked like a brand new rug and it felt fresh. They gave me some tips on how to vacuum and maintain it. I love Los Angeles rug Cleaning's professionalism. Kash also gave me a small book called " Carpet  Cleaning For Dummies" which is full of simple instructions on care and maintenance of carpets and rugs. I  could not be happier. I recommend this company highly.

I had waited some time to have the rug cleaned, and with a dog, the rug was quit dirty. When I called to arrange to have the rug picked up, they were extremely accommodating and we're able to pick up the rug the following day. They were very professional, analyzed the extent of soil on the rug and quoted a fair price. They also offered to apply a soil retardant, which I agreed to given our dog. When they finished the job, they called to schedule the delivery, and again accommodated my schedule. They did a terrific job. The rug looks like new!

I had to help him remove the carpet , moving furniture and rolling it up- a sign that this was less than professional, but I ignored the voice in my head.  The carpet was returned 2 weeks later, with minimal improvement. I told him I was disappointed and he blamed the quality of the rug. I asked if he could negotiate  the price, he declined. I paid.  I have attached a photo of one of the spots.  If he had just told me it was not worth fixing, I would have listened.

top_complaint_summary: Overpriced service

angi_reviews.text: They did a very good job but the paint job was a little sloppy since they didn’t really clean up after themselves that well which I don’t think is that important unless they do the work well. I would also like to say that I have never met a contractor that deserves to be rated highly since there is always room for improvement.

They are nice and they started the work on a Friday, following Thanksgiving.  My overall experience so far has been good.  They quality of work has been good and they are punctual most of the times.  Their professionalism has been fine and I will use them again in the future.

They were on time.  They finished in a day.  They came back two days later to check the job.  The person that came to check the job thought he should do something else.  He wasn’t satisfied and so he put in some newer shingles adjacent to where they did the repair and extended the area.  He did it at no extra charge.  I would have liked their price to be a little less expensive but I don’t know what the going rate is either.  I had several other estimates and theirs was in the middle.
They are very honest! I used them for everything once I figured out how great of a company!
I can't explain in 3000 characters how a $300,000 job went wrong, but it went REALLY wrong and it's taken 2 1/2 years and another 250,000 - 300,000 to fix it. I have details and I have photos.
They estimated it would take 6 weeks and it was actually done a little ahead of schedule. I am very happy. Everything looks beautiful. I couldn't be happier.

I hired a contractor initially who demolished my kitchen and left me "hanging" for five weeks wanting more money and not committing to anything. Once again, I began the tedious search of a new contractor. Universal came along and was sent from heaven. From the get go they were very understanding and never took advantage of my situation. I started with the addition first and wanted to make sure everything went the way I wanted to. I ended doing the cabinets and all the finish work in my bathroom, kitchen and my house. Universal took money as the job progressed and not up front. The whole job went on schedule and even finished before time. Workers were nice and clean and even when I wanted to make some changes Universal worked with me and came up with great designs. I feel like I owe Universal a great gratitude for coming through after I've been cheated by another company. I have recommended Universal to my family and friends and anyone else who is looking for a solid company.

The first time it rained, our roof leaked. I called them many times. They just did not come back here to fix it. They had not sealed it properly around a vent. It ruined the hardwood floors. I was planning on replacing them anyway but couldn t until the roof got repaired. It was six months before they fixed it. I had to make a complaint with the BBB and another agency first. It was only after I did that they came back. They were the lowest bid and they seemed professional, that is why I chose them.

I was impressed with the quality of the job. The tile is beautiful in the bathroom and they really made the whole thing look nice, but I think that they charged way too much. The whole project was done in a fair amount of time and the workers were friendly. I would not be able to use this company because again of the price. I did not think it was a fair price.

We had to supervise the subcontractors, since their was no foreman on the job. When we voiced our concerns, they seemed very disinterested. The original schedule of 1 month got dragged out close to 3 months, because of their over sites. They left trash in front of our house for over a month. Tried many times to get a revised schedule and never received one. We felt like once the schedule hit a snag, that they had moved on and didnt care about finishing the project in a timely manner, when there was so little to complete. Sometimes calls were never returned and we had to follow-up with them all the time. They would say workers would be on site, and then they never showed and no one called to tell us. Many problems, lies and bad customer service.

I was very disappointed with the completion of my kitchen. I feel I overpaid for what I got. I am now having problems with my sink. Every time I run my dish-washer, water leaks under my sink. It has happened so many times that now the floor is starting to buckle. The first week I went to get something out of my pantry, I pulled the drawer out and the whole drawer fell out and off the rails. All my canned goods fell out and on my new floors. The rails that hold the drawer were all twisted. The company came and replaced the rails, but put the same type back in. I asked if they didn't have a heavier-duty type and they said this was heavy duty. I now don't keep my canned goods in the pantry because the drawer won't support the weight. I'm very disappointed with what I got for the money I paid. I feel I got inferior quality material and workmanship and paid a premium price. I feel that I did not get what I paid for. Kitchen remodels are expensive, but you should get what you pay for.

WE HIRED THIS COMPANY IN BETWEEN RAINY WEEKS THIS WINTER.  THEY TOOK TOO LONG TO COMPLETE THE JOB AND DID NOT MEET MY EXPECTATIONS.  WE ALMOST HAD RAIN IN OUR HOUSE BECAUSE THEY GOT THE ROOF ON JUST ONE DAY BEFORE THE PREDICTED RAIN STARTED.

THE PROJECT MANAGER PROMPTLY RETURNED PHONE CALLS.  THE WORKERS WERE ALL POLITE.  THEY CLEANED UP AFTER THEMSELVES EVERYDAY.  VERY PROFESSIONAL.  WE WERE EXTREMELY PLEASED WITH THEIR WORK AND WORK HABITS.

angi_reviews.text: They had to come back and redo it. The initial person who came out was not very professional. She was the salesperson as well as the provider and was always in a hurry to get somewhere and was kind of condescending. They were not very good communicators.

They ran into some problems originally because my concrete still had moisture in it. They actually re-did the whole job and didn't charge me an extra cent. The result is a beautiful polished floor that I hope to enjoy for years to come!
It took 3 days which is exactly what was quoted. Great communication through the project.
The work was great. It's absolutely beautiful. The guys at Val-Arm really know what they are doing.
Val-arm ground the concrete Down to expose large aggregate rocks in the slab and then polished to a high sheen.  It's absolutely awesome.  Thanks guys great job.

Val-Arm came out to my house on short notice and provided an accurate quote to restore the concrete on my driveway, my porch, and the walkway around the front of my home. The house is for sale and they were able to scheduling me quickly and work around a couple of showings. There workers were very professional and answered all of my questions.
The work itself is absolutely stunning. I had no idea that my cracked concrete could be made to look so amazing without replacing everything. Their process is fairly simple in that they make cuts into the concrete, fill large cracks, grind any rough spots, power wash, then stain the concrete. The final result looks like custom concrete paving slabs or concrete stamps.
Initial concrete leveling and crack repair - provided follow up to a previous job and offered to return in the future if ever a need for any minor repairs.

They're overpriced.  They actually did the work but I expected more work out of them.  What they did was okay but for what they charged; I felt ripped off.  They were there for about three and a half or four hours.  They called back and said they're going to come back and finish the work and I contacted them but they never came back.  It wasn't really done to my satisfaction.  Most of the working that they were supposed to was overpriced and they lack integrity.

Working with Val-Arm was a breeze. They are very professional, pleasant to work with, and provided excellent service. We would definitely use them again for other concrete work. We are happy customers.

They scheduled an appointment for the quote and were timely and got me the quote the same day by emial.  They were not only the least expensive, they were available the soonest to do the work and they also seemed to be the most knowledgeable on the best way to fix the problems.  They did the work in less than a day and then came back after it dried to smooth down any rough areas.  The were punctual, cleaned the area after work and were very professional.  They also said that if we have any issues when we are laying the hardwood floors to call them and they will come over if anything areas need to be smoothed out.  I have had some bad experiences with contractors recently so i was a little worried by they were great.   I will definitely call them when I am ready for other concrete work.

Was very pleased with Val-ARM's service.  Co owner Francesca was prompt & very professional when we met and she inspected property.  As she promised, I had an estimate from her in one week's time.  She then brought two workers out with her several days before work was scheduled just to verify scope of job.  They saw a few complications & estimated more hours to complete but Francesca honored her original estimate to me!  The work was done on time & looks great.  All debris including dead tree roots were removed from the premises & I have peace of mind now that the backyard concrete patios are safe as well as attractive.  Val-Arm was several thousand dollars below another co's bid, which frankly was for less work.  Obviously Val-Arm wanted the job.
Showed on time, finished on time, cleaned up completely -- and it looks great! Received lots of compliments! Great service!

The service was perfect.This is the second time using Val-Arm and I must say I was not disappointed. Once again their concrete resurfacing work was fantastic. The outcome was amazing, price very competitive and they were able to accommodate my family's schedule. They definitely proved to be a first class company. If you want a job done right don't hesitate to call Armando at Val-Arm. I can't express enough praise for Sergio who is in my opinion an artist the work he did for me both times turned out beautiful.
responded quickly, came out and did the work without a hitch. very happy with the results.

angi_reviews.text: I own a 4 -unit apt. building in which the previous owners did un-permitted construction, so I was cited by the Los Angeles housing dept. to bring the whole building up to code. I worked with Eli and Uzi and explained my predicament. They immediately made me feel at ease and said that this was nothing to stress about and told me they would take care of everything and handle the building inspectors. The time frame was 3 weeks at the most and they kept to the schedule exactly. They were prompt, professional and easy to get along with. They handled the inspector with finesse and won him over, which is very important. They saved me from lots of drawn out drama with the city. THANK YOU!!

Fantastic. Frank and Jr were our crew, and they were fantastic.  Everything went up smoothly and quickly, and stayed in budget. Eli was always available by phone for questions, and Frank was extremely knowledgeable and friendly. They both were very accommodating when we were changing our minds on design, and helped us think of the advantages and disadvantages of our changes. Frank even helped teach my husband how to build a fence while they were working on the deck. I couldn't recommend a better team. Will definitely use them again.

review_sentiment.summary: Customer praises the service team's professionalism, communication, and ability to manage the complex situation with the housing department.
Excellent customer service and adaptability from the team.

angi_reviews.text: We first used SCCCI more than 20 years ago for exterior coating and window retrofitting services. Because their work was professionally completed then and held up very well over the years, we elected to use them again. Again, we found the quality of their work to be high, and their responsiveness to concerns prompt and courteous. While it may have been less expensive to work directly with painting and window subcontractors, which also would have allowed us to use a different window manufacturer, the overall project price and quality of the windows used were reasonable enough to make it worth paying a little extra to have the whole project coordinated and guaranteed by SCCCI, whom we know stands behind their work, even after more than 20 years.

I love working with Mike (Sales) and supporting knowledgeable office staff. More importantly, I really like the detail and meticulous work their painters do, especially Jose and Juan team! Showed up prompt and worked full day, kept equipment very tightly and always cleaned up after days work. My house looks amazing and very cool during the summer!! I get a lot of compliments on my house and inquires on painting company and colors too.

angi_reviews.text: He was so nice (Dean) he was very professional, knowledgeable and address my concern. After we signed the contract, we started after a week. They started the work on Tuesday and completed the job on Friday. I notice the leak two months ago and they came out right away the same day.

It's always tough choosing a general contractor for a job but I have to say we've been completely thrilled with the results of working with SCCCI. Mike and his team did an excellent job and even went above and beyond to fix other issues that came up during the construction at no additional charge. We got several quotes but SCCCI had very competitive pricing, their communication was top notch and we generally felt very comfortable throughout the whole project. Not only would I hire Mike and SCCCI again, but I would also strongly recommend them to anyone looking for general contracting projects.

BAD! Do NOT hire Larry Lidberg or anyone associated with them. He walked out on the job after yelling at me several times. He didn't review the work being done and blew up when he was questioned about the faulty work. Please check his court records at the Ventura County court (venturacountycourt.org) and the Los Angeles county courts. He is sue happy and falsely serves people. SCCCI or S. Ca. Construction Consultants, Inc. have several claims against their bond and are being looked at by the contractors board. Please check all this information for yourselves, the Ventura county website lets you check court cases for free and LA charges you $1. It will be the best $1 you will ever spend. He is bad news and word is he is going to change his company name to CEC.
The initial set up went very well, the house looks much better - we are still looking at a few pick-up items, but I have been asurred they will be there for us!

I was very happy to have hired SCCI to paint the exterior of our home. I met with Dann to choose colors/finishes and it was very apparent he knows the business well.  He made suggestions that I would have not of thought of otherwise and I was very happy with the way everything turned out.  The crew was timely and professional, and carefully cleaned each day of the project.  No touch-ups were needed and people who come over always compliment the colors and clean lines.  Thank you for a great job and experience! I highly recommend them and i will be using them again when i paint the interior of my house.

If you ever need any work performed on your home or have any questions about home improvement please do not hesitate to get in touch with me--I have every intention of being your life long contractor. angi_reviews.text: Friendly and professional handling of all aspects of job from start to finish. Excavation and pouring into front planter location was slightly delayed, but the company explained the delay and worked with us to accommodate our needs. Price undercut every one of the several contractors we received estimates from over the past several years. SCCCI passed cost savings of a materials distribution company's liquidation on to their customers, saving us a couple thousand dollars. They also were flexible with us for a portion of the payment, allowing us to pay this portion in installments over the next ten months. The owner and son worked directly with us to ensure that we were happy with the process, the cost, and the results. House looks great. Overall excellent service!

I'd just bought my house a couple of months ago and the first thing it needed by a paint job for the eyesore that it was; color as well as peeling paint. It apparently had not been painted in at least 17 years. Excellent experience, the company was very responsive to my needs, including follow-up call to see how it went. The construction manager checked on the job consistently; workers did an very conscientious job, with daily clean-up at the end of the day. A great deal of time was spent sanding off all old paint from the wood by rotary sander. The company identified itself by neighborhood canvassing, and while I've never hired on this basis before, the presentation by Michael was really very entertaining!  At the same time, they also did small but important things for me, such as hanging new exterior lights and installing an outside outlet on the balcony.  Yes, it was expensive, but hopefully will not have to worry about the paint for a long time to come.

angi_reviews.business_response_text: I say emphatically after 27 years of a flawless record with workmanship, as long as this review remains on this site we invite anyone to review this project in person. They have a lifetime guarantee against any defect whatsoever covering both labor and materials. They believe they have ‘pinholes’. We have walked the project including the owner of the company and “it’s beautiful”. In addition they have had the manufacturer out to inspect and take samples and the job is flawless. Call us at (800) 413-3333 for their address.

angi_reviews.text: A big chunk of the coating has dislodged below one of the windows they installed. I now how've structural cracks in walls they hammered on (at one point the hit the outside wall so hard they cracked the inside wall). I had to call them out many times to redo work that was either poorly done or to fix the cracking problem, which is still not fixed.  They now say they are unable fix the cracking, so have stopped trying.  Their lifetime warranty is apparently worthless.

They painted my house the wrong color. They also used the wrong primer for the trim. I also ended up having to hire someone else to install the gate again because it kept falling off. They sprayed stucco all over the outside faucets and the meter readers. The salesperson was very rude.

I HAD A VERY GOOD EXPERIENCE. THERE WAS ONE WINDOW THAT HAD A DEFECT AND THEY SENT SOMEONE OUT TO FIX IT IN A RELATIVELY SHORT TIME. THEY WERE VERY CAREFUL ABOUT COVERING THINGS. THEY COVERED THINGS UP SO THEY WOULDN'T GET THE HOUSE DIRTY OR DAMAGE ANYTHING. THEY WERE VERY GOOD ABOUT RESPECTING MY FURNITURE AND RUGS. THE MANAGER CALLED A MONTH AFTER TO ENSURE THAT I WAS SATISFIED AND ASKED IF THERE WAS ANYTHING THEY COULD DO TO IMPROVE IT. THEY VERY CONCERNED WITH CUSTOMER SATISFACTION.

angi_reviews.text: They ended up putting in a smaller unit than I wanted or needed.  I thought they were putting in a four unit and it was only a three unit.  I found this out when I called someone to do my service and he let me know that I should have a bigger unit because this one was going to be working harder.  They arrived on time, cleaned the area, and were professional.  I have no complaints about there work just the size of the unit.

Suggested aggressive measures to to maintain the unit.  Although we had noticed no drop in the performance of the HVAC system, the technician pointed out the rust stains and a slow-drip of liquid in the coils, saying it needed to be replaced ($2,000).  He also recommended replacing the furnace based on age.  He did have a very attractive financing program through a bank and an insurance company to spread the total cost ($6,000) over 5 years.  He also noted that if I had the budget, the 4.5-ton condenser could use an upgrade to a 5-ton condenser based on the size of our house (2,100 sq. ft), but that it wasn't necessary.  I asked for the weekend to consider the proposed work.  We ended up getting a second opinion and just going with more freon.
Answered all of my questions and did a great job.

We called Indoor Air Quality in Calabasas and got hold of a wonderful women who explained the details of what a Heating furnace includes.  We had issues with our heater and we thought maybe we need to have it serviced or maybe replaced.  We believe that our air ducts weren't cleaned in quite some time so that was something that we had the technician Mark come out and take a look at as well.  In the end we replaced the Heater and created a new Insulation for one of the rooms as well.   The technician made sure the ducts were cleaned using negative pressure techniques they showed us.  They also went to our attic made sure we don't' have any duct leaks which we didn't but that was important for us to know since we never checked it.   The check up was only $49 it was a monthly promotion and we paid for the heater $500 plus installation.  We are very happy with the results.

I had Indoor Air Quality, Inc in Calabasas come out to my mom's home as well this month.  I am very comfortable using their services since this is my second time using them.  For $49.00 they provided us with a 21 point system tune-up and safety inspection for our  air conditioner & heater unit.  A free installation of air filter (1? paper filter limited to standard size) and a free basic air duct cleaning, using negative Pressure Technique including an attic inspection for insulation & ducts Leaks meaning (check for rodents and efficiency rating).  I also installed a new Unit that was very old for $1,200.  Great Service.

My wife and I called your Indoor Air Quality, Inc. and asked for air duct cleaning service.  When your representative arrived, they pointed - out that our ducting system was made with fiberglass which was unlined on the inside.
For years, we have had our ducting system cleaned, but we were unaware that the fiberglass could not be cleaned propertyly.  We appriciated the education provided to us.
We were provided with 2 options.   We could replace the ducting or we could replace the heating/air conditioning system.  Since the system we had was very old we decided to buy a new system and ejoy the saving on the utility cost.
Once more we would like to thank you for your sales and installation service.  We are happy to refere you as well.

I hired Indoor Air Quality Inc. .  They are a full service heating and air conditioning company, specializing maintenance., repair and selling air conditioning systems.  I got my heating system, since it broke and it was cold.  They speacialize in air ducts and filters and removing asbestos.  I only mention this because they did a good job and I felt I should mention everything they do.  I should reccomend their serivce.  They are professionals with everything they do.

I would recommend them. They took longer than they said they would. They did a good job overall and the price was reasonable.

They were on time.  They finished one job in a day, on two different days; one for the fence and one for the orange oil treatment in the house.  I thought they could improve on cleaning up.  They did okay with the clean up but there was still some mess left back.

As s real estate professional I can say with utmost certainly that Eccono tree care is the best in the business of Tree services and monthly gardening services.
Eccono tree care showed up on time, were very polite and professional. They listen to all our requests and wishes.

Econo came promptly to prepare an estimate.  Several workers arrived a few days later to perform the work.  They made sure that we were satisfied with the job before leaving.  The brush clearance was acceptable to the Los Angeles Fire Department.

Eccono Tree was great! They did an awesome job, they were diligent, speedy and clean. They made sure everything was cleaned up before they left. They did damage some lights, but Ori was very attentive and immediate on getting the lights fixed free of charge. I would highly recommend them to all my friends and associates.
They were not the cheapest bid ($670.00) but they were the most honest and accommodating to my schedule. I had 5 bids ranging from $670 to $3,000.

I selected this company from internet after searching through a long list .  i chose Ecocno Tree care since it had workman's comp. in addition to license and insurance. the workman's comp was the selling point to me. The whole interaction with everyone was very friendly.  The whole job was handled very efficient. I certainly would recommend Ori Zairi he is very responsible and gave me even more hints regarding my gardening.   It was a job well done

angi_reviews.text: Was late starting the project-seller stated it was Riverside County that was slow in giving the permits.  That is entirely possible.

When the floor was first laid, I was very pleased with it. Soon after, it began peeling and cracking. I contacted the company and asked them to repair the damage, but they passed the blame onto me, even though I have been taking care of the floor as indicated.
They were very efficient and they cleaned up after themselves. They did a beautiful job and I don't have any complaints.

summer is approaching and the sun blinds me through my patio door, so i decided to have a patio cover built. i already had a slab for it so it wasn't as expensive as i thought. i called unique and they showed me some ideas and i liked what they had to offer so i went with them.
the patio cover is simple nothing fancy, made from spruce wood. it looks amazing and i hope it will do the trick. it took about 4.5days to get it done. everything went smoothly. no complications

I've been planning remodeling my home for years, i finally decided to commit to it and called unique. my friend said they did great work in her home. i met with the same contractor and i really liked him. he spent 4 hours with me and went into detail about what he can do and how to bring my ideas to life.
i decided to move forward and start the work. the project took about 5 weeks to do everything. they started on my bathroom and i was scared at first when i saw everything being ripped out but see it come together is amazing. first the floors vanity and shower. they finished the bathroom in a little over a week. my jaw dropped when i saw the finished result.
i couldn't wait to see the kitchen done. everyone was really nice the workers covered everything. and cleaned up after they were done. i would definitely use them and refer them to anyone i know.

EVERYTHING WENT GREAT. DOV, MY CONTACT PERSON, WORKED WITH ME ON THE TIMING (ALLOWING ME TO PUSH OFF PROJECT FOR A MONTH) AND THE PRICING.  THE GUYS GOT STARTED WHEN THEY SAID THEY WOULD.  THEY CLEANED UP AT THE END OF EVERYDAY.  THE PROJECT MANAGER HAD THE INSPECTIONS SCHEDULE TIMELY AND THERE WAS LITTLE TO NO DOWNTIME. I WAS REALLY UNSURE, BUT THEY MADE EVERYTHING QUICK AND PAINLESS.  THANK YOU EVERYONE.

angi_reviews.text: I recently renovated my 2bd/2 bath aparment in Hollywood with Ezra and his team at Energy Green Builders. This was a full gut renovation including two full baths, full kitchen replacement, all new flooring, windows, doors and paint. We came up with a budget and time frame that was both realistic and very reasonable, the work was completed on schedule and any hiccups or surprises were dealt with prompltly and professionally. There were several unexpected expenses that came up which they stepped up and covered without increasing my cost, I am very aprreciative and grateful to have found them and won't hesitate to recommend time and time again. They have already returned for follow up jobs with my neighbors and we will continue to use them. Over the time the work was completed, they left a clean tidy work place each day and kept noise and dirt to a minimum. Everyone that sees the apartment is amazed by the beautiful transformation thanks to the craftsmanship and vision of Rami, Ezra and all the workers!
The project went well and I was very pleased with the finished product. Ezra and his team was great to work with.
Went well from start to finish. The roof was done in a few days, the bathroom took a bit longer but the end result was great. Ezra and his team did a very good job!
They were prompt, hard- working, and efficient, and left everything in place when they were finished.

angi_reviews.business_response_text: Mr. [removed member name] Customer service is our top priority, and your review either positive or negative is always welcome. According to our technician that was at the appointment, the flat roof over your garage that was leaking, can't be repaired due to wet plywood boards, that are sagging and need to be replaced. You will always have a puddle of water over the garage due to that same problem, our tech recommended that the roof be replaced, because it could not be fixed, even you mentioned that you have tried sealing the area and it is still leaking from that same location. Flat roofs cannot be fixed with a quick seal, and we will not take any responsibility for the roof not to leak in the first rain. We cannot do miracles with $49 roof tune-up, its not a leak repair service, and you and few customers that thought that they can fix a major roof problem for $49, are unhappy with Angie's List deal. Good luck with your project, and we wish you happy holidays for you and your family.

angi_reviews.text: The set up and install went flawlessly and it is still performing quite well. My only issue with this company is it's financing solution for the project and the follow through with that aspect of the job. It seems every time we turn around the person we have dealt with is no longer at the company. I don't have a strong feeling they will be there if there ever is a problem but it's been over a year now and everything is still performing beautifully and they DID install a quality system.

It went great! The certified technician was extremely informative and was detailed oriented. He painted the picture for me so I could make an intelligent decision. Over all, I was extremely satisfied!!! I will most definitely recommend American Solar Solution to all of my family members and friends. =)

The staff i spoke with was very helpful and professional. They provided plenty of helpful information and answered all of my questions. The installation of the solar panels i purchased for my home went very well and smooth. I was very happy and satisfied with the service and installation. I highly recommend this company when purchasing and installing solar panels. I do have this company in thought for other services i might need in the near future.
AMCRUZ

We first saw an ad in the paper and decided to research the possibility of installing solar. We investigated numerous solar companies and looked at leasing vs purchasing. American Solar Solution has an A+ rating with the Better business Bureau which made us confident in the company. We contact them and arranged an appointment and Sal attended our home. Sal spent plenty of time with us and explained everything to us so we understood. The installation team were extremely punctual, polite and professional. We were very impressed by their commitment to getting the job done right. Thank you American Solar for a job extremely well done.
not good

American Solar Solution were in the area providing information on installing solar panels. We expressed interest and set up a consultation to discuss our options. Nir from American Solar Solution attended our property for a consultation and was very informative and friendly and talked us through the entire process. We decided to go ahead with installing solar as we had a high electric bill of $500-$800 per month. The installation team were professional and left the place clean and tidy. Thank you to Nir and everyone at American Solar for such a great job.

We found everyone involved to be professional, hard working and cordial. Area was kept clean and kept free of any debris! Timeline of installation went as quoted to us and salesman, Nir, kept his promises. He was available for any questions or problems that came up. He was very friendly and easy to work with.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Hi (member name removed), Thank you for your review. We are pleased to hear you are happy with the system and our installation. We hope you are looking forward to the long term benefits of solar power. If we can be of any further assistance, please don't hesitate to contact us. From the team at American Solar Solution

angi_reviews.text:
Everything went very smoothly and we are happy with the system.
We received our first electricity bill since the system was installed and it was $0.00 compared to $368 on the previous bill. This impressed us.
And the DWP incentives payment was prompt and made us even happier to install the system.
Thank you American Solar. Great job
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Good Afternoon [removed member name], Thank you for your review. We are glad you are happy with your installation and that is great news about your electricity bill! This is one of the financial benefits of going solar. If we can help again in the future, please contact us. From the team at American Solar Solution

angi_reviews.text:
Beware. We have been very dissatisfied with our experience. We were promised many things in terms of rebates from DWP and with our selection as a Bosch Showcase home.
There's a lot of bait and switch with this company. IF you use them, make sure everything is in writing and that it is detailed what your rebates will be and what the policy is for any other "incentives". Beware.
They had good workers and they kept the job going which I appreciated.  Furthermore, they completed everything to my satisfaction.

I am picketing in front of the offices of American Solar Solution and I have been approached by lots of people, imcluding former and current employees who have helped me to get a better understanding of the unethical practices of this company. If I had known any of this, I would have never opened my doors to American Solar Solution
You should be aware that there is a chance that American Solar Solution may change their company name. This is something I was told by one of the people that I spoke with and I have no way of confirming this.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Dear Valued Customer, American Solar Solution is sorry that you had a less than pleasant experience. We strive for excellence in every system we install. We have an outstanding track record and wonderful reviews. So far your review is the first negative review we have received. Our company is dedicated to resolving any issues we may have and our doors have always been open to you. Your system has passed the city and DWP inspections and has been in working order since it was installed. If, at any time you feel you are not 100% satisfied with the installed system or our customer service, we would be more than happy to meet with you and discuss ways in which to remedy the situation. American Solar Solution is willing to share any plans and permits with you. As with all of our customers, we value your business and hope we may continue our professional relationship. Thank you American Solar Solution

angi_reviews.text: I received a call from one of their sales reps regarding a free quote. I was getting calls from many companies but for some reason, the lady who I spoke to was very professional, kind and had answers to all of my questions. I told her to call me back in a couple days so I could first talk to my husband about it. She called me back and we set up the appointment. The day of the appointment, their technician called and arrived on time. He was also very professional, courteous and had all the answers. He din't try to sell me anything, didn't lie to me, very honest. We decided to go with the leasing option and they are finally done with the panels. They look incredible and can't wait to start sving.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: Customer, Thank you for the kind words. Here at American Solar Solution, we want to make sure we go above and beyond for each one of our customers to ensure the process of going Solar is as seamless and painless as possible. Customer service is paramount with us and each report such as yours stands to reinforce that we are achieving our goals of customer satisfaction. Thank you once again! -Your Friends at American Solar Solution

angi_reviews.text: The installation crew was prompt and efficient in their work. They completed the installation within 2 days and returned to repair the roof tiles after the city inspector to ensure all broken tiles were repaired. There was nothing they could have done to make the installation easier or more efficient. Highly recommend this company as they've had multiple follow ups to insure my satisfaction. Since I paid for the work using a promotional balance tranfer checks from 2 credit cards, American Solar Solution rebated the balance transfer fee to me in the form of a check. That allowed me to receive 12 months interest free on the balance tranfers. Very nice!!

My parents finally got around to renovating their house and thought it'd be a good idea to install some solar panels to take advantage of all this sunlight in California (global warming?? :/) Well, after getting estimates from some solar panel businesses in our county, my parents decided to go with American Solar Solution because not only did they have the best price for the solar panels my parents were looking for but they really took their time to go over all the details about the entire process and patiently answered all of my parents' questions. I think my parents were most impressed by the fact that they actually finished installing the solar panels by the time that they said they would. (Personally, I'm most impressed by the fact that solar panels can make the electricity my pareitns' house needs without harming the environment.) My parents have already been telling their friends and family that they need to get some solar panels as well!

We started with a new roof facing South on a two story house, with no shadows, an ideal location. Eli explained the quirky and ever shifting government rebate situation, and handled all the paperwork for both federal and DWP rebates. He also found us a one year zero interest loan for most of the balance. The work was done promptly, and looks fine from the ground (no way am I going up there). Now we're just waiting for DWP to flip the switch.

angi_reviews.text: They were pretty good. We had language problems with their workers.  The work they did was an A, good.

It's been two months since we signed the contract, and it hasn't been finished. The work that they did do was not done well. Since then, we have fired the company, and found another.

The contractor was not present while the work was being done, which led to poor work. We have been displaced from the rooms during the whole experience.

They were slow partly because of the weather and partly because they mismeasured one of the windows and they had to reorder it and it took a while. The salesman was really friendly, but I came to realize later that some of the sales tactics that he used was a little high pressure. They did good work, but the salesman made promises that somehow the company didn’t seem to be informed of. Therefore, you got to make sure that everything is written out and they stick to what they say they are going to do because it took some effort to get them to do what they said they were going to do.
Make sure you are specific of what you want done and have it written down.

Everything turned out beautifully. They do things the right way without cutting corners. They take the time to get the proper permits and make sure that all inspections go smoothly. We found some existing plumbing and electrical issues along the way which all got taken care of to avoid future problems. Anything that wasn't right got fixed until we were satisfied. They are also helpful in figuring out ways to work with your budget. We were treated like family the whole way though. Never need to find another contractor - they do it all.

angi_reviews.text: OMG. He encouraged me not to have him pull permits. He ignored our contract and installed different tiles on backsplash and never sealed them. I paid $28K for a small kitchen. Had a contract. Yuval ignored the contract. I paid for granite counters and he installed them in pieces, he even charged me $3K to install a full piece so I had a countertop which didn't have a cut. And installed the crown molding in pieces. OMG. He put in two 2" pieces to fill in where he didn't measure properly. Kitchen floor chipped immediately. He didn't seal any tiles. Had me order appliances from some cheap company back east. The interior of the dishwasher quickly rusted. It's only been five years and my kitchen needs remodeling! He built a refrigerator cabinet which actually was too small for any refrigerator. I told him, please make my new frig fit, he wanted to charge me $60! Is $28,000 not enough! Do NOT trust this man. Liar, and crook. Oh, I can upload several pictures. I will.

angi_reviews.text: She agreed to refund a certain amount of money and never did, gave me the run around all the time.  She never mailed it and full of excuses.  I had hired them to redo the kitchen and they took months to get someone out here and the person they sent was unsatisfactory and incompetent.

The service went great. I had them install an exhaust fan over the stove, replace a fan in the bathroom, install a light fixture and some other handyman services around the house. 2-3 technicians came out and completed the job in about a half day. They did a nice job cleaning up after themselves. They were very nice and I had no problem scheduling the deal.
See above, absolute waste of time

Was a great Angie's List Big Deal. 
Arrived on-time with two people.  One was very knowledgeable, one was the helper.  Installed crown modeling on the entire first floor; just did the cuts and installation for us.  We completed the calking and painting.
Also fixed an ill-fitting exterior door, which everyone else wanted to replace.  Saved us a lot of money.
Overall very satisfiled with what we got for the money spent versus what we got.

The remodeling project was a disaster. I was very impressed by Michael, the owner and the "arts and crafts" part of the partnership (his description). He was knowledgeable, smart, and punctual. I thought we would have a successful project.
His wife Krista is the "business" half of the partnership, responsible for quotes and schedules. I found her unprofessional and undependable.
It took five months to get a semi-firm price on the overall job (we had agreed that the job was different in scope from the package deal, and that the price would be higher or lower than the amount paid). When it came, it was wildly over budget, and I attempted to negotiate a price closer to the original package by re-specifying materials and fixtures. Before we ever reached agreement, Michael got sick, and was unable to meet or work further. I was informed that, because of his health, the company went out of business.
Horrible experience. Would not ever work with this contractor again.
The work Miracle has done has been ok, but they have not been very responsive in finishing my project.  All attempts at contacting them have fallen on deaf ears.
They gave me a good deal.

They came in and they always had problems. They had nice guys working of them, but they would only do a little but at a time. They had to order this and that and then we had the holidays. I am very easy-going, but my recent concerns started when their phones were turned off. I just talked to Krista Friday, she gave me her cell number, she said they were waiting on cabinets and now her cell phone, their business phone and home phone is turned off.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: This is untrue. Our phones are all in working order and always have been.The customer consistently added different design and we spent months taking her to choose tubs and fixtures.

angi_reviews.text: Lots of promises no action

Michael and his assistant showed up at the time as they said.  After we described the job that we wanted done, they went to pickup the materials and started working.  Due to the power shortage in our area, they had to come back the second day.  They worked a little more than 7 hours between the two days, but they did not ask for more.  They have done professional jobs and we are very pleased with their work.
Miracle construction is very professional and will get the job done they way you want it!

The entire project looks great and was completed in a timely manner.  So much of the remodel really depends on the owner having all the materials (ie, tile, faucet, sinks) all picked out and waiting int he garage for the contractor.

In addition to doing a great job, they stand by their work.  I was referred to Miracle Construction after a neighbor had their bathroom completely remodeled including installing a tankless waterheater, and I was amazed at their great work.

Mike was great to work with.  He was extremely professional and easy to do business with.  His knowledge of the local building codes as well as an attention to details yielded a great final result.  If I had to have one complaint, it would be that he slightly underestimated the scope of the job and as such, it went a bit over the allotted time.  All in all, I would say that he did a great job at a very fair price.  I would definitely call them again for any construction needs.

angi_reviews.text: Extremely well -- covered in the above discussion.

I have a very close friend who Carsten built a house for and he LOVED his work.  I have also heard excellent reviews from an architect acquaintance who has worked with Carsten numerous times.  
I found his work to be meticulous and of the highest quality.  I am usually complaining about the lack of communication, the lack of attention to details and the lack of pride in quality work.  I did not have one instance where I might complain of any of that with Carsten.  I have very high standards which are usually not met, but Carsten met every one.  Attention to detail, communication with his client, quality of work, commitment to promised schedule.  If you are planning on any construction, I would suggest you look long and hard at working with Black Forest Craftsmen.  There are too many other people in the business who will lead to frustration and tears.  I'm just sayin'.

From the moment Carsten Cramer arrived I was impressed. He had done a major remodel and addition for the previous owners. I decided based on the quality of the work I was now living with and the fact that he knew the house--I would give him a call. I was a bit apprehensive as I was afraid the scope of what needed would not be of interest to him. But Carsten came over, very quickly gave an estimate, and began work within the next couple of days. The quality of the work was great, his team professional and accommodating, and they are familiar with high end finishes, fixtures, and details. I was so happy that I then had them back to paint, plaster, and wallpaper the entire house. Once again i was very impressed with Carsten and his team. I am already thinking about my next projects and look forward to working with Black Forest Craftsmen.

angi_reviews.text: Michael is a pleasure to work with and is very creative.  Allowing him to push the envelope to make an ordinary remodel into a custom look really made a difference...like his suggestion to move the bathroom wall out a foot into the hallway.  This idea allowed us to put a seat in the shower giving it that "luxury feel."  The original construction plan was to take 3 weeks but we ran into some bad weather and the special order "river rock" which wasn't in stock...so it took 4 weeks.  We were really pleased that he stayed on schedule and didn't try to nickel and dime us on the extras.  Michael performed work of exceptional quality at a very reasonable price.  We have received nothing but raves from our friends and relatives about how incredible it looks...we have named it "Coastal Sheik" :-)

The construction experience was better than I could imagine. Michael is a good communicator, he is fair, and he works very hard. His crew has been with him for many years, and they were all very pleasant. Michael told me the costs, and he came in on budget. Michael was able to answer all of my questions along the way. This was the first time I ever did major construction, and I was scared from all of the scary stories out there. Michael proved them wrong!

review_sentiment.summary: Customer praises Michael's creativity and exceptional work quality at a reasonable price.
Client praises the contractor's excellent communication, fairness, and professionalism, citing a positive experience despite being a first-time major construction customer.

We couldn't be happier with our contractor. We had such a good experience with Star Builders, Inc. and our contractor Larry, when we remodeled our kitchen.We chose Star Builders, Inc. because eveyone that we met and spoke with was wonderfully personable AND very professional.
The price was a little bit more than we planned, but we got was amazing. We have already started planning our bathroom remodel project with them.

They could have done the job in three to four days, but it's already been ten days and it's far from done. My roof still has a hole in it, the windows and doors are not up yet. The workmen don't bother to ever show up and they have left a mess in my backyard. There is never a supervisor present and they do not return my calls. They say they are coming to work and then do not show up. I have never had such a bad experience with a company.
angi_reviews.business_response_text: We appreciate all the reviews we get, in addition to the time the members take to write them. We hold your opinion of us, in high regard. This naturally sets the standard for our work ethic and level of customer service. So I was truly taken aback by this customers review, as I was under the impression we had built a good report through our daily back and forth telephone conversations. I felt that the job was handled well. We completed everything stated on the contract and abided by the contract scheduling. The contract was signed 3/15/2013 and we started work only after the “3 day right to cancel” waiting period (required by law). We were able to accommodate all her requests and even with the multitude of rescheduling, the job finished 2 days ahead of the scheduled contract completion date. I ask that this review is read with a greater understanding and consideration. I also ask- to please read our other reviews that I believe attest more to what type of company that we are. Thank you

angi_reviews.text: Simon, Guy, and other workers were on time, explained work as it progressed.  All work completed timely.  Also cleanup done each day.

From start to finish, the entire project went very smoothly.  As with any remodel this size, there will always be unforeseen issues....but the way they were handled is the real issue. And in my case, Guy took care of everything as well as anyone could have.

I had actually had four estimates before I met with Guy from Star Builders. None of them seemed quite right, either they showed up very late or when they came in they didn't wipe their feet and tracked in dirt. These things made me wonder how they would be on the job! Guy from Star builders showed up on time, wiped his feet thoroughly and sat listening patiently to what I wanted. He then told me my options to get everything I wanted including the limited space concern. With his wonderful suggestions and detailed explanation of the entire process in a way I could understand,it made my contractor choice clear! Everyone was kind and considerate and cleaned after themselves everyday. The job finished earlier than I thought and my kitchen and bathroom came out better than I could have possibly dreamed. If your considering doing any work to your house, Star Builders are the guys!
